ARREST FOR ATTEMPTED STREET THEATRE by Camilla Power

On Mayday morning, I’m wondering whether to head to Clerkenwell on the day when pagan, anarchist and socialist hope springs eternal. If I step onto the Green, I am liable to arrest under bail conditions imposed after 25 hours detention in Lewisham Police Station from around 6 pm on the eve of the royal wedding.

What did I do to be banished from the sacred Mayday space? Nothing…yet. I was picked up in one of last week’s preemptive raids during what’s become known in ‘activist’ circles as the Great Royal Wedding Purge. The police have begun to arrest people whom they suspect of thinking of doing something.

These arrests have been written about in terms of democratic rights to free speech. From my perspective, it’s about the human right to ritual participation. My work as an anthropologist combines Darwinian and Durkheimian models on the evolution of ritual as the necessary condition for language. Performative deeds precede and provide the necessary scaffolding for speech. In activist mode, I put theory to empirical test, helping create ritual street theatre to move into and around politically contested spaces, at ritually charged ‘cracks’ in time, establishing symbolic presence. As part of a motley crew known as the Government of the Dead, I’ve worn silly costumes, devised ways to hang and decapitate effigies, spilt fake body fluids, committed cannibalism, cast spells, bodypainted, sung and danced badly.

On the eve of the wedding, several cars and a van load of police – maybe twenty odd officers of the law – swooped on a south London street corner to round up a theatrical troupe. Suddenly I was in the midst of the most extraordinary street theatre yet; what’s so exciting is you never know who is going to turn up and take part. The police were the ones in costume, apart from the detective and shifty undercover surveillance; we were distinctly underdressed. We’d been moving theatrical props – some quite heavy. And the police knew the drill of the choreography, stringing themselves into a line between us and the suburban street, backing us steadily against the London brick walls behind. Slyly, they ringed around a white van which they suspected we were walking towards. We just waited expectantly to be auditioned while the detective in the suit flashed his badge and pointed to some of us, denying others – ‘no, he’s alright’ – as if he were casting us for roles. The only one who happened to be wearing some fancy dress got picked on; as did my close friend and colleague Chris Knight, a Professor of anthropology – best known for his top hat, dark glasses and vampire blood Baron Samedi look – but now in a motheaten jumper. By a stroke of fortune, a Channel 4 documentary team and an independent filmmaker were on hand to film the whole episode. A friend pointed out later, more police officers were needed to arrest us than for the Krays!

I was under suspicion of conspiring to cause a public nuisance. But what had I done? No ritual had yet been performed. The police wanted to know about a superbly crafted guillotine, decked with red and red-and-black flags either side of the legend ‘Some Cuts Are Necessary’ and louchely associated with a cariacature dummy Prince Andrew, adorned with a cardboard Knight Grand Cross of the Royal Victorian Order. This august decoration was in fact pinned onto the flesh and blood Andrew by his mum in an investiture on March 26. No one noticed the goings on that Saturday at Court. Some royal rituals are best kept under wraps, it seems.

After the ritual drama on the street, the procedural boredom of the booking in, and then, the royal dungeon: perpetual fluorescent glare which never acknowledges circadian rhythm, the hard and sticky plastic mattress, steel loo, ‘cushion’ on the ledge which can never be angled right to rest your neck comfortably…even a numb doze is rudely disturbed by random clattering checks through the cell door aperture and callouts for inedible meals. With the demeaning requirement to ask humbly for every petty comfort, this had a special character of intermingling Monarchical and Disciplinary Punishment

As Victor Turner tells of such liminal states of sensory deprivation, you enter ‘the realm of primitive hypothesis’, where you have power to take apart and put together the world as you know it in novel combinations. Could it be that the Royal Household, amid all the Kate/Wills mania, images plastered ubiquitous as maoist icons of young love, felt challenged? Could they be sufficiently challenged in their pageantry by our cardboard cutout, straw-stuffed constructions held together with cable ties and gaffer tape that they let fall to their inner cabal, they would not be amused by any rival rebellious spectacle? The police, smarting from the anarchist poke breaching Charles and Camilla’s body politic, would have scrambled into action.

The Government of the Dead is versed in lowdown mummer’s tricks for transforming corpses into the stuff of feasts. It regularly rehearses a Rabelaisian carnival of bloodshed and dismemberment, ruthless slaughter ‘transformed into a merry banquet’, as Bakhtin puts it: ‘bloodshed, dismemberment, burning, death, beatings, blows, curses and abuses – all these elements are steeped in “merry time”, time which kills and gives birth’. EAT THE BANKERS was the slogan under which top-hatted Chris Knight/Mister Mayhem zombie-walked, urging fellow zombies to ‘snack on bankers’ brains’ at the April 1 G20 Financial Fools Day Banquet at the Bank.

The Government of the Dead’s fearsome Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse first galloped out at Canary Wharf, Hallowe’en 2008 on the pavement outside Lehman Brothers. Financial wizards scuttled home for the afternoon. While a new moon set over Canary Wharf dock, witches cast an opening ceremony amid a circle of pumpkin candles, summoning the Horsemen from four directions to gyrate wildly to a samba band – Dancing on the Grave of Capitalism. But capitalism keeps rising from the grave, compelling us to bury it in a lunar infinity of revolutions .

Mardi Gras 2009, again dark moon, zombies went window-shopping down Oxford Street in a New Orleans-style funeral jazz procession to Hang a Banker at Tyburn Tree/Marble Arch. Being indigenous London zombies, they also tossed bankers’ brains in frying pans in the Zombie Pancake Race. The zombies kept trying and failing to haul the shop-dummy, bowler-hatted banker up onto Marble Arch. Police egged the zombies on, ‘ner, do it properly!’ they cried. Their good humour on this occasion starkly contrasts with the cruel persecution of the zombie folk who turned up on Soho Square looking for breakfast.

On Mayday, 2010, the Saturday before the general election, the righteous justice of the Government of the Dead was visited on the party leaders. Processions came from each Party HQ to occupy Parliament Square. Cameron and Clegg were hanged, presciently side by side, from a sturdy gallows, while Brown was decapitated, blood spurting onto the lenses of press cameras. The longest fourth procession came all the way from Clerkenwell; black bloc anarchists escorted a pint-sized Nick Griffin to be hung, drawn and quartered, then hurled to the crowd. After Death, miraculous new Life: a Maypole was erected on Parliament Square and we danced in a wild whirl. The heavens opened. Two, three, five, ten tents were hurriedly pitched for cover and suddenly a camp mushroomed. This became Democracy Village, a tented premonition of Tahrir Square and Democracia Real Ya which held the ground until forcibly evicted on 20 July 2010.

On Democracy Village, the Government of the Dead had its initial brush with royal power at the State Opening of Parliament on May 25. As the royal carriage rolled by, Queen Tracy, a homeless woman of regal bearing, dressed in Elizabethan costume, delivered an Alternative Queen’s Speech, drowned out by the tolling of Westminster Abbey’s bells.

This was truly a ‘world turned upside down’ with those lying in the gutter looking at the stars. Royalty channels cosmic alignment between heaven and earth, ensuring that monarch and people move in step through cycles and seasons to keep the cosmos turning, bring the rains, and make the kingdom fertile. According to Max Gluckman’s thesis on rituals of rebellion in traditional sacred systems, where the system itself is not in dispute, dramas of rebellion and role reversal turn the world upside down only to return it right back to where it was before. The implication is that if the rebellious ritual is not tolerated, as ours wasn’t, the system does not at all feel sure of itself.

As the medieval lower strata of grotesque revelry mirrored and symbolically destroyed the authority of officialdom, the ritual shadow world demands its fair share of power. The Government of the Dead as Rabelaisian agitprop asserts its rites in polarity to the rigid ceremonial of royal protocol. The slogan of the Government of the Dead – ‘the only good government is a dead government’ – sounds fundamentally anarchist. Yet it derives from an idea common to many cultures across the world. Those who live in the world, eating, drinking, having sex, are susceptible to the temptations of the flesh; only once dead, as ancestors, can they be trusted. To join the Government, you must be dead. We agitators are mere agents, our comings and goings governed by lunar time and tide. The Government of the Dead seeks to restore lunarchy – rule by the Moon – to humanity, with ritual, sexual and economic exchange switching by lunar phase. Let the shadow world Government take the power for one phase, say waxing moon, the official world in waning.

When the Government was informed of the date set for William Wales and Catherine Middleton’s marriage, it was aghast. The dying days of the moon of April prior to Mayday was cosmologically catastrophic! No truly royal couple can marry fruitfully except at full moon, the honeymoon time. Dark moon conjures menstrual blood, kinship, witchcraft – all antithetical to marriage. Mayday is the time of popular fertility rite, not sex between newly weds, but group sex of the lads and lasses in the woods and fields. The Government realized it had a cosmic duty to supply the necessary erotic elements to avert this threat to fecundity. We scribbled down the ritual formula: Royal Wedding + Mayday holiday = Right Royal Orgy. How this was to be achieved, the agents weren’t certain, but it had compelling logic. In the event, the Zombie Group Wedding, Queer Resistance Flashmob and fertility rites around the statue of Eros promised a solution.

Except the event was prevented; the agents of zombie orgy chucked in a dungeon; the guillotine impounded under counter-terrorism laws. The Government of the Dead is now gravely displeased.

title: Yek ji damezrînerên Koma Amed Birkan Çelîk koça dawî kir
content:
Bîrkan Çelîk endamê damezrîner ê Koma Amed e û li navçeya Selîm a Qersê dijiya. Çelîk li malê xwe krîza dil derbas kir û jiyana xwe ji dest da.




Piştî ku haya malbatê jê çêbû Çelîk birin nexweşxaneyê û li wir tevî hemû mudaxeleyan ji mirine nehat rizgarkirin.




Çelîk sibe li gundê Baskoyê yê navçeya Selîm a bajarê Qersê dê bê definkirin.







Bîrkan Çelîk




Bîrkan Çelîk di nav koma Koma Amedê de cih girt ku di salên 1990î de hatibû avakirin. Di sala 1992an de piştî ji endamên komê Evdilmelik Şexbekir koça dawî kir, komê xebatên xwe bi Navenda Çanda Mezopotamyayê (MKM) re domand. Piştî sê albûmên wan hatin weşandin, ji ber zextên dewletê endamên komê neçar man ku derkevin derveyî welat. Piştî vê yekê kom belav bû. Endamê komê Birkan Çelîk piştî belavbûna komê neçû derveyî welat û kare xwe yê pîşeyî wate kare xwe dermansaziyê li bajarê Qersê domand. Çelik, li gel dermanfiroşiyê wênegirî jî dikir. Her wiha Çelîk dibistana muzîkê li Qersê ava kiribû û bi sedan ciwan li wir perwerde dikir.










Derbarê Koma Amed de




Kom, sala 1988an ji aliyê xwendekarên Fakulteyên Tipê yên Zanîngehên Enqere û Hacettepeyê ve hat damezrandin.




Di nav endamên destpêkê yên komê de Evdilmelîk Şêxbekir, Gulşen Çetîn, Savaş Çakmak, Rohat Kutlay, Fikrî Kutlay, Mustafa Kart û Ahmet Kaya hebûn.




Albuma yekem sala 1990î bi navê "Kulîlka Azadî" derket û dengekî mezin veda.




Yek ji endamên destpêkê yên komê Evdilmelîk Şêxbekir, ji bo avakirina Navenda Çanda Mezopotamyayê (NÇM) jî kedeke mezin da.




Evdilmelîk Şêxbekir, Îlona 1991ê tevlî refên PKKyê bû û sala 1992yan jiyana xwe ji dest da.




Komê paşê bi beşdariya gelek hunermendên din xebatên xwe domand lê hinek endamên komê piştî albuma "Dergûş" a sala 1997an ji ber sedemên siyasî neçar man ku penaberî welatên Ewropayê bibin.

author: Abahlali_3
title: We mourn the loss of Des D’sa
content:
30 October 2026 Abahlali baseMjondolo press statement

We mourn the loss of Des D’Sa, father, uncle, grandfather, and a comrade to many

The death of Desmond D’Sa has plunged many people on the left in Durban and beyond, across numerous organisations, into shock and despair. Siyakhala ngo Des.

Comrade Des was a stalwart in the struggle against apartheid and was a well-known organiser who formed the South Durban Community Environmental Alliance (SDCEA), an environmental organisation that raised the concerns of families living in the oil- and gas-affected areas of Wentworth and the Bluff.

His activism and the fight against injustices did not end with environmental issues and it definitely did not end in Wentworth and the Bluff. Comrade Des fought against all forms of oppression and injustice, including gangsterism and the mining companies in rural areas, and supported everyone from fisherfolk to migrants and poor people, whether living in flats, hostels or shacks. He did not back down when struggle became dangerous. Comrade Des spoke fluent isiZulu and engaged everyone with the same respect.

He joined the first march against ANC councillor Yacoob Baig organised from Kennedy Road in 2005, which became part of the process towards the formation of our movement. He stood with our movement from the beginning, and was one of the few who never wavered in his support even when we were under severe attack and isolated.

Comrade Des was one of the founders of the Right to Know Campaign that fought fought against secrecy while promoting the right to information. He was also one of the founders of The Durban Coalition, which was first formed in response to the devastating floods of 2022. The Coalition, which unites community organisations across the city in a united front, is thriving today and is an important formation in the city.

We will miss Comrade Des so much. He was always on the side of the people. He was always so warm and kind. We always laughed when he was around.

We wish to thank his family for him. And wish to express our heartfelt condolences to his family, friends and comrades.

It is so sad and devastating that you have left us. Till we meet again.

Hamba kahle Comrade Des D’Sa. Ubuyiqhawe.

Upon my arrest on Feb/6/76, some of the first groups of people who came to show solidarity, along with my own People, in recognition of my status as a Prisoner of War, were the anti-authoritarian groups of both Canada and the U.S.A. The respect, recognition, love and solidarity they gave not only to me but to my People is something I will always cherish and hold dear to my heart. This show of solidarity proved to me that not all Euro-Americans were our enemy.

Throughout the first months of our organizing the Leonard Peltier Defense Committee (LPDC), the anti-authoritarians were the people who gave us what knowledge, resources, and skills they had to build an effective organization. I questioned why they would help my People and myself, as at the time, we believed all white people were wasichus; the evil ones. They proved to us that this was not the case and that they too hated the wasichus. They too were resisting and fighting imperialist oppression being committed by their race, but not their People. They did not consider themselves to be part of a People so evil.

Now that my case has gained international attention and is becoming a cause to rally around, other Peoples are standing with us. But the first people who supported us, at least the strong-hearted ones, are still with us. These people, whom my own People call the good-hearted ones, were with me from the beginning of my imprisonment. I was very concerned when I heard that some of them, who are also imprisoned warriors, were not going to be recognized as political prisoners or POWs. Neither I nor my People want to work with those who will not recognize their own warriors. So I was pleased to hear that FN! [Freedom Now!] and other such organizations have changed their views on this very critical issue.

From the beginning of these new organizations, one of the questions I repeatedly asked was how they defined political prisoners and prisoners of war. Some wanted to blanketly define all Indian prisoners as political prisoners or POWs. This I could not agree with. There is a certain truth to it; because of imperialist oppression, through socio-economic conditions or outright aggression against Indian Nations, all Indian prisoners are in a sense political prisoners. But I for one, along with all traditionalist and progressive Indians, cannot identify as political or justify in any way, someone who has, for example, raped a sister, molested a child, or murdered an elder. I decided I would have to withdraw my name from any organization which used this blanket type of definition. Again, I was pleased to learn that this was not going to be the policy of these organizations.

My greatest disappointment, in all my years of struggle, occurred just recently, when I saw the lack of support for the courageous warriors at Oka. The knowledge that some of my own People failed to stand up to protest the invasion of Oka broke some of my spirit as a warrior. But it also awakened me to the realization that I must work harder to build unity among my own People and their nations.

In today’s world, we see nations whom many of us considered allies turning into new imperialists to join the old. We as warriors, and our organizations, must build our own foundation of unity from which to struggle, to protect the environment, stop the spread of nuclear weapons, and to resist colonialism. There are still a few small nations holding strong — but in truth, we now have to depend on ourselves for sanctuary in the struggle to free our homelands. We must build a unity so strong that no matter how oppressive our enemy becomes, they cannot destroy it.

Through this Tribunal, let us begin a new day, a new organization, a new movement. Let us hold our fists high, and put the oppressors on notice that we have just begun to fight, for not only our political prisoners and prisoners of war, but for our nations and for our freedom.

title: Iranian regime sentences Van resident Cenk Demir to 5 years in prison
content:
The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) stated that a regime court in the city of Urmia had sentenced Cenk Demir, originally from Van (Wan), to five years in prison on charges of “membership in opposition groups.”




According to the statement, Demir was arrested in Urmia approximately eight months ago. After being questioned for months at a security detention centre in the city, he was transferred to Urmia Central Prison.




It was reported that, following the announcement of the verdict, Demir was transferred to the Ershad ward, where political prisoners are held.

author: Nathália Baron
title: ‘O sistema do Estado é horrível’: Caraguatatuba é campeã em violência contra a mulher
content:
O relógio se aproxima das onze da manhã quando Alcione senta na poltrona da sala de acolhimento. A mulher, cujo nome homenageia a sambista, está lá para contar sua história que, nos últimos anos, tem sido marcada por ciclos de violência e resistência. Um tormento que se agrava quando o ex-marido, em recusa ao fim do casamento, a ameaça de morte. Uma mulher que reflete milhares de outras Brasil afora, presas a uma espiral de violência enquanto lutam pelo direito de seguirem vivas.










A poucos metros dali, as ondas quebram ao chegarem na faixa de areia, vazia devido à baixa temporada. 

Estamos em Caraguatatuba, no litoral norte de São Paulo, o município brasileiro com mais de 100 mil habitantes que possui a maior taxa de mulheres atendidas pelo Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) devido à violência física.

 A taxa média dos últimos dez anos é de 312 casos por 100 mil habitantes, o triplo do estado de São Paulo, segundo levantamento feito pela 

Agência

 

Pública

 a partir de dados do DataSUS de 2016 a 2025.




Além de estar no topo do ranking das cidades com a maior taxa de violência física, Caraguatatuba também é o município paulista com mais de 50 mil habitantes com a maior taxa de tentativa de feminicídio: foram 24 entre 2021 e 2025, quase cinco por ano, segundo dados do Ministério da Justiça. Apesar disso, os feminicídios estão abaixo da média: foram seis no mesmo período. Um indício de que a cidade pode estar conseguindo acolher mulheres vítimas de violência, impedindo que cheguem a ser assassinadas.



















“A institucionalidade na prevenção à violência contra as mulheres previne mortes. Quanto mais equipamentos você tem, menor a chance  do agravamento dessa violência intrafamiliar, que é o feminicídio”, analisa a demógrafa Jackeline Ferreira Romio, que pesquisou o cenário do feminicídio no Brasil a partir de dados do sistema de saúde.




Apesar de evitar mortes, os equipamentos públicos não têm sido eficientes na prevenção inicial da violência, atuando de forma reativa, quando a mulher já corre risco grave. Medidas protetivas seguem sendo negadas e, quando concedidas, violadas. Mesmo equipada com aparelhos públicos voltados para a proteção das mulheres que vão desde Conselhos, delegacia especializada, centros de acolhimento e aplicativos de denúncia, Caraguatatuba ainda não viu os números de agressões e tentativas de feminicídio caírem. Falta algo.




Alcione relata que o comportamento controlador do marido se agravou no segundo ano de casamento. Àquela altura, João*, retomou um antigo vício em álcool e outras drogas e, desempregado, começou a vender os móveis da casa para sustentar a dependência. Quando o marido quis vender a bicicleta que haviam comprado juntos, ela pediu para que ele saísse da casa, que era dela.




Ele saiu, mas pouco tempo depois, apareceu no portão de Alcione. Chorando, disse que estava dormindo na rua e pediu ajuda para se alimentar. Com pena, ela permitiu que ele entrasse, ofereceu banho e comida. O clima amigável mudou quando ela se recusou a reatar o relacionamento.




“Ele me aferiu um tapa na cara, um tapa muito forte. Eu fui até a cozinha chorando, ele foi me acompanhando e disse ‘Não chora, porque esse tapa não doeu. Vai doer agora, porque eu vou pegar uma faca e te matar’”.




A mulher correu até a casa da frente, onde mora sua mãe, e pediu ajuda aos familiares presentes. João conseguiu fugir. No dia seguinte, Alcione buscou atendimento na Delegacia de Defesa da Mulher (DDM) de Caraguatatuba. Mesmo sendo uma unidade especializada em violência contra mulheres, sentiu-se desrespeitada: foi atendida por uma funcionária da prefeitura que não demonstrou preparo em acolhê-la.




“Uma pessoa grossa. Fazia perguntas como se eu fosse a culpada. Saí de lá humilhada. Tive vontade de desistir.” Após a mobilização de Alcione e outras vítimas, a funcionária foi retirada da delegacia e uma assistente social a substituiu.
















Alcione foi ameaçada de morte pelo ex-marido, mas conseguiu sair do ciclo de dor e violência.




Para Márcia Coelho, presidente do Conselho da Mulher de Caraguatatuba (CMDMC), as mudanças recentes na Delegacia de Defesa da Mulher melhoraram o acolhimento, mas ainda há dinâmicas sistêmicas que prejudicam a experiência de quem busca atendimento: 

“O sistema do Estado é horrível. É uma coisa fria. Na sala de espera há um balcão com vidro e você tem que falar ali na frente de todo mundo”

, explica.




As caraguatatubenses que sofrem qualquer tipo de violência de gênero durante os finais de semana ou feriados precisam aguardar até o próximo dia útil para que possam buscar atendimento especializado. Isso porque a Delegacia de Defesa da Mulher do município, assim 

como 75,8% das DDMs do país

, atende apenas de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h. A alternativa oferecida pelo Governo do Estado é uma Sala DDM 24h, que opera dentro de uma delegacia comum. O problema é que as agressões são mais frequentes quando o homem está em casa – à noite ou no final de semana.




Segundo a vereadora Cássia Gonçalves de Jesus (PT), a experiência nessas salas pode agravar o estado emocional da mulher, pois “o acolhimento é feito pelo mesmo delegado, o mesmo plantonista. Não são pessoas especializadas. Escutamos muitos relatos de mulheres que sofreram outra violência durante o atendimento”, explica.




Crime crescente no Brasil e em São Paulo




No estado, houve um aumento de 22,2% nos casos de feminicídio entre 2023 e 2025 (saindo de 221 mortes de mulheres para 270) – um aumento três vezes maior do que a média nacional (de 6,3% no período).




Em sua campanha eleitoral, o governador Tarcísio de Freitas, reeleito com 62,6% dos votos, trouxe a segurança da mulher como um de seus focos. Ele promete o “fortalecimento da rede”, aumentar em três vezes o número de Delegacias de Defesa da Mulher 24 horas, a expansão do aplicativo SP Mulher Segura e a continuidade da Patrulha SP Mulher Segura.




As promessas de campanha, no entanto, não condizem com o que foi feito nos primeiros quatro anos de governo. Tarcísio deixou de destinar R$ 35,7 milhões entre 2023 e 2025 para as Delegacias de Defesa da Mulher e para a Secretaria de Política para as Mulheres, segundo dados compilados pela 

Agência Pública

.
















O governador de São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas, deixou de destinar R$ 35,7 milhões entre 2023 e 2025 para programas de proteção às mulheres.




“No ano passado, por exemplo, menos de 30% do recurso destinado ao enfrentamento da violência contra a mulher foi aplicado no estado. Ou seja, mais de 70% do que estava disponível não foi investido”, critica a vereadora.




Cássia explica que parte do alto índice de agressão à mulher em Caraguatatuba tem relação com o fato de a cidade ser muito desigual e violenta. O município também lidera o ranking da maior taxa de mortes violentas do estado, concentrando 17,6 mortes a cada 100 mil habitantes, conforme dados divulgados pelo Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública. Os altos índices refletem as fragilidades estruturais e a desigualdade socioeconômica do município, acentuadas pela escassez de investimentos estatais e por um déficit histórico de políticas habitacionais e de infraestrutura pública, como analisa a vereadora.




“Se você pegar o mapa da violência em Caraguatatuba, vai ver que ela se concentra na região sul, onde vive mais de 50% da população, majoritariamente a classe trabalhadora. É a área onde os equipamentos públicos são mais ausentes e onde falta o braço do Estado para garantir direitos básicos, como moradia. Isso também impacta a violência – que recai sobre as mulheres.”




Procurada, a Secretaria de Segurança Pública do Estado de São Paulo (SSP) afirma que, assim como a Delegacia da Mulher, a Sala DDM permite registrar ocorrências, solicitar medidas protetivas e receber orientações, prezando por um atendimento em ambiente reservado, com sigilo e escuta qualificada. A instituição destaca o aumento das prisões em flagrante por violência doméstica e o crescimento dos investimentos em políticas para mulheres, mas não comenta porque quase R$ 36 milhões deixaram de ser investidos nos últimos quatro anos.




Em nota, a prefeitura de Caraguatatuba diz que o município segue os fluxos oficiais de notificação e conta com uma rede de proteção que integra serviços de assistência social, saúde e segurança pública, entre outros. Sobre a profissional mencionada por Alcione, informa que ela deixou de integrar a equipe da Delegacia de Defesa da Mulher (DDM) em julho de 2026. Por fim, reconhece que a existência de serviços não é suficiente para eliminar a violência e afirma que busca aprimorar os fluxos de atendimento, a integração entre os serviços e as ações de prevenção e proteção às mulheres.




Violência patrimonial




Na contramão da declaração de Cássia, Marília* teve uma experiência positiva quando buscou a delegacia de polícia do município para denunciar uma ameaça de feminicídio de seu marido.




Ainda jovem, se apaixonou por um homem mais velho vindo de uma família rica. Como prova de seu amor, na hora de assinarem os documentos oficializando o casamento, concordou com uma união com separação total de bens. O que ela viria a descobrir depois é que, junto da união, havia assinado também um acordo que eximia o parceiro de arcar com qualquer tipo de gasto relacionado a ela, nem mesmo gastos para alimentação.




Não demorou para se ver presa em um casamento pautado pelo dinheiro. Ao longo dos anos, dividida entre cuidar do filho e reformar os imóveis do marido sem qualquer remuneração, definhou em uma espiral depressiva.

 A situação se arrastou até o início do segundo semestre de 2026, quando ele se recusou a pagar um tratamento psicológico para Marília.




Para ajudá-la, o filho do casal, um adolescente de 17 anos, se prontificou a ir até o pai e convencê-lo a mudar de ideia. Depois desse encontro, Marília estranhou a insistência do menino para que a mãe não voltasse para casa. Inquieta, questionou o porquê até que o jovem falasse a verdade.




“Ele foi pra cima do meu filho, falando que, quando eu chegasse, ele daria uma facada em mim. Assim que ouvi aquilo decidi fazer o B.O [boletim de ocorrência]. Não tenho família para pedir ajuda, queria só que, caso ele me matasse, a polícia soubesse quem foi”.
















Uma cidade de contrastes: de um lado, lindas praias, de outro, recorde em violência contra a mulher




Na delegacia, mãe e filho foram encaminhados para atendimento psicológico e psiquiátrico, serviços que acessam até hoje. As consultas ajudaram Marília a entender que estava vivendo violência psicológica e patrimonial.




Contempladas pela Lei Maria da Penha desde sua criação em 2006, a violência psicológica e a patrimonial são reconhecidas como formas de violência doméstica. A violência psicológica caracteriza-se por condutas que causem dano emocional, diminuam a autoestima ou busquem controlar, limitar ou perturbar as ações, comportamentos, crenças e decisões da vítima. Atualmente, determinadas condutas dessa natureza podem configurar o crime autônomo de violência psicológica contra a mulher, previsto no o Código Penal, cuja pena é de reclusão de 6 meses a 2 anos e multa, salvo se o fato constituir crime mais grave.




Já a violência patrimonial consiste na retenção, subtração, destruição parcial ou total ou apropriação de bens, valores, documentos pessoais, instrumentos de trabalho, direitos ou recursos econômicos da mulher. Diferentemente da violência psicológica, não existe um único crime denominado “violência patrimonial”, de modo que a conduta praticada poderá configurar crimes diversos, como furto, apropriação indébita, dano ou estelionato. Ambas violências podem ser sofridas simultaneamente e, mesmo que a agressão física não ocorra, devem ser denunciadas.




‘O ideal seria o agressor sair imediatamente’




Além do amparo para a saúde mental, mãe e filho foram encaminhados para a Casa de Acolhimento Provisório. O espaço, criado em 2023, é destinado a mulheres em situação de violência sem risco iminente de morte, acompanhadas ou não de filhos menores de 18 anos. O acesso ocorre mediante encaminhamento da delegacia ou do CREAS (Centro de Referência Especializado de Assistência Social) e o tempo de permanência é de 15 dias podendo ser estendido por mais 15 dias. Dentro desse prazo, a vítima precisa encontrar uma nova casa.




Sônia Cordeiro, diretora da Divisão de Proteção Especial da Secretaria de Assistência Social de Caraguatatuba, conta que a moradia é o principal desafio no rompimento do ciclo da violência doméstica. “Elas vão para a casa de acolhimento porque o agressor continua no domicílio, mas não é uma residência permanente e muitas não possuem renda própria para irem para outro lugar. Hoje o Governo do estado oferece uma ajuda de R$ 500, mas é um valor baixo, não dá pra custear um aluguel”.




Jackeline esclarece que esses mecanismos são importantes, mas ainda se limitam a soluções primárias: “Não são o melhor para a mulher, mas é o melhor que podemos oferecer hoje. O ideal seria o agressor sair da casa imediatamente, deixando ela para a mulher e o filho. O Estado ainda oferece apenas o básico. É triste pensar que, para manter mulheres vivas, estamos ofertando apenas estratégias mínimas”.




Marilia e o filho voltaram a morar em uma das casas reformadas por ela. Sem renda, a mulher começou a trabalhar como motorista de aplicativo, mas ainda não ganha o suficiente para sustentar os dois.




“Muitas vezes eu saio desesperada pra trabalhar, pra comprar comida pro mesmo dia. O que mais me dói é ver meu filho vender os brinquedos que ele coleciona pra me ajudar a comprar nossas coisas. Ele podia continuar com o pai e ter tudo, mas preferiu ficar comigo comendo pão com mortadela”, diz, emocionada.




A medida que falha em proteger




Com o apoio das assistentes sociais, Marília foi até o Ministério Público solicitar uma medida protetiva de urgência. O promotor negou o pedido sob a alegação de que se ela não estava fisicamente machucada, não havia justificativa para a proteção.




“Eu falei pra ele: ‘Olha, eu preferia que o meu marido me espancasse e eu parasse num hospital, do que eu passar esses 20 anos de abuso psicológico, tomando vários remédios. Até suicídio eu tentei, porque não achava saída’. O que mata o ser humano é essa comparação. Como eu vou mensurar o tamanho da dor que cada mulher está sentindo?” Marília desabafa.
















Manifestação em São Paulo em comemoração dos 20 anos da lei Maria da Penha.




A segunda solicitação foi aceita. Agora, ela e o filho possuem uma medida protetiva provisória que vigora até novembro deste ano. Desde que foi concedida, o marido mudou-se para outra cidade. Com medo do que pode acontecer caso a medida não seja renovada, Marília vai semanalmente à Defensoria Pública pedindo uma atualização, mas voltava para casa com a mesma resposta.




“Toda vez é um estagiário diferente e eu tenho que contar a mesma história de novo e de novo. Isso já é violento. No fim, eles falam que eu tenho que esperar e que deveria voltar quando faltasse quinze dias pro prazo acabar. Eu e meu filho temos medo. Eu sei que ele tá esperando o prazo acabar pra vir atrás da gente”. Os únicos momentos em que Marília chora são ao falar do filho e do medo que tem do que o marido pode fazer contra os dois.




Em nota, a Defensoria Pública afirma que o atendimento a mulheres em situação de violência doméstica é considerado urgente e segue um protocolo que prevê o relato dos fatos uma única vez, para evitar a revitimização. As medidas protetivas são acompanhadas e, quando provisórias, é feito um agendamento do retorno antes que o prazo acabe, para reavaliar a situação de risco e adotar as providências necessárias à continuidade da proteção.




Em 2025, Alcione também conseguiu uma medida protetiva provisória que, na época, precisava ser renovada a cada dois meses. Assim que foi notificado sobre a proibição de aproximação, João passou a persegui-la. Em uma das vezes, entrou na casa de Alcione e tentou estuprá-la.




O agressor chegou a passar cinco meses preso, mas, assim que foi solto, retomou as tentativas de assédio. Cada invasão foi registrada pelas câmeras de segurança da casa e pelo acionamento do Botão do Pânico – aplicativo que aciona a Guarda Civil Municipal automaticamente. Nenhuma delas foi considerada no primeiro julgamento. Após duas audiências, João segue respondendo por seus crimes em liberdade.




“Eu estou revoltada, porque foi uma luta. Todas as vezes que ele ia lá, eu tinha que ir na delegacia, para mim também era humilhante. E hoje ele está solto sabendo que, provavelmente, não vai ter nada. Eu acredito que a justiça vai chegar”, Alcione diz, decidida.




Em 2025, para cada um dos 1.571 feminicídios no país, houve 2,7 tentativas de feminicídio e 84 descumprimentos de medidas protetivas de urgência foram registrados.

 Em números absolutos, o estado de São Paulo lidera as denúncias de tentativas de feminicídios – das 4.189 tentativas totais, 757 foram no estado – e fica em segundo lugar nos descumprimentos de medidas, com 22.820 casos, atrás apenas do Paraná, com 23.220 infrações.




Na visão de Jackeline, também falta, a nível nacional, um plano de reabilitação para os agressores: “A gente não tem um serviço de psicologia social voltado à readaptação desse homem violento para relações harmônicas e não patriarcais. Não basta esperar que a vítima saia da violência. A gente precisa responsabilizar o agressor para que novas violências não aconteçam”.




Caraguatatuba ainda enfrenta o problema estrutural de um governo que, há décadas, não volta seus olhos para as demandas da população feminina. É o que devende a vereadora: “São governos de direita que não enxergam esse tema como central na construção de uma sociedade. É a estrutura machista e patriarcal que se não conseguirmos romper, não vamos avançar. Temos que botar o pé na porta e falar: ‘É necessário olhar pra isso, porque precisamos seguir vivas”.




Onde buscar ajuda




Ligue 180 — Central de Atendimento à Mulher. Gratuito, 24 horas. Orienta sobre direitos, recebe denúncias e indica serviços de atendimento próximos. Também atende pelo WhatsApp: (61) 9610-0180. 




Ligue 190 — Em caso de emergência, risco imediato ou violência acontecendo naquele momento, acione a Polícia Militar. 




Delegacia da Mulher — Para registrar a ocorrência e solicitar medidas protetivas de urgência. Na ausência de uma delegacia especializada, busque uma delegacia de polícia. 




Casa da Mulher Brasileira e Centros de Referência (CRAM/CRAMS) — Oferecem acolhimento e podem reunir atendimento psicológico, social, jurídico e outros serviços da rede de proteção. 




Serviços de saúde — UBS, UPA e hospitais também podem acolher mulheres em situação de violência. Em casos de violência sexual, procure atendimento o quanto antes.

author: winter oak
title: Rallying the real anarchists!
content:
by Paul Cudenec, who reads the article 

here




The anarchist movement of which I became part in the 1990s was very much to my liking.




It took to the streets against the globalists and their summits, it fiercely defended nature against roadbuilding and other “development” and it was defiantly opposed to the plutocratic ruling class with all its exploitation, repression and warmongering.




Anarchists expressed themselves freely, clearly, angrily and often with a sharp sense of humour.




But, progressively, all of that changed.




Opposing globalist gatherings was deemed retrograde by many, nature was increasingly regarded as a suspect reactionary construct and the emphasis shifted to “critical whiteness” and “trans rights”.




Worst of all, the joy and humour seemed to drain completely away from the movement, being replaced by the dead-eyed and narrow-minded robotic dogmatism which I had always associated with the Marxist “left”.










I began to suspect that the anarchist scene had been deliberately infiltrated and corrupted by the ruling mafia in order to disarm it as a potential source of resistance.




This was confirmed for me six or seven years ago, initially by a general anarchist failure to call out the obvious 

fakery

 of the “climate” movement and then, of course, by the appalling collaboration with the Covid manoeuvre.




I first confronted this issue in an article entitled ‘Anarchists and the Coronavirus’, published on April 3 2020, which analysed a wide range of anarchist responses to the scamdemic.




I 

wrote

: “It seems that most fellow anarchists feel obliged to respect the prevalent social taboo. They insist that they are ‘not downplaying the seriousness of the COVID-19 pandemic’ and are anxious to distance themselves from the dreaded ‘conspiracy theorists'”.




I and others had already been accused of spreading “dangerous misinformation” by anarchists who nevertheless, at this stage anyway, continued to regard us as “comrades”.




By April 26 2020 the ongoing venom directed at me by so-called “anarchists” had totally confirmed what had been a somewhat tentative conclusion.










In ‘Anarchists against freedom’, I 

warned

: “People are attaching the anarchist label, and a sort of shallow parody of anarchist ideology, to something which is not anarchism at all.




“This pseudo-anarchist thinking has not grown from anarchist philosophy and therefore can never be anything but a replica anarchism, a zombie anarchism which appears to be the real thing but lacks the anarchist soul.




“This fake anarchism is the sworn enemy of true anarchism. By stealing the body of anarchism, it banishes real anarchism from the world”.




Following this revelation, I dug deeper and in February 2021 published a 

very detailed exposé

 showing exactly how the anarchist scene had been funded and thus manipulated by globalist “philanthropists” and their 

impact investment

 industry.




I remarked: “The sterile, divisive mindset they have been spreading on behalf of their corporate paymasters should be thrown on the scrapheap of ideological history, where it belongs”.




In recent years I have often referred to my position as being 

organic radicalism

, which is a broader philosophical concept than anarchism in that it includes non-anarchist thinkers.




But I also think it is important to maintain an understanding of

 

authentic anarchism and for that purpose I have set up a new Substack called 

Real Anarchists

.




Although some of my own posts will be shared on that site, the idea is not to present my particular philosophical vision – paradoxically, real anarchism could also be regarded as broader than organic radicalism!










Instead, the goal is to restore the notion of an anarchism that can embrace a wide range of perspectives while retaining an overall fundamental coherence.




This 

openness

 is central to the very character of true anarchism, which is not a set dogma but more like an 

existential attitude

 and it is this 

essence

 of anarchism which I seek to uphold.




I know full well that, historically, anarchism has not always reflected all my own beliefs – a blind faith in “science” and “progress” was very prevalent for a long time, for instance, and my interest in cultural rootedness is no doubt not shared by those anarchists who champion an internationalism that is hardly distinguishable from globalism.




But I would counter that anarchism is necessarily a call for decentralisation, not just down from the national-state level but down from that of the so-called “international community” and all its centralising infrastructure.




And if anarchists believe that societies can function perfectly well without government, that can 

only be

 because of the natural order that reigns in small and cohesive human communities.










The new blog will present both historical and contemporary anarchist content – I am not sure how it will evolve over time and I welcome any suggestions, submissions or constructive comments.




The aim is a long-term one and is not about creating some kind of new movement going by the name of “real anarchism”.




Indeed, success for the project would be that the “real” part of the term becomes redundant, because everyone now understands what actual anarchism is and is not.




The idea is to help conjure back into life the lost anarchist soul!

title: The Kurdistan Region’s experience of government – I
content:
The Kurdistan Region is facing the consequences of its failure to form a government on every front, as the balance of power in the Middle East is once again being tested and the region faces the prospect of major changes. Two political forces remain determined to secure their respective demands in the government formation process: the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK) and the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP). In this series, we look back at the history of government formation in the Kurdistan Region, beginning with its first government.




The Kurdistan Front after the Raperin uprising




Following the First Gulf War and the Raperin (uprising) of March 1991, the Iraqi government withdrew its administrative institutions from much of the region in October 1991, following United Nations Resolution 688 and the establishment of a no-fly zone north of the 36th parallel by the allied powers. The administrative vacuum left by the withdrawal was filled by the Kurdistan Front (Bereya Kurdistanê), marking the beginning of a period of de facto autonomy for the Kurds.




The Front was established in 1987–1988 by the KDP, PUK, the Kurdistan Democratic People's Party (KPDP) and the Kurdistan Socialist Party-PASOK (Kurdistan Democratic Independence Party). By 1992, it had developed into an eight-party umbrella organisation with the participation of the Iraqi Communist Party, the Kurdistan Toilers' Party, the Kurdistan Socialist Party (KSP) and the Kurdistan Islamic Movement. The Assyrian Democratic Movement was also among the Front's constituent organisations.




A committee established by the Front held negotiations with Baghdad over autonomy. Election Law No. 1, adopted on 8 April 1992, provided for the distribution of 100 parliamentary seats through proportional representation, with five additional seats reserved for Christian lists. An electoral threshold of 7 percent was introduced for the 105-seat parliament.




The KDP received 437,879 votes, securing 45.27 percent, while the PUK won 423,833 votes, or 43.82 percent. The Kurdistan Islamic Movement fell below the electoral threshold with 5.08 percent. The Kurdistan Socialist Party, the Iraqi Communist Party and the Kurdistan Democratic People's Party also failed to enter parliament.




Following the initial count, the KDP secured 51 seats and the PUK 49. However, objections led to the KDP relinquishing one seat, leaving the parliament evenly divided, with 50 seats for each party. The region was governed by an eight-member Presidential Council comprising four representatives from each party. Parliament convened on 4 June 1992, and Cewher Namiq Salim was elected its speaker.




By a majority vote, parliament adopted a decision defining relations with Baghdad on the basis of a “federal union within a democratic and parliamentary Iraq”. This decision would become the first document establishing the federal status later enshrined in the 2005 Iraqi Constitution.




First cabinet: 1992–1993




The first cabinet, formed by Fuad Masum of the PUK, received a unanimous vote of confidence from parliament in Erbil (Hewlêr) on 4 July 1992. The post of prime minister was allocated to the PUK, while the deputy premiership went to the KDP. Of the 15 ministries, six were allocated to each party. The Iraqi Communist Party, the Assyrian Democratic Movement and an independent representative received one ministry each.




The cabinet had no foreign affairs or defence ministries. The Minister of Peshmerga Affairs effectively served as defence minister. Ankara, Tehran and Baghdad did not recognise the government. The post of justice minister remained vacant when the cabinet was announced. Two notable features of the first government were the appointment of poet Şêrko Bêkes as culture minister and Kafiye Süleyman's position as the only woman in the cabinet.




Second cabinet: 1993–1996




The cabinet formed by Kosret Resul Ali of the PUK, who was elected prime minister in April 1993, received a vote of confidence on 25 April 1993. The distribution of ministries between the parties remained unchanged, except for the Ministry of Justice, which was allocated to the Kurdistan Unity Party.




Clashes and the division of the region




Clashes between the KDP and PUK began on 1 May 1994. The joint government effectively collapsed when the PUK took control of Erbil in 1994. The KDP captured Sulaymaniyah (Silêmanî) on 9 September, while the PUK recaptured the city on 13 October 1996.




The region was subsequently divided into two administrative areas. Erbil and Duhok came under KDP control, while Sulaymaniyah and Germiyan were controlled by the PUK. Despite numerous negotiations between the parties, a unified administration could not be established until 2006. Throughout this period, the region continued to operate under a dual-administration system.




Third cabinet: 1996–2006




Erbil administration (KDP, 1996–1999):

 The KDP established its own cabinet under Roj Nuri Şaweys in September 1996 after taking control of Erbil. As most PUK parliamentarians did not attend, parliament continued to convene in Erbil with 67 of its 105 members.




Sulaymaniyah administration (PUK, 1996–1999):

 Following the division of the region into two distinct administrative areas, the PUK maintained its government in Sulaymaniyah under Kosret Resul Ali. The administration governed a population of 1,442,797. Jalal Talabani subsequently appointed Barham Salih as prime minister in place of Kosret Resul through Decree No. 9, issued on 20 January 2001.




Fourth cabinet: 2001–2006




Erbil administration (KDP, 1999–2006):

 Nechirvan Barzani's 23-member cabinet received parliamentary approval on 21 December 1999. The cabinet governed the Erbil-Duhok area, which had a population of 1,868,391.




Sulaymaniyah administration (PUK, 2001–2004):

 Jalal Talabani appointed Barham Salih as prime minister in place of Kosret Resul through Decree No. 9 of 20 January 2001. Salih headed a 19-member cabinet. He subsequently moved to Baghdad on 28 June 2004 to serve as Iraq's deputy prime minister. The Sulaymaniyah administration remained under PUK control between 2004 and 2006.




The reunification period: 2002–2006




Party leaders Barzani and Talabani met in Shaqlawa (Şeqlawa) on 8 September 2002 and established four joint committees. Parliament convened for a joint session in Erbil on 4 October of the same year. Twenty-nine new parliamentarians, including 28 from the PUK and one from the KDP, were sworn in. Parliament was thus reconstituted with 51 KDP members, 49 PUK members and five Assyrian-Chaldean representatives.




In the Iraqi elections held on 30 January 2005, the Kurdistan Democratic Patriotic Alliance, comprising the KDP, PUK and several other parties, won 25.73 per cent of the vote and secured 75 of the 275 parliamentary seats. Jalal Talabani was sworn in as President of Iraq on 7 April 2005.




Parliamentary elections were held in the Kurdistan Region on the same day, with 111 seats contested. The KDP won 40 seats, the PUK 38, the Kurdistan Islamic Union (Yekgirtû Islami) nine, the Kurdistan Islamic Group (Komele) six and the Toilers' List one. Parliament convened on 4 June 2005. Masoud Barzani was elected President of the Kurdistan Region in a vote held on 12 June 2005.




An agreement signed by the two parties during an extraordinary parliamentary session in Erbil on 21 January 2006 allocated the first term as prime minister to the KDP and the parliamentary speakership to the PUK. The agreement provided for the two positions to rotate between the parties after two years. The KDP and PUK each received 11 ministries, while the remaining ministries were allocated to other parties.




The parties also agreed to merge the separate ministries of interior, finance, justice and peshmerga affairs established by the two administrations within one year. However, the merger was not completed until 2009. The structure of the peshmerga forces, which remained affiliated with the two parties, continued until September 2026.




Fifth cabinet: 2006–2009




The first unified cabinet received a unanimous vote of confidence from all 111 parliamentarians on 7 May 2006. Newşirwan Mustefa, who left the PUK in 2006, contested the parliamentary elections held on 25 July with the Gorran Movement. In its first election, Gorran secured 23.72 per cent of the vote and won 25 seats. The joint Kurdistan List formed by the KDP and PUK received 57.37 per cent of the vote, with its representation falling to 59 seats, including 30 for the KDP and 29 for the PUK.




Masoud Barzani won the regional presidential election, held by direct popular vote on the same day, with 69.6 per cent of the vote.




Sixth cabinet: 2009–2012




The premiership passed to the PUK in accordance with the agreement between the two parties. Masoud Barzani tasked Barham Salih with forming a government on 30 September 2009. Salih's cabinet received a vote of confidence on 26 October 2009. Barham Salih reduced the number of cabinet members from 42 to 21, forming a government composed of representatives from the KDP and PUK.




Seventh cabinet: 2012–2014




The premiership returned to the KDP, with Nechirvan Barzani elected prime minister on 17 February 2012. His cabinet received a vote of confidence on 5 April 2012 and was sworn in the following day. The PUK and KDP, which held a parliamentary majority, passed Law No. 19 on 30 June 2013. The law extended Masoud Barzani's term as President of the Kurdistan Region, which was due to expire on 20 August 2013, until 19 August 2015.




In the elections held on 21 September 2013, the KDP won 38 seats, the Gorran Movement 24 and the PUK 18. The Kurdistan Islamic Union (Yekgirtû) secured 10 seats, while the Kurdistan Islamic Group (Komele) won six. Four opposition parties also entered parliament with one seat each. Turkmen and Assyrian-Chaldean representatives secured five reserved seats each, while Armenians received one reserved seat.




Eighth cabinet: 2014–2019




Government formation negotiations continued for eight months following the elections. The five parties holding a parliamentary majority agreed to allocate the premiership and Ministry of Interior to the KDP, the parliamentary speakership and the ministries of Peshmerga Affairs and Finance to the Gorran Movement, and the deputy premiership to the PUK. The cabinet was sworn in on 18 June 2014.




ISIS captured Mosul in June 2014. On 3 August 2014, KDP peshmerga forces stationed in Shengal withdrew from the area, and ISIS launched its genocide against the Yazidis. Thousands of Yazidis were massacred, while women and children were abducted.




The KDP accused the Gorran Movement of responsibility for attacks in which KDP offices were set on fire during protests over salaries in October 2015 and announced that it no longer recognised the parliamentary speaker. Ministers were prevented from entering their ministries and were replaced by other appointees. The Gorran Movement declared that appointments made without consulting parliament were illegitimate. Parliament did not convene between October 2015 and 15 September 2017.




The Gorran Movement and Komele formally withdrew from the government on 20 December 2017 amid renewed protests over salaries in Sulaymaniyah. The eighth cabinet subsequently continued as a KDP-PUK government until 2019.




Ninth cabinet: 2019–present




Masrour Barzani's cabinet, comprising representatives from the KDP, PUK, Gorran Movement, Turkmen community and Christian community, received a vote of confidence on 10 July 2019. Vala Ferid of the KDP was elected the first woman speaker in the history of the Kurdistan Parliament on 18 February 2019. She was succeeded by  Rewaz Faiq of the PUK on 11 July 2019. The PUK began boycotting Council of Ministers meetings on 26 October 2022. The boycott ended on 14 May 2023 following a meeting between Masrour Barzani and Qubad Talabani. The Gorran Movement decided to withdraw from the government on 10 October 2024.




The Kurdistan Parliament extended its term by one year in October 2022. Elections were postponed four times, with dates set for 1 October 2022, 18 November 2023, 25 February 2024 and 10 June 2024. On 30 May 2023, Iraq's Federal Supreme Court ruled that the extension of parliament's term was unconstitutional, invalidating all parliamentary proceedings conducted during the extended period. As parliament had also lost its authority over the electoral commission, the elections were administered by Iraq's Independent High Electoral Commission. A further ruling by the same court divided the Kurdistan Region into four electoral constituencies: Erbil, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok and Halabja. The ninth cabinet's four-year term expired on 10 July 2023.




In the next part of this series, we will examine the deadlocks encountered in previous government formation processes and the latest electoral process.

author: CNT Madrid
title: Recomendaciones de cara a la huelga del 11N en el sector de la comunicación
content:
Como seguramente sepas a estas alturas, la clase trabajadora de este país está convocada a una 

huelga general el próximo 11 de noviembre

. CNT es una de las organizaciones convocantes del paro con el lema 

‘Bajemos los alquileres, subamos los salarios’

.




Por otro lado, en nuestro sector, el de los medios de Comunicación (Prensa, televisión, radio, publicidad…) se dan una serie de particularidades que pueden generar dudas entre quienes formamos parte de él y queremos participar de manera activa en la jornada de paro y movilización, por lo que desde la 

sección de Prensa y Comunicación de CNT

 queremos compartir algunas cuestiones básicas:




1. Tradicionalmente en prensa escrita de periodicidad diaria, la huelga se legalizaba para el día anterior a la general:    los redactores no escribían nada para la edición del día siguiente, las rotativas no imprimían… El día de huelga que amanecía sin prensa en la calle ya era sinónimo de éxito. Hoy, con el papel como algo testimonial y los periodistas realizando su trabajo para la edición online o papel indistintamente, ese acto forma ya parte del pasado y 

la huelga se convoca para todo el sector a partir de las 0:00 horas del día 11 de noviembre.




2. 

Los servicios mínimos no son aplicables a los medios privados y no se pueden imponer

. Se 

podrán fijar sólo en medios de titularidad pública

 y bajo condiciones muy estrictas, amparando el derecho de la ciudadanía a la información. 

Pero, en todo caso, deberán ser negociados con Comité de Huelga o la representación de los y las trabajadoras en cada centro de trabajo o los sindicatos convocantes en cada empresa.




3. Emitir programas enlatados o de catálogo por parte de radios, televisiones, etc es legal, pero 

adelantar grabaciones de programas que suelen ser en directo con el objetivo de contrarrestar el efecto de la huelga es ilegal.




4. 

No tenemos obligación de comunicar a la empresa si vamos a secundar la huelga

; Y si estoy acogiéndome a mi derecho a parar, 

mi puesto no puede ser ocupado por nadie

, tampoco a través de personal externo contratado para ese objetivo.; es ilegal.




5. Finalmente, 

cualquier acción de la empresa dirigida a

 

disimular o minimizar el paro

 estará atentando contra el derecho de huelga y 

es por tanto denunciable,

 por lo que recomendamos documentar esa actuación.




Si tienes más dudas, consulta nuestras 

preguntas frecuentes sobre el derecho a la huelga

. Y ante cualquier duda adicional, 

contacta con nosotr@s a través del correo: prensa_medios@madrid.cnt.es







La entrada 

Recomendaciones de cara a la huelga del 11N en el sector de la comunicación

 se publicó primero en 

CNT de Madrid

.

Recomendaciones de cara a la huelga del 11N en el sector de la comunicación

 se publicó primero en 

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

title: Putin'den Avrupa'ya savaş uyarısı: “Kazanan olmayacak”
content:
Rusya Devlet Başkanı Vladimir Putin, Avrupa ile olası bir savaşın sonuçlarının yıkıcı olacağını belirterek böyle bir çatışmada kazanan tarafın olmayacağını söyledi. Moskova’da düzenlenen Rusya-Afrika Zirvesi’nin ardından Afrika Birliği Dönem Başkanı ve Burundi Devlet Başkanı Evariste Ndayishimiye ile ortak basın toplantısı düzenleyen Putin, Avrupa ülkelerinin 2030’a kadar Rusya ile savaşa hazırlanma yönündeki açıklamalarını değerlendirdi.

Putin, “Biz her şeyden önce hazırız ancak Avrupa ile herhangi bir savaş istemiyoruz. Eğer isteyen varsa hazırlansın” dedi. Batılı ülkelerin Rusya’ya stratejik yenilgi yaşatma hedeflerine ulaşamadığını savunan Putin, bu hedefin 2030’a kadar gerçekleştirilmesinin de mümkün olmadığını ileri sürdü.

Avrupa ile olası bir savaşın sonuçlarına ilişkin konuşan Putin, “Eğer işler çok ileri giderse hiçbir kazanan olmayacak. Bunu kimse unutmasın” ifadelerini kullandı.

Rusya’nın Birinci ve İkinci Dünya Savaşlarından ders çıkardığını söyleyen Putin, benzer çatışmaların yeniden yaşanmaması için çaba gösterdiklerini belirtti.

Putin, Finlandiya Cumhurbaşkanı Alexander Stubb ve Norveç Başbakanı Jonas Gahr Store ile yaptığı telefon görüşmesine de değindi. İki liderin Moskova ile doğrudan temas kurmasını olumlu değerlendiren Putin, Avrupa ülkeleriyle ilişkilerin yeniden kurulmasına yönelik adımları desteklediklerini söyledi.

Putin, Baltık Denizi’ndeki deniz ulaşımına yönelik kısıtlamaların da yeni gerilimlere yol açabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Rusya’nın bölgede seyrüseferin engellenmesini istemediğini belirten Putin, iletişim ve ulaşımın kısıtlanmasının Basra Körfezi ve Hürmüz Boğazı’ndaki duruma benzer bir tablo yaratabileceğini ifade etti.

Rusya’nın herhangi bir meydan okumaya karşılık vereceğini söyleyen Putin, buna karşın Baltık Denizi’nde gerilim istemediklerini kaydetti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Encamên hilbijartinên Îsraîlê aşkere bûn
content:
Komîsyona Navendî ya Hilbijartinan a Îsraîlê encamên dawî yên hilbijartinên parlamentoyê aşkere kirin. Rêjeya beşdariyê vê carê li gorî serdemên berê gihişt asta herî bilind. Rêjeya beşdariyê ji sedî 77,9 bû.




Di hilbijartinan de hevpeymaniya bi serkêşiya Benjamin Netanyahu li gorî qonaxa berê hijmareke mezin a kursiyan ji dest da. Binketê vê hilbijartinê hevpeymaniya Netanyahu bû.




Her wiha ti hevpeymaniyek ango partiyek nekarî piraniya pêwîst a ji bo avakirina hikûmetê bi dest bixe. Ji bo avakirina hukumetê 61 kursî pêwîst e.




Dabeşbûna

 

120

 

kursiyan




Li gorî daneyên fermî yên komîsyonê, 5 milyon û 716 hezar û 665 dengder beşdarî dengdanê bûn.




Kursiyên partiyan ên li parlamentoyê bi vî awayî dabeş bûn:







Likud: 27 kursî




Yaşar: 21 kursî




Biyaxad: 12 kursî




Lîsteya Hevbeş: 11 kursî




Demokrat: 8 kursî




Raam: 8 kursî




Îsraîl Beytenu: 7 kursî




Cihûtiya Tevratê ya Yekgirtî: 7 kursî




Otzma Yehudît: 7 kursî




Şas: 6 kursî




Siyonîzma Olî: 6 kursî







Eniya Netanyahu li bin ket




Li gorî van encaman, eniya Netanyahu bi bidestxistina 53 kursiyan rastî binketineke mezin hat. Eniya Netanyahu di serdema borî ya parlamentoyê de xwediya 68 kursiyan bû.




Li hemberî vê, eniya li dijî Netanyahu 48 kursî bi dest xistin.




Partiyên Ereban (Lîsteya Hevbeş û Raam) jî 19 kursî bi dest xistin. Partiyên Ereban bi vê encamê serkeftineke dîrokî û mezin tomar kir. Vê carê kursiyên Ereban li gorî hilbijartina berê nêzîkî du qatan zêde bûn.




Eniya li dijî Netanyahu bi kursiyên partiyên Ereban dikare bi hêsanî hikûmetê ava bike. Lê belê piraniya partiyên mixalefetê razî nînin ku bi Ereban re hevalbendiyê bikin.




Komîsyona Hilbijartinan ew gotegot red kirin ku behsa sextekariyeke berfireh an jî midaxeleya Qeterê dikirin. Birêvebirê Giştî yê biwekalet ê komîsyonê Din Livni li ser mijarê daxuyaniyek da.




Livni got, "Ew raporên ku hatine belavkirin bi temamî bêbingeh in û lêkolîn dê ti bandorê li ser encamên dawî nekin."



















Encamên destpêkê yên hilbijartinên Îsraîlê




28 Cotmeh 2026










Encamên fermî dê Çarşemê radestî Serokkomarê Îsraîlê Isaac Herzog werin kirin. Piştî wê yekê Herzog dê bi serokên partiyan re bicive da ku pêşniyarên wan wergire. Ev pêşniyar dê li ser diyarkirina wî kesî bin ku dê ji bo avakirina kabîneya nû bê erkdarkirin.




Herzog hişyarî da partiyên siyasî û daxwaz kir ku bi "mêjiyekî vekirî" dan û standinan bikin. Armanca vê ew e ku welat tûşî xûleke din a hilbijartinê nebe.




Li aliyê din, Netanyahu û Gadi Eisenkot her yek ji wan rijd e ku dê bibe serokwezîrê bê.




Parlamentoya nû ya Îsraîlê dê 10ê Mijdarê sonda yasayî bixwe.




(AY)




*Çavkanî: Rûdaw, AA

title: Apple'ın OpenAI'a açtığı ticari sır davasının tarihi belli oldu
content:
Fotoğraf: Laurenz Heymann/Unsplash

Apple'ın eski çalışanları Chang Liu ve Tang Yew Tan ile OpenAI ve io Products'a karşı açtığı davada duruşma takvimi belirlendi.

ABD Bölge Mahkemesi Hakimi Edward Davila, tarafların sunduğu takvimi değerlendirerek duruşmanın 19 Temmuz 2027'de saat 09.00'da yapılmasına karar verdi.

Mahkemenin belirlediği takvime göre tarafların duruşma öncesinde belge paylaşımı, delil toplama ve uzman raporlarına ilişkin işlemleri tamamlaması gerekiyor.

Belge paylaşımının büyük ölçüde 5 Şubat 2027'ye kadar, delil toplama sürecinin ise 12 Mart 2027'de tamamlanması öngörülüyor.

Apple, iki eski çalışanının şirkete ait gizli ürün ve teknoloji bilgilerini kötüye kullandığını ileri sürüyor. Şirket, söz konusu bilgilerin OpenAI'ın donanım geliştirme çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak amacıyla kullanıldığını iddia ediyor.

Davanın tarafları arasında eski Apple çalışanları Chang Liu ve Tang Yew Tan'ın yanı sıra OpenAI ve io Products da yer alıyor.

Tarafların iddia ve savunmaları, belge paylaşımı ve delil toplama süreçlerinin ardından mahkemede değerlendirilecek.

title: CHP'nin kurultayını iptal eden karara karşı başvuru hazırlığı: Yeni Parti, mutlak butlan kararını AİHM'e taşıyacak
content:
Ankara — Yeni Parti, CHP'nin 2023 Kurultayı'nı "mutlak butlan" gerekçesiyle iptal eden Ankara Bölge Adliye Mahkemesi 36’ncı Hukuk Dairesi'nin kararını AİHM’e taşımaya hazırlanıyor. Başvurunun kararın yarattığı hak ihlalleriyle ilgili olacağını belirten Yeni Parti kurmayları, “Anketlerde Türkiye'nin birinci partisi olarak devam eden CHP’yi, mutlak butlan kararıyla yüzde 2’lere düşürdüler. Ne farkı var kapatmaktan? Bu bir hak ihlalidir. Bu hakkı elbette biz arayacağız. Çünkü seçmen, ‘Bizim hakkımızı siz koruyun’ diyor. Hala birinci parti yapıyor. Bu başvuru CHP değil, Türkiye demokrasisi için bir başvuru olacak” dedi.

Ankara Bölge Adliye Mahkemesi 36'ncı Hukuk Dairesi, 21 Mayıs tarihli kararıyla CHP'nin 2023 Kurultayı'nı mutlak butlan gerekçesiyle iptal etmiş, önceki Genel Başkan Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu'nu Genel Başkanlığa getirmişti. Yeni Parti, bu karardan doğan hak ihlallerini Avrupa İnsan Hakları Mahkemesi’ne (AİHM) taşımaya hazırlanıyor. Başvuru için hafta başında bir hazırlık ekibi kurulduğunu belirten kurmaylar, konunun salı günü yapılan MYK toplantısında görüşüldüğünü ve hukuki süreçlere ilişkin bilgilendirme yapıldığını belirtti.

Mutlak butlan kararına karşı yapılan temyiz başvurusu, 17 Temmuz’da Yargıtay'a taşınmış, Yargıtay 3'üncü Hukuk Dairesi, 26 Temmuz’da kararı ön incelemeye almıştı. Kurmaylar AİHM başvurusu için Yargıtay’dan çıkacak kararı beklemeyeceklerini belirterek kararı AİHM’e taşımalarının gerekçelerini şöyle açıkladı:

“Mutlak butlan diye olmayacak bir kararla aslında sadece Yargıtay Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı’na ve Anayasa Mahkemesi’ne (AYM) tanınmış, bir siyasi partinin iç işleyişini düzenleyen, bir çeşit kapatma kararına imza attılar. Bu kararın hem siyaseten hem hukuken farklı okumaları var. 47 yıl sonra birinci parti olmuş CHP’nin yönetimini değiştirdiniz ve 13 yıl bir başarıya imza atmamış yönetimi geri getirdiniz. Delilsiz bir başvuru yaptınız ve bir yandan muhalefet partisini yüzde 2’lere indirdiniz. Bu aşamada yeni bir parti kuruluyor ve ana muhalefet partisi oluyor. Ama bu ana muhalefet partisi örneğin sandık görevlisi veremeyecek. Dolayısıyla AİHM'e gidilmesinin aslında temel sebeplerinden bir tanesi hukuki değil siyasidir. Burada hak ihlali var. Hak ihlali dediğimiz şey sadece kişinin özgürlüğünden alıkonulması değil, bu da bir hak ihlali. Hem de Anayasa ile tanımlanmış siyasi partilere yönelik bir hak ihlali. Dolayısıyla en temel sebeplerden bir tanesi bu.”

Kurmaylar, “Karar, AİHM’e taşınmadan önce iç hukuk yollarının tüketilmesi gerekli mi” sorusunu da yanıtladı. Konu hakkında iki farklı görüş olduğunu belirten kurmaylar, şöyle konuştu:

“Neticede AİHM'in vereceği karar, sonucu etkilemeyecek. Biz şimdi Yeni Parti’nin kurultay başvurusunu yapacağız. 14-15 Kasım'da kurultayı yaptıktan sonra, altı ay geçmesini bekleyeceğiz seçim yeterliliği için. Bu süreçte bir erken seçim olması durumunda Yeni Parti seçime giremeyecek. Bu da bir hak ihlali baktığınızda. Yani dolayısıyla CHP'ye verilmiş mutlak butlan kararı, aslında Türkiye'de sadece CHP değil, siyasi partilerin hepsini etkileyecek bir hak ihlali. Bizim AİHM başvurumuz tam anlamıyla bu kapsamda olacağından iç hukuk yollarının tüketilmesi gerektiğini düşünmüyoruz. Tabii AİHM'in de düşündüğü kıymetli. Geçmiş kararları araştırdığımızda iki farklı görüş var: İç hukuk yollarının tüketilmesi gerektiğini düşünen ekip de var, düşünmeyen de var.”

Kurmaylar, kararı AİHM’e taşımanın “mutlak butlan kararını gündemde tutmak” ve “CHP’yi geri bırakamamak” şeklinde eleştirilmesine yönelik olarak da şunları söyledi:

"Bu karar, Türkiye demokrasisine vurulan bir darbe. Geçmişte parti kapatılıyordu. Onu da böyle nitelendiriyorduk. Kapatmakla partinin yönetimini değiştirmek arasında nasıl bir fark var? Teknik olarak da yok, siyasi olarak da fark yok. Anketlerde Türkiye'nin birinci partisi olarak devam eden CHP’yi, mutlak butlan kararıyla yüzde 2’lere düşürdüler. Ne farkı var kapatmaktan? Dolayısıyla bu CHP’yi geri bırakamamak değil, Türkiye demokrasisi için hak aramaktır. Bugün CHP’ye, yarın başka bir partiye yapılır bu. Mahkemelerin böyle bir yetkisi yok. Bu yetki Anayasa ile sadece AYM ve Yargıtay Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı’na tanınmış. Dolayısıyla ‘CHP’yi geri alalım’ gibi bir motivasyonla değil, Türkiye demokrasisi için hak aramak amacıyla hareket ediyoruz. Bu hakkı elbette biz arayacağız. Çünkü seçmen, ‘Bizim hakkımızı siz koruyun’ diyor. Hala birinci parti yapıyor. Mesele partinin isimlerinden daha ziyade seçmenin kimi yetkilendirmeye niyet ettiği meselesidir. Seçmen şu anda bizi yetkilendirmeye niyetli, biz de o seçmen için hak arıyoruz. Bu CHP değil, Türkiye demokrasisi için bir başvuru olacak."

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.
