title: YJA Star guerrillas: Martyr Bêrîtan is the torch of our struggle
content:
Every year on 25 October, fighters following in the footsteps of Martyr Bêrîtan (Gülnaz Karataş) commemorate the anniversary of her action against the line of betrayal in the free mountains. The date also marks the founding of the women's army. For this reason, guerrillas, particularly women guerrillas, mark the day with great enthusiasm. Guerrillas of the Free Women's Units (YJA Star) shared their feelings on the 34th anniversary of Bêrîtan Hêvî's martyrdom.




YJA Star guerrilla Elefterya Gabar Cizîr began by commemorating Martyr Bêrîtan with respect: “Comrade Bêrîtan became a pioneer and symbol of freedom for us. She understood the reality of Abdullah Öcalan's leadership. She became an example for us and for all women. Comrade Bêrîtan recognised the reality of free women, rebelled against the mentality of betrayal and refused to surrender. Many years may have passed, but she left us a legacy of resistance. That is why we commemorate Comrade Bêrîtan every year. She became a symbol of the will and resistance of free women. Through Martyr Bêrîtan, we came to recognise the will of free women. Through her, we came to understand our own reality. Bêrîtan's personality and action shattered the sexist mentality that underestimated women's strength. This gave us tremendous morale and spiritual strength. Thanks to those martyrs, we came to understand what real life means and the path of free women.







 







If women today have recognised their own strength and risen up, it is thanks to those pioneers. If women continue to take their place in the fields of struggle today, it is thanks to the efforts of the martyrs and Abdullah Öcalan. Abdullah Öcalan gave us strength and created the conditions for women to recognise their own will and take a leading role in society. Women have always played a pioneering role in guerrilla life and struggle as well. Great resistance has been waged in those mountains under the leadership of free women. Comrade Bêrîtan has always been an example for us. We will always struggle to develop ourselves along Bêrîtan's path, strengthen our struggle and fulfil her dreams.”




‘We will always follow Bêrîtan's path’




Guerrilla Bişeng Brûsk Vejîn also commemorated all the martyrs of the revolution through Martyr Bêrîtan and continued: “We must always commemorate Comrade Bêrîtan and introduce her to all women. When we look at the history of the freedom struggle, we see the pioneering role played by Comrade Bêrîtan. As women guerrillas in particular, we strive to follow in her footsteps. We will always take her path as our guiding principle because she is our pioneer and heroic commander. It is a great privilege for us to struggle along Bêrîtan's path and commemorate her in the free mountains today. Comrade Bêrîtan rejected surrender and carried out an action in which she put her life on the line against the path of betrayal. She is the pioneer and torch of our struggle. The existence of women who seek freedom and keep Bêrîtan's name alive today is extremely valuable to us. As those who follow in Comrade Bêrîtan's footsteps, we are striving to develop ourselves along her path and take determined steps forward.”

title: KRG Interior Ministry opposes Shengal integration, calls for implementation of 9 October Agreement
content:
On 26 October 2026, a ceremony was held in Shengal attended by YBŞ-YJŞ fighters and officials from the Iraqi Federal Government. During the ceremony, it was announced that 4,165 members of the YBŞ-YJŞ would be integrated into the federal security system.




The Yazidi community welcomed the move, expressing satisfaction that the Iraqi state had recognised Shingal’s defence forces. They also stated that Yazidi rights should be recognised in the Iraqi Constitution in the future.




On Tuesday night, the Kurdistan Region’s Ministry of Interior issued a statement calling for a return to the 9 October 2020 Agreement, which was signed in partnership between the KDP, the Turkish state and then-Prime Minister Mustafa al-Kadhimi, under the supervision of the United Nations.




The agreement stated that the Yazidi community should not have its own defence force and proposed the dissolution of the YBŞ, YJŞ and Êzidxan Asayish forces, which had been established to protect the population during the days of the 

ferman

 (the term used by Yazidi to refer to genocidal persecution and massacres).




The Yazidi community rejected the agreement, describing it as a new attempt at genocide and stating that it disregarded their will.




In yesterday’s statement, the Ministry of Interior said that all agreements concerning Shengal should be made with due regard to the will and demands of its population. However, the statement overlooked the fact that the members of the YBŞ-YJŞ are Yazidis who live in Shengal.

title: History repeats itself for the Turkish state
content:
The Justice and Development Party (AKP) government has recently been forming a number of alliances. While the AKP and the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) defend these agreements, the opposition has criticised them. Various reasons have been put forward to explain these alliances. However, given that they involve the Middle East and its surrounding region, the first question that comes to mind is their connection to war. Military historians define war as the continuation of politics by other means. From this perspective, it is clear that these alliances risk drawing Turkey into the war in the Middle East.




In fact, the alliance with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan has already drawn Turkey into the war. According to incoming reports and assessments, Turkey has become involved in the ongoing war in Yemen. The Turkish state has sent its armed drones and the specialists who operate them to Saudi Arabia, from where attacks are being carried out against the Houthis in Yemen. As is known, the Houthis are supported by Iran. Turkey has therefore effectively entered into a war with Iran. On the one hand, it claims to oppose the war being waged by the United States and Israel against Iran, while on the other, it is waging war against the Houthis in Yemen.




Turkey is trying to play every possible side to suit its own interests. By participating in the war against the Houthis, it has placed itself in an anti-Iranian position. The Houthis are also enemies of Israel. Turkey has therefore effectively adopted a position favourable to Israel. Supporting Iran while acting against it, appearing to oppose Israel while pursuing policies that favour it! Turkey is pursuing a policy riddled with such contradictions. To use a familiar expression, it has recently been pressing every button. It is well known that those facing difficulties and crises resort to trying everything. Turkey believes that it can salvage something by acting this way, but in reality, it is gambling.




Neither Iran will forget Turkey's position nor will Israel begin to view Turkey favourably simply because it has attacked Yemen. Turkey's apparent opposition to the war against Iran is entirely connected to its hostility towards the Kurds. It opposes the war because it believes the Kurds could benefit from it. Indeed, when Devlet Bahçeli calls on the Kurdistan Free Life Party (PJAK) to lay down its arms, he is expressing hostility towards the Kurds rather than concern for Iran. Iran knows very well that, despite Turkey's approach, Ankara ultimately wants Iran to be weakened. Turkey believes that a weaker Iran would allow it to become more influential in the region.




By forming an alliance with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, Turkey is not merely positioning itself against Iran. It is also antagonising India. India, like China, is emerging as a rising power. India also maintains strong relations with Israel. There is a considerable possibility that Turkey's new alliance will leave it worse off than before, losing what it already has while pursuing something more.




It is well known that Enver, Talat and Cemal Pasha brought a devastating defeat upon the Ottoman Empire by entering the war alongside Germany, which they believed to be a powerful ally. The AKP government may be calculating that closer relations with Saudi Arabia will bring in petrodollars and enable it to overcome its economic problems. Yet the attraction of these petrodollars could drag Turkey into all kinds of disastrous situations. The alliances being formed demonstrate precisely this danger.




Every political alliance causes concern among certain states and political forces. The alliance with Qatar, Pakistan and Indonesia will unsettle not only India and Iran but also other countries. Turkey's agreement with Libya on maritime jurisdiction has already caused concern in Europe, Greece, Israel and Egypt. Antagonising Europe in this way will cost Turkey dearly. Egypt is already deeply dissatisfied with Turkey's policy towards Libya, and this dissatisfaction will now increase. Turkey has already antagonised Israel, Southern Cyprus and Greece. It has thus created further opposition on another front.




If war is the continuation of politics by other means, then the alliances Turkey is forming indicate that it is moving towards war.




Two years ago, faced with the war in the Middle East and the prospect of changing political balances, Turkey sought to end its war against the Kurdish Freedom Movement and protect itself from the dangers that might emerge. It pursued a policy of strengthening the domestic front as the Middle East was being reshaped. Indeed, the authorities consistently presented their involvement in the Peace and Democratic Society Process as an effort to strengthen the domestic front. Turkey now appears to have abandoned its policy of ending the war against the Kurds to avert these dangers. The state's failure to take any steps, despite the Kurdish Freedom Movement having taken every possible step, already indicates a change in policy. Its recent pursuit of alliances is a concrete expression of this shift.




The AKP and MHP government now appears to be seeking to overcome the threats it perceives in the Middle East through external alliances rather than by strengthening the domestic front. On the one hand, it is exerting pressure on forces opposed to it; on the other, it is sidelining the Peace and Democratic Society Process. In short, it is doing everything that could weaken the domestic front. This clearly shows that strengthening the domestic front is no longer its policy. Instead, it has adopted an approach based on suppressing domestic opposition through external alliances while seeking to counter threats from abroad.




The Ottoman Empire weakened and retreated in the face of the West during the 19th century because of internal conflicts, particularly those involving the Kurds. At the beginning of the 20th century, it gambled on an alliance with Germany and lost. The Turkish state is now repeating this historical experience. By refusing to accept the hand extended by the Kurds, it is making a historic mistake. The only way to rescue Turkey from this impasse is to take steps that will advance the Peace and Democratic Society Process. Turkey's future also depends on the policy it pursues in this regard.




Source: Yeni Yaşam newspaper

author: Unknown
title: Türkoğlu: We want to speak with disabled women, not for them
content:
The Women's Council and Disability Commission of the Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party), together with Bismil Municipality's Women's Policies Directorate and Disability and Elderly Services Unit, held a meeting with women in Bismil district of Diyarbakır (Amed) under the slogan "Disabled Women Exist Too".




The meeting was attended by DEM Party Women's Council Spokesperson Halide Türkoğlu, Disability Commission Co-Spokesperson Hatice Betül Çelebi and numerous women.







‘Ableist ideology deepens discrimination’




Halide Türkoğlu said at the meeting that disabled women faced inequality and discrimination due to both the male-dominated mentality and ableist ideology. She said that disabled women were being denied the right to make decisions about their own lives and participate in decision-making and governance processes, stressing that their problems and demands must be addressed directly with them.




Türkoğlu said: "We want to speak with disabled women, not on behalf of disabled women," and added that disabled women must be involved in decision-making processes and have control over their own lives. She said that genuine equality could only be achieved by recognising differences, bringing experiences together and leaving no woman behind.




‘Services are a responsibility, not a favour’




Türkoğlu said that disabled women faced the risk of violence and abuse and criticised the lack of inclusive policies concerning disability. She pointed out that responsibility for caring for disabled people was placed on women and that the financial support provided for care was inadequate.




Türkoğlu said that the state and local authorities were responsible for addressing the difficulties disabled people faced in education, healthcare, employment, transport, social life and political participation. She stressed that disabled people must be recognised as individuals with rights.




Türkoğlu said that the DEM Party would continue developing policies together with disabled women and other disabled people and would also push Bismil Municipality to develop policies on disability. She called for stronger collective struggle and organised solidarity to ensure that disabled women could lead equal, free and accessible lives.

author: Unknown
title: The AKP cannot function without war
content:
It is becoming increasingly clear with each passing day that the process initiated by Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan through his February 27, 2025 Call for Peace and Democratic Society amounts, in a sense, to a disruption of the established game. To the domestic and international powers that divided Kurdistan into four parts, imposed genocide on the Kurds, and have benefited from the Kurdish question and the contradictions and conflicts it has generated, the message was effectively: “I will not play the game you want and impose on me. I will play my own game.” In this way, Öcalan has challenged the politics of war and moved toward adopting a politics of peace.




This new strategy and policy developed by Abdullah Öcalan has undoubtedly shocked and bewildered the forces that have tied themselves to, and benefited from, the strategy of conflict arising from the Kurdish question. It appears that the AKP is among those most taken aback. Indeed, under present conditions, when Turkey’s interests and democratic future lie in a politics of peace, the AKP remains unable to break away from its entrenched politics of war and militarization. It has failed to respond positively as required to the peace process initiated by Öcalan. The steadily increasing violence, judicial repression, and police pressure across all areas of life in Kurdistan and Turkey are manifestations of this. By sending military equipment to Saudi Arabia for use against the Houthis in Yemen, preparing to deploy troops, and developing new military alliances in the region, the AKP demonstrates that it cannot function without war and is unable to abandon its politics of war.




As of October 29, the Republic of Turkey will have completed its 103rd year since its founding and will be entering its 104th year. If the period that began with the fascist military coup of September 12, 1980, is to be defined as the “Second Republic,” then the AKP’s quarter-century in power undoubtedly constitutes the central ruling force of this period. It could also be put this way: The “Second Republic” process initiated by the military junta headed by Kenan Evren found its true ruling power under Tayyip Erdoğan’s leadership. In other words, the “Second Republic” was shaped by the mentality of Kenan Evren and Tayyip Erdoğan. Its only difference from the First Republic was the incorporation of political Islam, which had previously been excluded from the state under the label of “reactionism,” into the state apparatus. Thus, the “Second Republic” continued and intensified its hostility toward the Kurds and communism.




Let us look back and recall this recent history. The Evren–Özal alliance, which laid the foundations of the September 12 regime, became the driving force behind this transformation of the Republic. It was primarily Turgut Özal who carried this forward, developing the political line inherited from Menderes and Demirel, albeit with cautious and hesitant steps. When the same Turgut Özal sought to pursue a similar approach toward the Kurds, however, that intention cost him his life. Necmettin Erbakan attempted to advance the process initiated by the Evren–Özal alliance, but his approach to the Kurdish question was also deemed unacceptable, and he was pushed aside. Having drawn the necessary lessons from all these developments, Tayyip Erdoğan became the most skillful and thorough practitioner of the mentality and policies of September 12.




Tayyip Erdoğan’s nearly quarter-century in power should also be examined in two distinct periods. During the first period, when he was still engaged in a fierce power struggle with the secularist forces of the Republic, he was compelled to forge both covert and overt alliances to consolidate his strength. To succeed in this struggle, he pursued a policy of presenting himself as generally “pro-peace.” Indeed, during this period, whenever elections approached, he requested a ceasefire from the PKK and secured electoral victories by ensuring that elections were held in an atmosphere of ceasefire. In the second period, after neutralizing the secularist forces within the Republic, he fully aligned himself with the Turkish Republic’s deeply entrenched anti-Kurdish and militaristic policies. He donned a military uniform and sought to fulfill the role of commander-in-chief. During this period, he undoubtedly adopted a strategy of winning elections by escalating both domestic and external conflicts.




In its current form, the state and the AKP government have merged and become fully integrated. Some intellectuals and politicians describe this situation as the “AKP State,” a characterization that is, in fact, not entirely inaccurate. Ultimately, the AKP State, having incorporated political Islam and operating in an environment where the socialist movement has also been weakened, has concentrated its entire militaristic orientation on the “war against the Kurds.” As a result, an AKP political strategy has emerged that feeds on this war and has tied its survival to it, regardless of Turkey’s overall trajectory. An AKP administration has thus taken shape that depends on the war against the Kurds for its existence and can easily sustain itself through it.




In recent years, however, two developments have disrupted this seemingly smooth course:




- The US-Israeli war plans and actions aimed at establishing a new hegemony in the Middle East have come to threaten Turkey’s future.




- The announcement of the peace and democratic society process, aimed at protecting Turkey from this threat and overcoming it.




Having become incapable of surviving without war, the AKP finds itself at an impasse, unable to find a way forward in the face of the peace and democratization process initiated by Abdullah Öcalan.




The AKP’s new political approach that has emerged under these circumstances is striking and must be properly understood. Notably, it makes no mention of peace or democracy. Instead, it employs a deceptive method that subsumes and effectively erases everything under the concept of a “Terror-Free Turkey,” devised by some of its advisers. Likewise, the steps involving a “Parliamentary Commission” and a “Framework Law” have become two magic wands shielding the AKP from the demands of the peace and democratic society process. By relying on these measures, the AKP creates the impression that it is doing everything necessary to advance the process, while in reality attempting to conceal its political stance, which fundamentally opposes peace and favors war. Above all, this deception must be clearly recognized and exposed.




It appears that the AKP government has sought to use the peace and democratic society process initiated by the Kurdish side as leverage against the United States and Israel, ultimately seeking to reach an agreement with them—or, more precisely, to surrender to them. Indeed, this surrender was realized at the NATO meeting held in Ankara in July. Through the “Mecca Agreement,” Turkey has now effectively joined the Abraham Accords in a covert manner, aligning itself with the US-Israeli war bloc as a means of ensuring its own survival. Thus, even if it does not engage in war domestically, it will seek to sustain and operate the war machine it has built by participating in conflicts abroad.




In fact, it cannot be said that the war within Turkey has come to an end either. Yes, since the ceasefire declared by the PKK on March 1, 2025, there have been no armed confrontations on the Kurdish front. Nevertheless, the AKP government has intensified economic, political, judicial, and police repression against the Kurds and Turkey’s society to such an extent that its actions have become far more destructive than armed warfare. In other words, it continues to expand and implement the seven-dimensional special warfare strategy outlined by İlker Başbuğ in 2009. Through the appointment of government trustees, it is attempting to seize control of almost all municipalities. It is imposing restrictions on the press reminiscent of the reign of Abdülhamid. It is said that the age of drug use in Kurdistan has fallen to as low as five. Prisons are overflowing, and even those who have served their full sentences are unable to secure their release. Prostitution, femicides, and other forms of pressure and violence against society have reached extraordinary levels.




According to a statement by Sezai Temelli, deputy parliamentary group chair of the DEM Party, military expenditure under the heading of “defense” has increased by 60 percent. While arming itself to such an extent, the AKP government simultaneously demands and expects complete disarmament from the Kurds. This contradictory approach—arming itself while demanding that the Kurds disarm—is troubling the minds of everyone living in Turkey today.




It is abundantly clear that the AKP cannot function or govern without war. The war machine it has built is spreading bloodshed and death all around it. Escalating violence against society and the opposition domestically, combined with participation in wars alongside the US-Israeli bloc internationally, forms the foundation of the AKP’s current policies. There must be no illusions about this. The AKP has long since abandoned the policy of transforming Turkey into an alternative model of life and society through peace and democratization. Instead, it has joined the world of US-Israeli hegemony, a world that destroys societies and nature. It is evident that Turkey can have no future under the current AKP government. Yet a Turkey without the AKP could be a much better place.




Source: Yeni Özgür Politika

author: Unknown
title: Fîlmê nû yê Behmen Qubadî li Festîvala Tokyoyê hate nîşandan
content:
Fîlma nû yê sînemagerê Kurd Behmen Qubadî yê bi navê "Trees Are Watching" li Festîvala Fîlman a Navneteweyî ya Tokyoyê hat nişandan. Piştî nîşandanê, derhêner Behmen Qubadî beşdarî rûniştineke pirs û bersivan bû û bersiva pirsên rexnegir û hezkirên sînemayê da.




Qubadî di rûniştinê de behsa sedemên têkçûna ekolojîk û bandora wê ya li ser derûniya mirovan kir.




Fîlma "Trees Are Watching" ku stêrka navdar a Hollywoodê Eva Green û lîstikvanê naskirî yê Tirkiyeyê Murat Yildirim tê de rolên sereke dilîzin, wekî fîlmekî "tirsa psîkolojîk" û wekî alegoriyeke ekolojîk balê dikişîne.




Bûyerên fîlmê Dar Dinêrin li bajarê Mêrdînê diqewimin. Çîroka nivîskarekê (Eva Green) û keça wê ya kerr vedibêje ku vegeriyane axa bav û kalan.




Li wir, ew rastî rûdanên seyr û bîranînên berê tên. Li herêmê, ji ber birîna daran xweza hatiye wêrankirin û tenê du dar wekî şahid mane.




Derhêner Behmen Qubadî di civînê de anî ziman ku dar û xweza ne tenê hûrgiliyên dîmenê ne lê di heman demê de ew şahidên zindî û bêdeng ên kiryar û trajediyên mirovahiyê ne jî.




Qubadî bal kişand ser metirsiya mezin a jinavbirina xwezayê û got ku sînemaya wî vê carê bi şêwazeke nû û bi hêmanên sosret peyameke tund dide kesên ku zererê didin jîngehê.




Piştgiriya Martin Scorsese ya ji bo projeyê




Yek ji xalên herî girîng ên ku di rûniştinê û medya navneteweyî de deng veda, piştgiriya derhênerê xwedî xelata Oscarê Martin Scorsese ya ji bo vî fîlmî bû.




Beşdariya Scorsese ya di projeyê de kelecaneke mezin di nav derdorên sînemayê yên cîhanî de çêkiriye û giraniya hunerî ya fîlmê Qubadî zêdetir kiriye.




Fîlmê ku beriya niha li Festîvala Fîlman a Navneteweyî ya Torontoyê (TIFF) cara yekem hatibû nîşandan, niha li Tokyoyê di beşa sereke de ji bo xelata herî mezin ketiye pêşbaziyê.




Festîvala Tokyoyê ya îsal dê heta 4ê Çiriya Paşîn a 2026an berdewam bike û sînemagerên herî navdar ên cîhanê bîne cem hev.




*Çavkanî: Rûdaw




(AY)

author: Kay Pacha / Equipo Pueblos Originarios del SERPAJ
title: Aucan Huilcaman; derribando la doctrina del descubimiento
content:
Así como difundimos informaciones de conflictos o de diversa índole, siempre relacionadas con el mundo indígena, en esta oportunidad queremos darle a conocer el testimonio de un hermano mapuche del Gulumapu, Chile, Aukan Huilcaman. Es una persona con mucha trayectoria y experiencia en defensa de los derechos indígenas y un importante protagonismo a nivel internacional.










https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Aucan-.mp3




https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Aucan-.mp3




Descargar audio




Ha participado en numerosos foros y encuentros internacionales, y últimamente lo hizo para analizar, junto con otros hermanos y hermanas, lo que se conoce como “Doctrina del Descubrimiento”, que es un principio legal y religioso que las potencias coloniales europeas utilizaron desde el siglo XV en adelante para justificar la exploración, la invasión, el despojo de tierras y la subyugación de los pueblos indígenas en América, África y Asia.







Esta doctrina está basada en una serie de bulas papales del siglo XV (como Dum Diversas en 1452, Romanus Pontifex en 1455 e Inter Caetera en 1493) emitidas en el contexto de la Era de los Descubrimientos. Y claro, en ese entonces, en esas bulas se  sostenía que las naciones cristianas europeas tenían derechos de soberanía y propiedad sobre cualquier territorio habitado por “no cristianos” en el momento en que un explorador europeo “descubría” esas tierras.







Asumía que los pueblos originarios no tenían derechos de propiedad legítimos ni soberanía sobre sus propios territorios debido a su condición de no cristianos o por considerarlos “no civilizados”, algo que con el tiempo, pasó del ámbito religioso al derecho internacional y civil.







Como dijimos, han habido varios encuentros analizando este tema y buscando estrategias para rebatir y eliminar esos conceptos que si bien se esgrimieron hace muchos años, sus consecuencias aún perduran.







En esta oportunidad Aukan participó en la conferencia internacional sobre el desmantelamiento de la doctrina del descubrimiento-terrorismo Maorí- en la ciudad de Roturua en el territorio de Aotearoa (Nueva Zelandia), del 1 al 18 de octubre de 2026.







Así que entonces escuchamos sus interesantes conceptos.




El Micro Kay Pacha se realiza con el apoyo de la organización Otto per Mille-Chiessa Valdense.




La entrada 

Aucan Huilcaman; derribando la doctrina del descubimiento

 se publicó primero en 

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

.

author: Unknown
title: Žižek’in “İmkansız Özne: Kürtler, Rojava ve Günümüz Komünizmi” isimli kitabı okurla buluştu
content:
Dünyaca ünlü kamusal entelektüel Slavoj Žižek’in 18 Nisan 2021’de Kobanê Üniversitesi’nin açılışı kapsamında düzenlenen “Demokrasi Hâlâ Bir Seçenektir” başlıklı konferansının deşifresi ve Türkçe çevirisi, Luvi Yayınları tarafından “İmkansız Özne: Kürtler, Rojava ve Günümüz Komünizmi” adıyla kitaplaştırıldı.




Binevş Güney’in deşifre ederek Türkçeye çevirdiği, gazeteci Osman Damla’nın da editörlüğünü yaptığı çalışma, Türkçe ve İngilizce edisyonlarıyla yayımlandı. 




Luvi Yayınları, kitabın sunuş kısmında çalışma hakkında şu bilgilere yer verdi. 




‘Kobanê yalnızca direniş değil, geleceğin de inşa pratiği’




Konferansın Kobanê’de yapılması, metne yalnızca Žižek’in katılımının ötesinde bir anlam kazandırıyor. Elektrik ve internet kesintileri, bağlantı sorunları gibi teknik aksaklıklar, düşüncenin; savaşın, yıkımın ve maddi imkânsızlıkların tam ortasında üretildiğini gösteriyor. Kobanê Üniversitesi’nin varlığı, yalnızca akademik bir kurumun açılışı değil; yıkımın ardından hayatı yeniden kurma iradesinin ifadesi olarak öne çıkıyor.




Žižek, Kürt meselesine yaklaşımında Kürtleri jeopolitik rekabetlerin edilgen kurbanları olarak görmek yerine, sınırlı da olsa kendi alanlarını açtıkları koşullarda toplumsal yaşamı yeniden örgütleme iradelerine odaklanıyor.




Rojava deneyiminin önemini, yalnızca direnişte değil, “nasıl bir gelecek inşa edileceği” sorusunu somut bir gerçekliğe dönüştürme biçiminde görüyor. Direnmek ile kurmak arasındaki ayrım vurgulanırken; insanların nasıl yaşayacağı, farklı kimliklerin nasıl bir arada bulunacağı gibi sorular gündeme getiriliyor.




Seçim sistemleri, liberal demokrasi krizi




Kitabın temel izleklerinden biri de Demokratik Konfederalizm olurken, Žižek, liberal demokrasinin krizini de tartışıyor. Sorunu yalnızca seçim sistemlerine veya parlamentoların işleyişine indirgemeyen düşünür, mevcut siyasi kurumların toplumsal hoşnutsuzluğu dile getirmekte yetersiz kaldığını belirtiyor. Bu krizin yalnızca “demokrasisi gelişmemiş” ülkelerde değil, Batı’nın yerleşik demokrasilerinde de yaşandığını vurguluyor. Parlamenter sistemi eleştirirken doğrudan demokrasiyi de romantize etmekten kaçınıyor; halkı tek ve homojen bir özne olarak görmüyor. Siyasetin, hazır bir halk iradesinin temsilinden ziyade ortak bir siyasi ufkun aktif biçimde inşa edilmesini gerektirdiğini savunuyor.




‘İyi yabancılaşma’




Liderlik tartışmasında Žižek, insanlara ne yapmaları gerektiğini buyuran otoriter bir figür yerine, kendi imkânlarını gösterebilen ve ortak bir gelecek fikrini görünür kılabilen bir liderlik anlayışını öne çıkarıyor. Abdullah Öcalan’ın rolü de bu çerçevede, emretmekten çok umut yaratma ve siyasal imkânı temsil etme kapasitesi üzerinden ele alınıyor. “İyi yabancılaşma” kavramıyla, özgürlüğün her karara sürekli katılım anlamına gelmediğini; su, elektrik, sağlık gibi kamusal hizmetlerin güvenilir işlemesinin de bir özgürlük alanı yarattığını belirtiyor.




Oryantalizm eleştirisi




Žižek, Batı popüler kültüründe Ortadoğu’yu ve Rojava’yı sürekli bir çılgınlık ve kaotik coğrafya olarak sunan oryantalist kalıpları da eleştiriyor. Kürtlerin şiddet ve kuşatma ortamında rasyonel, katılımcı ve kurucu bir toplumsal aklı hayata geçirdiğini savunuyor. Kapitalizm ile demokrasi arasındaki zorunlu birlik düşüncesini sorgulayan Žižek, kapitalizmin otoriter siyasal biçimlerle birlikte işleyebildiğini belirterek “otoriter kapitalizm” kavramını tartışmanın merkezine yerleştiriyor.




Komünizm tartışması: Yerel ve özgün bir deneyim olarak Rojava




“Komünizm” tartışması ise geçmişin devletçi modellerine dönüş çağrısı değil; su, enerji, sağlık, salgınlar ve küresel ısınma gibi ortak sorunların piyasa ilişkilerine bırakılamayacağını, ulusal sınırları aşan bir koordinasyona ihtiyaç duyulduğunu vurguluyor. Rojava’nın yerel ve özgül bir deneyim olmasının ötesinde daha geniş bir siyasal öneri üretip üretemeyeceği sorusu da gündeme geliyor. Devletsizlik meselesi ve Demokratik Konfederalizm’in felsefi önemi bu bağlamda öne çıkıyor.




‘Özgürlükten sonra ne yapacağız?’




Metin romantik bir ütopya anlatısı değil; jeopolitik dengeler, geçici ittifaklar ve siyasal pragmatizm gibi gerçekliklerin de altını çiziyor. Kobanê deneyiminin asıl anlamı, salt bir direniş sembolü olmanın ötesinde “sonrasının” sorgulanışı olarak belirginleşiyor. Demokrasi, liderlik, kadın özgürleşmesi, ekoloji, kapitalizm, devletsizlik ve toplumsal örgütlenme gibi meseleler bugün de yakıcı güncelliğini koruyor.




Kitabın bıraktığı temel soru şu: Bir halk, kendisine çizilmiş sınırların ve belirlenmiş geleceklerin dışına çıkarak kendi yaşamını kurabilir mi? Eğer mümkünse, bu yalnızca Kobanê’nin veya Kürtlerin sorusu değil; hepimizin önünde duran “Özgürlükten sonra ne yapacağız?” sorusudur.




(EMK)

author: Simon Childs
title: Far-Right Loser Flávio Bolsonaro Flees Brazil After Election Defeat
content:
Far-right presidential election loser Flávio Bolsonaro has fled Brazil and is on his way to Florida, allegedly to claim political asylum.




The defeated senator, who lost to leftwing incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a stunning defeat on Sunday, disappeared for 24 hours before Argentinian migration authorities announced he had entered the country on Tuesday night.




There, Bolsonaro boarded a flight to the United States which made a brief stop in Ecuador before heading to Miami, 

the Guardian reported 

on Wednesday.




The 

US State Department confirmed

 it would grant visas to the far-right candidate and his family on Tuesday, while president Donald Trump 

said he “approved”

 of Bolsonaro coming to the US..




There was confusion earlier in the week over Bolsonaro’s whereabouts, with conflicting media reports and some sources saying he was already on his way to the US, when in fact he was in Argentina.




On Tuesday night, Argentine migration authorities confirmed that Bolsonaro and his family had crossed the border with Argentina and then boarded a plane to Ecuador.




In a post on X

, Argentina’s migration authorities said: “They did so with valid travel documentation and without any legal impediment to entering the country. Furthermore, the transits were recorded by the competent authority without incident.”




Bolsonaro’s apparent flight from Brazil comes after the Supreme Court ordered him to surrender his passport as part of an investigation into allegations of money laundering.




After he lost the election on Sunday, Bolsonaro insisted he would lead the opposition to the leftwing president. However, after Brazil’s Supreme Court gave him 24 hours to hand over his passport, he missed the deadline and boarded a flight.




Lula condemned Bolsonaro’s apparent decision to flee. “This is what the family Bolsonaro are like,” he said. “Brazil is their second homeland. Their first homeland is licking the boots of the US, as he’s become accustomed to doing.”




“I keep imagining what’s on the conscience of a citizen who just lost the elections and flees his country… He who owes nothing, fears nothing. A citizen who sneaks out of his country owes something. The act of leaving Brazil is shameful.”

title: Groupe de parole MeToo inceste et pédocriminalité Lyon
content:
Dans chaque groupe, deux personnes du collectif s'occupent de la modération et du soutien émotionnel individuel (si besoin, si une personne s'extrait du groupe). Ces personnes sont elles-mêmes concernées et prennent part aux échanges.




Le groupe est consacré aux personnes victimes d'inceste et de pédocriminalité, non aux personnes autrices de ces actes, même si elles ont elles-mêmes été victimes.




Le groupe de parole commence par une explication du déroulé. Ensuite, un tour de parole sert à se présenter (prénom, pronoms), à dire comment on se sent en ce moment et le sujet que l'on veut amener. Après, ça reste libre et d'autres sujets de la thématique peuvent être abordés.


Une vigilance à la répartition de la parole est faite mais il n'est pas obligatoire de s'exprimer.




Groupe sur inscription car limité à 10 personnes. Anonymat garanti, possibilité de se présenter sous pseudo dès l'inscription.




En partageant nos expériences et nos sentiments par la parole et par l'écoute, nous cherchons avant tout à rompre notre isolement, et à trouver une aide et un réconfort moral mutuel. Nous souhaitons également susciter notre capacité à demander de l'aide, c'est pourquoi il est complémentaire et ne se substitue pas à une thérapie souvent nécessaire (bien que coûteuse...).




Prochain groupe de parole : 


Lundi 9 novembre 2026 à 19h au Jusqu'ici.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Israeli Elections to Global Movements: Tariq Ali, Rashid Khalidi on New Book "The Neck and the Sword"
content:
We get analysis of the Israeli elections, the upcoming U.S. midterms, the pro-Palestine movement and more from Palestinian American scholar Rashid Khalidi and Pakistani British writer Tariq Ali. They are co-authors of the new book 

The Neck and the Sword: Palestine’s Unfinished Struggle

. The book, an extended conversation between Khalidi and Ali over two years, offers an overview of Palestinian intellectual and political history, drawing its title from a famous phrase used by the renowned Palestinian writer Ghassan Kanafani to describe the futility of “peace talks” between occupier and occupied, saying it was akin to a “conversation between the sword and the neck.”




Kanafani was assassinated by Israel in 1972, “murdered simply because his words were too dangerous for Israel to tolerate,” says Khalidi.




Public opinion about Israel has grown increasingly negative in the United States and across much of the world in the wake of the genocide in Gaza, and it’s “not going to shift back,” says Khalidi. “People have seen something that cannot be unseen. They’ve seen genocide. They’ve seen slaughter. And Israel has no defense.”




“Even in countries with no history of a Palestine solidarity movement, suddenly the Palestine flag emerges,” says Ali. “Why? Because their governments are trying to stop dissent on this issue, so they are defying their governments.”

author: CNT Valladolid
title: Invertidxs y maleantes de ayer y de hoy
content:
EL lunes 19 de octubre, como parte de las jornadas de inauguración del nuevo local de CNT, tuvimos la mesa redonda 

Invertidxs y maleantes de ayer y de hoy

.  El punto de partida de la mesa está en el que durante décadas hubo en España una ley de peligrosidad social que se aplicaba con dureza a quienes no se ajustaban a la idea de «la España viril y trabajadora»: homosexuales y disidencias de género, vagabundes, bohemios, extravagantes… Quisimos plantear el debate sobre si esa idea es cosa del pasado y si ha desaparecido de las instituciones y de las mentes. Y no lo preguntamos por preguntar, sino porque la experiencia de muches de nuestres afiliades muestra que si eso es cosa del pasado, segumos viviendo en el pasado.




La mesa estuvo acompañada de una exposición de fanzines y publicaciones sobre su tema, incluyendo varios números históricos del 

Canijín

, la revista que desde 1992 lleva alzando la voz contra los maltratos y cerrazones institucionales hacia la infancia; el colectivo editor de esta última publicación no pudo estar presente en la mesa por circunstancias ajenas a su querer. A pesar de esa ausencia, fue inevitable recordar durante el debate las distintas campañas y movilizaciones que han denunciado que el centro Zambrana es una cárcel de niños. Distribuimos el espacio en círculos, dando espalda a la mesa que presidía la sala y poniéndonos todas en el mismo nivel, también las personas que tuvieron a bien dar pie al debate compartiendo sus reflexiones y conocimientos:







Miguel Fernández Turuelo, investigador y autor de  

I

nvertidos,

 

provincianos

 

y maleantes, la ley de peligrosidad social bajo el franquismo




Piro Subrat, autor de 

Invertidos y rompepatrias: marxismo, anarquismo y desobediencia sexual

 (editorial Imperdible)




Lourdes, trabajadora social, participante en los colectivos de Valladolid 

Marabunta

 y Radio Kuko







Miguel y Piro hicieron un recorrido por el ámbito al que han dedicado sus obras, pero sin que faltase la alusión al presente al que nos enfrentamos. En la exposición de Miguel jugaron un importante papel expedientes de la policía franquista contra personas de Valladolid, 

rescatados por él de archivos oficiales

. Quedó constancia en ellos, en los documentos de la persecución policial de a quienes el poder definía entonces como «invertidos», de cómo el principal objetivo -dentro de la arbitrariedad- de ese acoso y de las medidas represivas aparejadas no era la presunta «curación» de conductas e identidades que rompian con la norma heterosexual o el trabajo asalariado; el principal objetivo era que no contagiasen la desobediencia contra esa norma, que no hicieran pública y visible la posibilidad de otras formas de vivir. La represión iba destinada al ocultamiento de esas existencias, y estaba mediada por un componente de clase o de complicidad tolerante de clase.




Se recordó en las preguntas el caso de los Patronatos tutelados por la Iglesia contra las mujeres desobedientes, instituciones protegidas, según confirmó Miguel, por lo opaco de los archivos que recogen su funcionamiento.




Piro nos compartió cómo reaccionaron partidos y organizaciones marxistas y anarquistas a la lucha de esxs invertidxs en los años setenta y ochenta por hacerse visibles y acabar con la marginación -las conocidas manifestaciones de liberación gay en ciudades como Barcelona u otras recientemente recuperadas en publlicaciones como 

Lunática

 de Andrea Momoitio

; reacción de esas organizaciones que fue siempre a rebufo de las vistosas y combativas manifestaciones de las personas disidentes de género, y con niveles de sinceridad variables. El activismo queer fue lo bastante combativo y visible -y arriesgado- como para hacer ineludible el posicionamiento o la maduración -para el caso, el periódico CNT, que si en algún momento dio difusión a humores dudosos, como el de que es lo mismo orgullo gay y orgullo tuberculoso, paso en los ochenta y noventa a ser un potente altavoz de la disidencia de género.




Si 

Invertidos y rompepatrias

 -del que se vendieron veinte ejemplares en la charla- recuerda cuantos melones abrió el activismo de disidencia sexual en los setenta y ochenta, la intervención de Piro y el debate posterior pusieron sobre la mesa que muchos de esos melones, si alguna vez se abrieron, se han vuelto a cerrar e incluso aspiran a petrificarse -vanamente-.  Inevitable recomendar la lectura de 

Invertidos y rompepatrias

, tanto por conocimiento como para estimular la reflexión sobre la situación actual,  y necesario recordar que la bitácora de internet donde el texto se alojaba gratuitamente ha sido barrido por una de las medidas contra el «terrorismo digital» del actual gobierno USA.




Por una circunstancia sobrevenida, la compañera Lourdes no pudo estar con nosotros en la sentada redonda, pero pudimos leer el texto de su intervención. Lo citamos a continuación,  por la reflexión que abre sobre todo lo anterior y sobre aspectos que en las organizaciones tenemos en cuenta menos de lo que debemos:




Bueno lo primero de todo dar las gracias por poder compartir este espacio de revisión y también de cuidados.




A mi me corresponde la parte final y también escrita desde la visión más reflexiva, y aunque crea que algunas de esas reflexiones puedan considerarse evidentes siempre es muy útil y conveniente refrescarlas, desde mi punto de vista, para generar debate en torno a ellas a raíz de este tipo de publicaciones y en estos encuentros….




Cuando hablamos de Invertidos y rompepatrias y de Invertidos, provincianos y maleantes, hablamos de algo que va mucho más allá de recuperar una memoria de persecución.




Hablamos de cómo una sociedad construye a quienes considera indeseables, de cómo los nombra y los sitúa fuera de los límites de lo aceptable. Y hablamos también de cómo esas categorías sirven para justificar que otras personas, instituciones y autoridades decidan sobre nuestras vidas.




Las palabras invertido, vago o maleante no solo formaban parte de una manera de ordenar el orden por establecer, sino que permitían señalar quién se apartaba de la sexualidad legítima, quién no respondía a las expectativas de productividad y disciplina o quién podía ser considerado una amenaza para el orden establecido. Bajo esas denominaciones se mezclaban conductas, formas de vida, posiciones sociales y disidencias que no tenían por qué guardar relación entre sí. Lo que las unía era que se las consideraba incompatibles con el modelo de sociedad que se pretendía imponer.




Nombrar a alguien de una determinada manera permitía dejar de mirarlo como una persona concreta, con una historia y unas condiciones materiales propias. 

La etiqueta hacía el trabajo de la explicación.

 Ya no había que preguntarse por qué alguien vivía de una forma determinada, qué desigualdades atravesaban su existencia o qué relaciones de poder estaba cuestionando. Bastaba con señalar lo que supuestamente era.




Y esta es una de las cuestiones que me interesa recuperar de estos libros: no solo quiénes fueron perseguidos, sino cómo una organización social llega a producir y necesitar a sus propios sujetos indeseables. Porque el problema no desaparece cuando dejamos de utilizar determinadas palabras, lo que considero que hay que preguntarse es qué categorías ocupan hoy su lugar, qué función cumplen y qué relaciones de poder contribuyen a sostener.




No se trata de establecer equivalencias fáciles entre épocas pero sí cabe preguntarnos qué permanece en los mecanismos que distinguen entre quienes encajan en el orden social y quienes terminan siendo presentados como un problema para él y para su sostenibilidad.




Y para comprenderlo, quizá tengamos que retroceder mucho más en nuestras propias historias de vida.




Desde la infancia, la familia, la escuela y nuestro entorno comienzan a establecer expectativas sobre cómo debemos comportarnos, aprender, relacionarnos y responder a la autoridad. La escuela, por ejemplo, no se limita a transmitir conocimientos. También participa en la reproducción de determinadas normas sociales y culturales. Y no todos llegamos a ella en las mismas condiciones ni sufrimos las consecuencias de no encajar de la misma manera.




No es lo mismo crecer con estabilidad económica, tiempo disponible, una vivienda adecuada y redes de apoyo que hacerlo en un entorno atravesado por la precariedad. Sin embargo, las trayectorias escolares, ya desde el inicio, pueden acabar interpretándose como si esas condiciones materiales no existieran. Lo que tiene su raíz en una desigual distribución de recursos termina apareciendo como una diferencia individual de capacidad, esfuerzo o comportamiento ya desde que somos niñes.




Así empiezan a construirse algunas de las primeras etiquetas: el chaval problemático, el desobediente, el conflictivo, el que no se adapta… de igual modo, comienzan a sostenerse las primeras medidas punitivas de reorganiazacion de la conducta, de control y de separación entre quienes sí se ajustan a lo correcto y quienes no consiguen estar a la altura, sin entrar en ningún tipo de valoración más profunda que la otorgada por la etiqueta cruelmente seleccionada. Cómo continúa la persecución y el castigo a partir de este punto, sería lo que nos trae hoy a esta charla.




Con el paso de los años cambian las instituciones y las exigencias. Aparecen otras formas de clasificación relacionadas con el rendimiento, la empleabilidad, la responsabilidad o la autonomía. Y una trayectoria atravesada por condiciones sociales acaba siendo interpretada como un problema que pertenece exclusivamente a quien las vive.




Aquí, a mi juicio encontramos una operación fundamental del sistema: convertir irremediablemente las consecuencias estructurales en características individuales de las personas que las experimentan, es decir, la responsabilidad de la exclusión acaba desplazándose hacia quienes han sido situados en ella.




Esta lógica explica que, para que un sector de la población puede permitirse determinados comportamientos porque dispone de recursos económicos, reconocimiento y, sobre todo, redes de protección, otras personas quedan expuestas a la precariedad, la vigilancia, el aislamiento o la intervención institucional. La desviación no se define al margen de esas relaciones. Importa quién establece las normas, quién tiene capacidad para aplicarlas y quién dispone de recursos para evitar sus consecuencias.




La normalidad, como palabra para eliminar cualquier explicación crítica al sistema, no es una medida neutral: también está construida desde posiciones de poder, y no puede entenderse al margen del capitalismo. Un sistema que organiza nuestras vidas alrededor de la productividad, la propiedad, la competencia y el trabajo asalariado establece también criterios sobre qué comportamientos considera útiles, responsables o aceptables.




Pero la exclusión no es un fallo que ese sistema todavía no ha conseguido corregir. Desde una perspectiva de clase, debemos analizar cómo la existencia de poblaciones precarizadas, señaladas o consideradas prescindibles contribuye a sostener las relaciones de poder existentes. El trabajador que teme perder su empleo conoce las consecuencias de quedarse fuera. Quien conserva cierta estabilidad teme perderla. Quien no ha sido señalado aprende qué comportamientos debe evitar para no ocupar ese lugar.




De esta manera, los márgenes no afectan únicamente a quienes son desplazados; también ayudan a disciplinar a quienes permanecen dentro. La figura del vago, del irresponsable o del inadaptado sirve para establecer una frontera moral entre quienes supuestamente cumplen con sus obligaciones y quienes deben justificar continuamente su existencia y sostener las consecuencias de quedarse fuera . Esa frontera presenta desigualdades estructurales como si fueran el resultado natural de decisiones individuales: la pobreza o la falta de empleo se convierten en falta de esfuerzo; la resistencia a la autoridad, en un perfil problemático; las dificultades para responder a las exigencias sociales, en algo que debe corregirse interviniendo sobre el individuo. El sistema conserva sus condiciones de funcionamiento y quienes no pueden o no quieren ajustarse a ellas terminan convertidos en el problema.




Aquí aparece una dimensión que me parece especialmente importante: 

la patologización de las historias de vida

. Es necesario analizar cómo una historia atravesada por condiciones materiales precarias, desigualdades, relaciones de autoridad y experiencias de exclusión puede acabar interpretándose principalmente a través de una categoría clínica o jurídica.




Porque una vida no comienza cuando aparece un diagnóstico. Antes ha existido una infancia, una familia, una determinada posición de clase, una experiencia escolar, unas condiciones laborales, unas relaciones sociales y, en muchos casos, sucesivas experiencias de clasificación institucional. Sin embargo, cuando una categoría diagnóstica pasa a ocupar el centro de la explicación, la historia deja de existir. Aquello que se ha construido a lo largo de una trayectoria vital termina interpretándose como una característica fundamental y definitoria de la persona. La explicación se desplaza, una vez más, desde las relaciones sociales hacia el individuo. Y la intervención puede concentrarse en modificar su conducta o su capacidad de adaptación sin cuestionar mínimamente las condiciones materiales que atraviesan su existencia.




No debemos olvidar que el conocimiento experto se constituye en autoridad sobre la vida de otras personas. Si alguien rechaza una intervención, se considera que no comprende su situación; si cuestiona una decisión, su desacuerdo se interpreta como parte del problema. La palabra de quien ha sido previamente clasificado pierde valor frente a la interpretación elaborada desde fuera.




No estamos hablando solo de diagnósticos o de tratamientos, sino de sociedades que convierten el sufrimiento, la desobediencia o las formas de vivir que no encajan en cuestiones que deben administrarse sobre el individuo. Se patologizan experiencias sin cuestionar las condiciones que las atraviesan. La autoridad establece qué es normal, quién necesita ser corregido y qué margen conserva para decidir por sí mismo. Lo que se presenta como una cuestión personal deja intacta la organización social que contribuye a producirla.




Y esa misma lógica nos conduce al sistema penal y a la cárcel

 -y al manicomio, apostilló la persona que leía este texto-

. Históricamente, el castigo no respondía únicamente a lo que alguien había hecho; también recaía sobre aquello que representaba, sobre su forma de vivir y su distancia respecto a la norma. La prisión materializaba esa frontera entre las vidas consideradas aceptables y las que debían ser apartadas.




La cárcel no es un espacio ajeno a las desigualdades que organiza la sociedad. El sistema que produce pobreza, precariedad y exclusión dispone después de instituciones para castigar y administrar sus consecuencias. No todas las personas llegan ante la mal denominada justicia con los mismos recursos, ni todas las violencias reciben la misma respuesta. Mientras quienes concentran propiedad y poder encuentran a su alcance todas las vías de protección posibles, quienes viven en los márgenes están expuestos a vigilancia, criminalización y encierro sin apenas posibilidad de revertir ninguno de sus efectos. Así, el castigo contribuye a preservar un orden profundamente desigual y a presentar su defensa como una necesidad colectiva.




Por ello, debemos discutir la legitimidad de un sistema que responde al conflicto y a la diferencia mediante el encierro, el aislamiento, la obediencia impuesta y la pérdida de autonomía. La palabra reinserción tampoco resulta inocente cuando significa devolver a alguien a las condiciones que contribuyeron a situarlo en los márgenes. Psiquiatrización y penalización pueden encontrarse así en un mismo punto: 

convertir un problema social en una identidad individual y ofrecer como respuesta la corrección de quien lo encarna.




Por eso los márgenes no son una anomalía que el sistema no ha sabido resolver. Son inherentes a una organización social que necesita jerarquías para mantenerse y cumplen una función en su reproducción. La existencia de personas consideradas peligrosas, incapaces o improductivas legitima la vigilancia, la tutela y el castigo, pero también enseña al resto hasta dónde puede apartarse de la norma. El privilegio necesita esa frontera: permite concentrar recursos y capacidad de decisión mientras responsabiliza a quienes quedan fuera de las condiciones que los han expulsado.




Y aquí entramos también nosotres. Sería demasiado cómodo dirigir esta crítica únicamente hacia las instituciones y no mirar nuestros propios espacios políticos. La militancia no nos coloca automáticamente fuera de las relaciones de poder. También podemos reducir a una persona a sus errores, decidir quién merece ser escuchado y convertir el desacuerdo en una amenaza. Incluso en organizaciones horizontales existen jerarquías construidas desde la experiencia, el reconocimiento, las redes personales o el tiempo disponible. La clase social atraviesa también las asambleas: no participa en las mismas condiciones quien dispone de estabilidad que quien vive entre trabajos precarios y responsabilidades de cuidados.




La respuesta a los conflictos es una prueba especialmente difícil. Si queremos romper con la lógica punitiva, no podemos reproducir sin más el señalamiento, el silenciamiento y la expulsión como formas automáticas de resolverlos. Afrontar los daños, sostener a quienes los sufren y asumir responsabilidades colectivas exige algo más que reproducir la misma maquinaria de clasificación que denunciamos. La horizontalidad tiene que existir precisamente cuando aparece la diferencia, cuando alguien disiente y cuando las respuestas fáciles dejan de servir o ser cómodas.




Y con esto volvemos al punto de partida. Quizá lo más importante no sea buscar quiénes son hoy los nuevos vagos y maleantes, porque eso nos devolvería a la costumbre de observar a quienes están en los márgenes y no a las relaciones que los producen. La transformación no consiste en ampliar la lista de quienes merecen ser considerados normales, sino en cuestionar por qué la normalidad funciona como una medida de valor y por qué alejarse de ella permite justificar la subordinación.




Dejo dos reflexiones para el debate. 

La primera:

 una sociedad que necesita fabricar vidas prescindibles para sostener los privilegios de unas pocas personas no está fracasando al producir exclusión; está mostrando una parte esencial de su funcionamiento. No basta con cambiar las etiquetas ni con humanizar sus instituciones si siguen intactas las relaciones económicas y de poder que necesitan esos márgenes.




La segunda nos compromete directamente:

 ninguna práctica emancipadora puede construirse administrando de otra manera a las personas que el sistema declara problemáticas. Nuestro desafío es levantar relaciones capaces de afrontar las diferencias, los conflictos y los daños sin convertir la autoridad, la patologización o el castigo en la respuesta habitual. Relaciones en las que nadie tenga que demostrar constantemente que merece ser escuchado, reconocido y capaz de decidir sobre su propia vida.




Y esperando que este sindicato y sus colectivos afines seamos capaces de hacer efectivo ese compromiso, pasamos de la letra al terreno de los hechos cerrando esta crónica.







La entrada 

Invertidxs y maleantes de ayer y de hoy

 apareció primero en 

CNT Valladolid

.




La entrada 

Invertidxs y maleantes de ayer y de hoy

 se publicó primero en 

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

author: Mag
title: Rettungsdienst: Befragung zeigt massiv gestiegene Arbeitsbelastung – ver.di fordert kürzere Höchstarbeitszeit
content:
Dossier




„

Die heute vorgestellten 

Ergebnisse der ver.di-Befragung „Gute Arbeit im Rettungsdienst“

 

 zeigen eine massive Zunahme der Arbeitsbelastung. „Die ohnehin hohe Belastung von Beschäftigten im Rettungsdienst hat sich seit Beginn der Corona-Krise nochmals deutlich verschärft“ (…) Die Befragung, an der sich rund 7.000 Beschäftigte beteiligt haben, belegt gravierende Probleme bei Arbeitszeiten, Arbeitsintensität, körperlichen sowie psychischen Belastungen. Fast alle Befragten berichten von Problemen, Beruf und Privatleben unter einen Hut zu bekommen. (…) Laut Befragung können 61 Prozent der Beschäftigten im Rettungsdienst ihre gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Pausen (sehr) häufig nicht oder nicht vollständig nehmen. Von den über 55-Jährigen geht fast die Hälfte auch krank zur Arbeit. 84 Prozent gehen davon aus, unter den derzeitigen Bedingungen nicht bis zum Rentenalter durchzuhalten

…“ 

ver.di-Pressemitteilung vom 04.10.2022

 

 und dazu:







Keine Notfallreform ohne die Rettungskräfte: Die Sparpolitik hat Folgen, die auch in den Rettungsstellen ausgebadet werden 

 







[Barmer-Krankenhausreport 2026] Drohende Überlastung der Notaufnahmen – Notfallreform benötigt mehr Verbindlichkeit – auch bei Personalbesetzung







Mehr Aufklärung soll Notfallreform retten




„

Barmer-Krankenhausreport zeigt Mängel der Reform. Die Belastung der Notaufnahmen kommt demnach auch von schlechter Patientensteuerung.


Die Notfallreform wurde zwar schon Mitte Oktober vom Bundestag verabschiedet und soll ab Januar in Kraft treten. Letzteres aber nur in Teilen: Die neuen integrierten Notfallzentren (INZ) und die digitale Zusammenlegung der Rufnummer 112 und 116 117 brauchen etliches an Vorbereitung, und das wird dauern. Zumal außerdem auch noch die Zustimmung der Länderkammer zwingend ist, die für den 20. November vorgesehen ist.


Obwohl einerseits alles schon recht fortgeschritten ist, reisst die Kritik an der Reform nicht ab. Bei den Skeptikern reihte sich jetzt auch die Krankenversicherung Barmer ein, die Argumente aus ihrem neuesten »Krankenhausreport« einbringt. Demnach ist unter anderem die Zahl der ambulanten Notfallbehandlungen in Deutschland innerhalb von zehn Jahren um 8,7 Prozent gestiegen. In jedem zehnten Krankenhaus hat sich die Anzahl dieser Behandlungen sogar mehr als verdoppelt.


Nun setzt auch Barmer-Chef Christoph Straub darauf, dass die telefonische Ersteinschätzung, digital unterstützt, zur Entlastung der Notaufnahmen (von fehlgesteuerten Patienten) sehr sinnvoll wäre, einschließlich einer inklusiven Terminvergabe. Allerdings: Verbindlich ist das im Rahmen der Reform nicht festgelegt worden. Patienten können zwar telefonieren, bevor sie selbst zur Rettungsstelle fahren, aber sie müssen es nicht. Ohne eine klare Vorgabe sei der Erfolg der Reform fraglich, meint der Kassenchef. Derartige Mängel im Gesetz gibt es einige. Offensichtlich hat auch Straub wenig Hoffnung, dass hier schnell nachgebessert wird – aber er stellt die Forderung trotzdem. (…) Grundsätzlicher fällt die Reform-Kritik von Stella Merendino aus, Sprecherin für Krankenhaus- und Notfallversorgung der Linke-Fraktion im Bundestag. Das Versagen der Versorgungsstrukturen dürfe nicht zum Fehlverhalten von Patienten umgedeutet werden: »Es bringt nichts, Patienten an eine Arztpraxis zu verweisen, die keine Termine hat. Und eine Notaufnahme kann nicht entlastet werden, wenn Patienten mangels freier Betten nicht auf Station verlegt werden. Notaufnahmen müssen endlich bedarfsgerecht finanziert und ausreichend Stellen geschaffen werden

.«“ 

Artikel von Ulrike Henning vom 27.10.2026 in ND online

 




Barmer-Krankenhausreport 2026: Drohende Überlastung der Notaufnahmen – Notfallreform benötigt mehr Verbindlichkeit




Pressemitteilung

 

 und 

die Studie

 










Keine Reform ohne Beschäftigte: Bei der geplanten Notfallreform ist die Perspektive der Rettungskräfte bislang außen vor. Die Linke will, dass sie mitreden – und hat sie befragt




„Lange Wartezeiten in den Rettungsstellen wie nach einem Anruf unter der 116 117 für den kassenärztlichen Notdienst – das kennen viele, die selbst einmal dringend medizinische Hilfe brauchten. Und seit Jahrzehnten rätseln Wissenschaftler und Praktiker, wie Menschen mit Bagatellerkrankungen ferngehalten und mit ihren Problemen an geeignetere Adressen verwiesen werden können. (…) Dass es also dringend eine Notfallreform geben muss, daran zweifeln weder Patienten, Experten noch Verantwortliche in Gesundheitswesen und Politik. (…) Aber: »Keine Reform kann gelingen, wenn die Beschäftigten nicht einbezogen werden.« Dieser grundsätzliche Einspruch kommt von Stella Merendino, Sprecherin für Krankenhaus- und Notfallversorgung der Fraktion Die Linke im Bundestag. Deshalb hat die Fraktion Ende 2025 eine Umfrage unter den Rettungskräften gestartet, und diese, so Merendino, »verbreitete sich wie ein Lauffeuer«. Knapp 8000 Rettungskräfte haben letztendlich innerhalb von drei Monaten daran teilgenommen. (…) Der Report »Status Rettungsdienst« fasst zunächst die Umfrageergebnisse zusammen. In dem jetzt bestehenden System sind die Beschäftigten dauerhaft überlastet, unter anderem durch ein hohes Arbeitspensum: Über die Hälfte der Befragten arbeitet in 12-Stunden-Schichten, in einem Monat machen etwa 60 Prozent mehr als fünf Überstunden. Ein reichliches Drittel empfindet den eigenen Arbeitsalltag oft als belastend. Und zwei Drittel können sich nicht vorstellen, dem Beruf bis zur Rente nachzugehen. Ein Drittel hält außerdem die Patientensicherheit unter den jetzigen Arbeitsbedingungen nicht für gewährleistet. Linke-Politikerin Merendino hat selbst viele Jahre in einer Berliner Notaufnahme gearbeitet und kennt die prekären Zustände. »Die Beschäftigten gehen täglich weit über ihre Belastungsgrenze. Um sie im Beruf zu halten, müssen dringend die Arbeitsbedingungen verbessert werden. Das kollidiert aber mit dem gesundheitspolitischen Kurs der Bundesregierung.« (…) Die Erhebung der Linken endete mit einer offenen Frage: »Wenn du Gesundheitsministerin Warken eine Nachricht zum Thema Rettungsdienste mitgeben könntest – welche wäre es?« Hier hieß es relativ häufig: »Fahren Sie mal mit. Sprechen Sie mit uns. Entscheiden Sie nicht über unsere Köpfe hinweg.« (…) Die Umfrageergebnisse sind in einen Antrag der Linken im Bundestag eingeflossen, der die Erwartungen der Beschäftigten an die Notfallreform zusammenfasst. Ein wichtiger Punkt darin ist, dass der Rettungsdienst endlich Bestandteil der Regelversorgung wird – und als solcher Eingang in das Fünfte Sozialgesetzbuch findet. Weiter – und dies gemeinsam mit vielen Kritikern – werden bundeseinheitliche Standards für den Rettungsdienst gefordert, unter anderem zur Versorgungsqualität und Ausbildung. Verbindliche Regeln zum Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutz sollen nicht zuletzt die Wochenarbeitszeit auf 40 Stunden beschränken, die Pausenmindestzeit auf 30 Minuten am Stück festlegen sowie Bereitschaftsdienste vollwertig als Arbeitszeit vergüten. Zudem geht es einheitliche Ersteinschätzungsverfahren zur Patientenaufnahme, integrierte Leitstellen und integrierte Notfallzentren – entweder an Krankenhäusern oder an künftigen regionalen Gesundheitszentren.“

 

Artikel von Ulrike Henning vom 8. September 2026 in Neues Deutschland online

„Ein neu gegründetes Bündnis aus Verbänden und Gewerkschaften hat wegen gravierender Probleme bei den Rettungsdiensten Alarm geschlagen. Das „Bündnis pro Rettungsdienst“ klagte heute bei seiner Vorstellung in Berlin über Personalmangel bei gleichzeitig steigenden Einsatzzahlen, die zu einer hohen Belastung und zu Engpässen bei den Notfalldiensten führten. Es gebe einen „dramatischen Personalmangel“, sagte Oliver Hölters, Sprecher der Mitarbeiterseite der Caritas, bei der Vorstellung. Das Bündnis warnte vor einer „nie dagewesenen Berufsflucht“. Während Personal fehle, stiegen die Einsatzzahlen immer weiter an – mancherorts um bis zu 20 Prozent, sagte Frank Flake vom Deutschen Berufsverband Rettungsdienst (DBRD), der dem Bündnis ebenfalls angehört. Oft handle es sich dabei um „Bagatelleinsätze“, für die eigentlich kein Rettungseinsatz nötig sei. „Viele Mitarbeiter sind frustriert, weil sie zur Bewältigung dieser Bagatellprobleme diesen Beruf nicht gewählt haben“, sagte Flake. Das Bündnis forderte, den Rettungsdienst „als relevanten Bestandteil des Gesundheitsdienstes“ anzuerkennen. Auch müsse der Rettungsdienst bei Gesetzesvorhaben innerhalb der Notfallversorgung stärker berücksichtigt werden. Hölters verlangte von der Politik eine „Ausbildungsoffensive“. Mehr Menschen müssten Zugang zu den Berufen im Rettungsdienst finden. Eine Verringerung der Arbeitszeit könne nur eine kurzfristige Lösung sein, um die Mitarbeiter zu entlasten, sagte er. Reduziere man die Arbeitszeit des vorhandenen Personals, fehlten am Ende jedoch noch mehr Mitarbeiter. Dem „Bündnis pro Rettungsdienst“ gehören mehrere Verbände und Gewerkschaften an. Neben der Mitarbeiterseite der Arbeitsrechtlichen Kommission des Deutschen Caritasverbandes und dem DBRD sind ihm unter anderem auch die Björn-Steiger-Stiftung und die Deutsche Feuerwehr-Gewerkschaft beigetreten. Derweil gingen die Tarifverhandlungen zwischen der Dienstleistungsgewerkschaft Verdi und den kommunalen Arbeitgebern in die nächste Runde. Verdi will die Arbeitszeit senken und eine Obergrenze für die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 44 Stunden vereinbaren, wie die Gewerkschaft in Berlin mitteilte. Dazu sollte es am Montag ein Gespräch mit den Kommunalen Arbeitgeberverbänden (VKA) geben. (…) Die Gespräche laufen laut der Sprecherin „unabhängig von Tarifverhandlungen“ und demnach ohne Streikandrohung.“

 

Meldung vom 12. Dezember 2022 im aerzteblatt.de

 




Kommunaler Rettungsdienst: ver.di fordert Einstieg in den Ausstieg von überlangen Arbeitszeiten




„Vor der heutigen Fortsetzung der Gespräche zwischen der Vereinigung der Kommunalen Arbeitgeberverbände (VKA) und der Vereinten Dienstleistungsgewerkschaft (ver.di) zur Verbesserung der Arbeitsbedingungen im kommunalen Rettungsdienst bekräftigt ver.di ihre Forderung nach einer Reduzierung der wöchentlichen Höchstarbeitszeit auf 44 Stunden in einem ersten Schritt sowie Maßnahmen zum Gesundheitsschutz für die Beschäftigten. „Die überlangen Arbeitszeiten von bis zu 48 Stunden pro Woche führen zu hohen gesundheitlichen Belastungen für die Beschäftigten und müssen endlich der Vergangenheit angehören“, sagte Sylvia Bühler, Mitglied im ver.di-Bundesvorstand. (…) Dass eine Reduzierung der Arbeitszeiten im Rettungswesen möglich sei, zeige das Beispiel des Deutschen Roten Kreuzes, so Bühler weiter. Hier habe ver.di Ende November mit den Arbeitgebern die schrittweise Reduzierung der Wochenarbeitszeit (inklusive Bereitschaftsdienst) von derzeit maximal 45 auf höchstens 42 Stunden bis zum Jahr 2028 vereinbart. „Vor sechs Jahren waren wir noch bei 48 Stunden, jetzt folgen die nächsten Schritte. Das ist der Erfolg der Beschäftigten, die sich für ihre Entlastung stark gemacht haben.“ Zur Verbesserung der Situation im Rettungsdienst insgesamt sei auch die Politik in der Pflicht, so Bühler weiter. So seien die Bundesländer gefordert, Rettungsdienstleistungen nicht an den billigsten Anbieter zu vergeben, sondern ausreichenden Personaleinsatz und gute Arbeitsbedingungen zur Vorgabe zu machen. ver.di hatte im Oktober Ergebnisse einer Befragung veröffentlicht, an der sich rund 7.000 Beschäftigte aus dem Rettungsdienst beteiligt hatten. Die Befragung belegt gravierende Probleme bei Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitsintensität sowie hohe körperliche und psychische Belastungen. So gaben 84 Prozent der Befragten an, unter den derzeitigen Bedingungen nicht bis zum Renteneintritt im Beruf durchzuhalten.“

 

ver.di-Pressemitteilung vom 12. Dezember 2022

 







Der Beitrag 

Rettungsdienst: Befragung zeigt massiv gestiegene Arbeitsbelastung – ver.di fordert kürzere Höchstarbeitszeit

 erschien zuerst auf 

LabourNet Germany

.

author: Julius Gavroche
title: Open letter from the prisoners of October 17, 2026
content:
from 

lundimatin

 #539, 28/10/2026







For weeks, the repression against the ongoing movement has intensified. In the aftermath of October 17th, Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin, flouting all separation of powers, ordered the judiciary to hand down the harshest possible sentences to arrested and prosecuted protesters. Many of them are now in prison. Some of the prisoners from October 17th managed to send us this open letter, which serves as both a confession and a call to continue the struggle.




We are writing to you from a prison in the Île-de-France region, the name of which we will not disclose, in order to protect ourselves from the risk of reprisals and, above all, from the judicial and prison authorities.







We are students, high school students, teachers, the unemployed, restaurant owners, small business owners, delivery drivers, gangsters, from every neighborhood and every city in the region: Créteil, Bobigny, Belleville, Montreuil, Bagnolet, Noisy-le-Sec, Seine-et-Marne, Seine-Saint-Denis, and Paris. We are of all ages, all skin colors, and all nationalities; we are Arabs, Whites, Blacks, Roma, Turks, Germans, and French.




We have been accused, rightly or wrongly, of looting, of committing violence against law enforcement, of assembling illegally, of concealing our faces. Ultimately, our situations and the accusations against us are irrelevant, because the courts have bowed to Macron’s orders and sent us all to jail. Even though each prison is all the more the unsanitary and overcrowded as a consequence, next, as long as they fit!




This reminds us how what we call Justice is in no way an independent institution, especially when the State and the bourgeoisie feel threatened.




In prison, we have the privilege of being able to numb ourselves all day in front of BFMTV, CNEWS, and the channels of the regime’s other watchdogs. The ideological offensive on these TV stations supports the repressive policies of those who think they govern us. This offensive is commensurate with the fear that has gripped them since last Saturday. It was a true revolutionary warning. Everywhere, they are now trying to make us regret it, to break us, to dissuade us from returning to future Saturdays. They are silencing the support, the pride, and all those little words we have read and heard in recent days, such as “I wish I had been there” or “you made them pay.” They want us to believe that our violence is comparable to the thousands of lives crushed by capitalism every day.




If the media mouthpieces of the powerful can’t define the “typical profile” of the insurgents, it’s because we are the people who have risen up. The people who suffer and who are now fighting to end their suffering. They try to divide us, to categorise us as protesters, vandals, looters, thugs, or far-left extremists. But they haven’t understood that we are all of these things at once! We are united by our anger and our desire for revolution. A revolution that gives us back the possibility to breathe and hope, to share and to work together. To finally allow us to decide how we want to live. A revolution that puts an end to this humiliation that oozes luxury.




This social rage drove us into the streets last Saturday; it’s the same rage that simmers in the corridors and cells of the prison where we are locked up. This rage also explains the support and respect other prisoners have for the October 17th uprising. Nor will we accept being separated into political prisoners and common criminals, because we were all driven into the prisons of this regime by this unjust world.




For all these reasons, we tell you emphatically, we regret nothing! Nothing except not having adequately protected ourselves against the repressive violence that was about to be unleashed upon us.




We therefore call on all those who are outside to continue standing up to the State and to return to the streets every Saturday, until the fall of Macron and his entire corrupt world.




We call on you to organise yourselves between each Saturday, to meet with one another, to prepare yourselves, and to take control of your lives now.




We call on you to support all prisoners like us and all uprisings, both here and elsewhere.




We urge you to avoid small shops as much as possible, to remind everyone that our people’s justice only targets the biggest, the richest, the multinationals—those who have been robbing, crushing, and despising us for far too long.




We urge you to reject any division among us and to loudly proclaim what we are fighting for: revolution.
