title: Henry aus dem Antifa-Ost Verfahren ist gestorben!
content:
Henry Aulich ist tot. Er wurde 38 Jahre und starb heute in den frühen Morgenstunden, nachdem schon vor einigen Tagen die die lebenserhaltenden Maschinen abgeschaltet worden waren. Seit seinem Suizidversuch am 15. August 2026, bei dem er von einer S-Bahn erfasst und schwerst verletzt wurde, war er nicht mehr aus dem Koma erwacht.




Es war ein sonniger Dienstag im August, zu mehreren saßen wir zusammen, nach einem weiteren von über 50 Prozesstagen im Dresdner Antifa-Ost-Verfahren. Thema war auch Henry. Er war an diesem Tag nicht zum Prozess erschienen, denn wegen akuter Suizidalität war er in eine Psychiatrie eingewiesen worden. Vier Tage später sollte er von einer S-Bahn überrollt werden.




Seit 2013 im Visier des Staatsschutzes




Henry war seit 2013 im Visier der sächsischen Repressionsbehörden. Im Zusammenhang mit Ermittlungen gegen die Fanszene der BSG Chemie Leipzig wurde über Jahre gegen ihn wegen des Verdachts der Bildung einer kriminellen Vereinigung ermittelt. Seine Telefone wurden überwacht, er wurde observiert, seine Kontakte erfasst. Auch besonders geschützte Gespräche wurden aufgezeichnet. 2016 wurde das Verfahren eingestellt. Der sächsische Datenschutzbeauftragte beanstandete später das Vorgehen des LKA und der Staatsanwaltschaft Dresden.




Doch damit endete die staatliche Verfolgung nicht. Immer weitere Ermittlungen folgten, und die Wohnung seiner damaligen Partnerin und ihm wurde wiederholt durchsucht, einmal über 14 Stunden lang. Zu Anklagen kam es damals nicht.




Als Henry schließlich 2025 im Antifa-Ost-Verfahren angeklagt wurde, lagen bereits mehr als zwölf Jahre staatlicher Ermittlungen hinter ihm. Jahre, in denen es seinerseits immer auch immer wieder den Wunsch gab zu sterben.




Mehr als 50 Prozesstage und kein Ende




Henry saß nicht in Untersuchungshaft und kam er seit November 2025 zuverlässig zu den Verhandlungen nach Dresden. Über 50 Prozesstage, obwohl ihn nur ein vergleichsweise kleiner Teil der Anklage betraf. Die Verteidigung beantragte wiederholt vergeblich, sein Verfahren abzutrennen.




Auch der Versuch seiner Anwält:innen, einzelne Verhandlungstage früher enden zu lassen, damit Henry an einer notwendigen Therapie teilnehmen konnte, scheiterte am Gericht. Der Senat verwies auf das Beschleunigungsgebot, weil andere Angeklagte in Untersuchungshaft saßen.




Im Juli wurde Henry wegen akuter Selbstgefährdung in eine geschlossene Psychiatrie eingewiesen. Ein behandelnder Arzt empfahl eine dreimonatige Prozesspause für Henry, ein anderer Psychiater hielt ihn für verhandlungsfähig.




Am 12. August wurde Henry von der Polizei aus der Psychiatrie zur Verhandlung gebracht. Wie ein Möbelstück. So saß er dann da, von Tavor, einem starken Psychopharmakon etwas benommen wirkend die wenigen Stunden den verbleibenden Prozesstages an seinem Platz. Drei Tage später, am 15. August, wurde er in Leipzig von einer 

S-Bahn erfasst

.




Selbst als Henry dann im Koma lag, wollte der OLG-Senat erst noch ein Gutachten über seine Verhandlungsfähigkeit einholen. Erst am 2. September wurde sein Verfahren schließlich abgetrennt.




Eine Frage der (Mit-)Verantwortung




Die Frage, welche Verantwortung die Richter:innen des Staatsschutzsenats des Oberlandesgerichts Dresden für den Umgang mit einem Menschen tragen, dessen akute Suizidgefährdung bekannt war, bleibt. Ebenso die Frage, was es mit einem Menschen macht, wenn er über mehr als ein Jahrzehnt immer wieder ins Visier staatlicher Ermittlungsbehörden gerät.




Jetzt also ist Henry tot




Henry galt einigen als ein gelinde gesagt schwieriger Mensch, wie es in einer differenzierten 

Stellungnahme

 vom September beschrieben wird.




Zugleich gibt es jene die davon erzählen, er habe ihnen aus der Patsche geholfen, wenn es nötig war. Bei der 

BSG Chemie Leipzig

 engagierte er sich über Jahre, wurde 2011 in den Aufsichtsrat gewählt und gehörte von 2012 bis 2015 dem Vorstand an. In ihrem 

Nachruf

 vom 24. Oktober schreibt die BSG, Henry habe die positive Entwicklung des Vereins maßgeblich mitgestaltet.




Nach seinem Suizidversuch vom 15. August zeigte sich die 

Rote Hilfe e.V.

 erschüttert und wütend.




Henry war eben nicht nur jener streitbarer Mensch, der über mehr als ein Jahrzehnt immer wieder ins Visier des sächsischen Staatsschutzes geriet. Es bleiben seine Freund:innen, seine Familie, darunter seine Kinder, und Weggefährt:innen.




Nach seinem Suizidversuch im August breitete sich eine 

merkwürdige Stille

 aus. Nur hinter vorgehaltener Hand wurde darüber gesprochen. Tage vergingen, Wochen wurden daraus. Im engeren Familien- und Freund:innenkreis waren die Bestürzung,die Trauer, der Schmerz und auch die Wut groß. Über seinen Sprung, über dieses Ende!




Frei nach 

Nelly Sachs

: Immer dort wo Menschen sterben, werden Stein und Stern und so viele Träume heimatlos.


			

-

author: Jenna Mahale
title: Pro-Israel Peers Call for Macklemore to Be Banned From the UK
content:
Fifty British peers have written to home secretary Shabana Mahmood urging her to ban American rapper Macklemore from the UK ahead of his Wembley gig this week. 




The letter, organised by ex-chair of Labour Friends of Israel Lord Walney, calls on Mahmood to revoke Macklemore’s electronic travel authorisation on the basis that proceeds from the tour will be donated to the Palestinian Youth Movement (PYM).




Lord Walney’s letter claims the grassroots anti-genocide group has a “record of glorifying terrorism and intimidating elected representatives” – allegations that PYM denies and which are based on its positions regarding what counts as legitimate resistance and protest.  




The peers’ letter characterises a 2025 PYM campaign that 

encouraged people

 to pressure Labour party figures over Palestine as “an attempt to coerce members of parliament through fear”. 




Signatories include former Conservative party chair Eric Pickles, former DUP leader Arlene Foster, former attorney general Lord Goldsmith, Lord Brady of Altrincham – appointed by Rishi Sunak – and Lord Roberts of Belgravia, who was appointed by Boris Johnson.




Macklemore announced his Free Palestine Tour – which quickly sold out its dates in Dublin, Paris and London – shortly after he was dropped as a support act on Ed Sheeran’s Loop Tour last month. 




Pro-Israel 

billionaire Robert Kraft

 spearheaded a ban on the rapper performing after he spoke out against Israel’s genocide in Gaza during shows at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium.




Lord Walney acted as a political violence advisor for the government between 2020 and 2025. 




In 2024, he 

recommended the proscription

 of groups such as Palestine Action and Just Stop Oil while working for lobbying organisations in the arms and fossil fuel industries. 




That included a role as chair of the Purpose Business Coalition, whose members include oil giant BP and arms manufacturer Leonardo, which has extensive links to the Israeli military.

author: Ben Smoke
title: Home Secretary Refuses to Meet Worker Affected by Her ‘Nasty’ Immigration Plans
content:
Home secretary Shabana Mahmood has refused to meet with a migrant care worker who will be affected by her rightwing immigration reforms.




Mahmood was asked to meet the worker as part of a discussion with Unison boss Andrea Egan about plans to make migrants wait up to 15 years to apply for indefinite leave to remain, 

the i Paper reported

. 




But the home secretary refused Egan’s request and the meeting, which is part of 

a charm offensive by Mahmood

 to stave off a growing rebellion against her reforms, was cancelled.




Unison is officially affiliated with the Labour party and has been at the forefront of opposition to Mahmood’s plans. Egan, who was expelled from Labour amid a purge of leftwing members in 2022, has described the reforms as “dehumanising”. 




Egan 

said on X

 on Wednesday: “Shabana Mahmood’s failure to engage with the migrant workers whose lives her nasty proposals will devastate is totally unacceptable. These are brilliant, committed workers who hold our public services together. Unison won’t tolerate them being attacked and ignored.” 




The Home Office 

told the i Paper

 the meeting was a private one-on-one talk between Mahmood and Egan that Unison had chosen to cancel.




Former shadow chancellor John McDonnell urged Mahmood to “think again on this decision not to meet” the worker. Writing on 

X

, he said “the work visa issue is causing totally unnecessary division in the Labour party.”




In an interview with

 Sky News

 on Thursday, energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh refused five times to back Mahmood’s policy of making people wait 15 years for permanent residency. 




In a now deleted social media post earlier this week, 

Fahnbulleh hit out

 at “any attempt to prolong the time people have to wait for settlement.”







In March this year whilst not a member of cabinet, Angela Rayner referred to the reforms as 

“un-British”

. She 

has since

 attempted to downplay reports of a cabinet split over the policy. 




The government 

has delayed

 its official announcement of the policy, the Critic reported, and says it is “considering responses” to a public consultation that closed in February.

author: Mada Masr
title: Mada Masr to challenge constitutionality of media law in Lina Attalah’s first court hearing
content:
During the first session in Mada Masr Editor-in-Chief Lina Attalah’s trial on Tuesday morning, her defense counsel is to petition the court for access to evidence in the case, including documentation held by media regulators regarding the applications for a license that the organization has repeatedly filed since 2018.




It will also challenge the constitutionality of articles in the law regulating the press, requesting that the case file be referred to the Supreme Constitutional Court or that the defense counsel be granted authorization to file its own case before the court.




Attalah is present at the New Cairo misdemeanor court to attend the first hearing in her trial on charges of establishing, managing and operating a website without a license, following her investigation by the Supreme State Security Prosecution on October 21.




Lawyers are also set to attend the New Cairo court session on behalf of the Journalists Syndicate, which said on Monday that it has submitted a formal memorandum to the Supreme Media Regulatory Council “regarding the crisis over Mada Masr’s license application and the legal action linked to it.”




The memo stresses that there were violations of due process in the administrative handling of Mada Masr’s licensing application, that Mada Masr was not notified of the decision and that the proper recourse is “a challenge before the administrative judiciary rather than criminal prosecution,” according to a statement issued on Monday evening by syndicate head Khaled al-Balshy, which Mada Masr reviewed.




The syndicate’s lawyers are to submit a legal memorandum to the court during the Tuesday session in support of Mada Masr, based on arguments laid out in their memo to the SMRC.




More broadly, the syndicate called for a review of the licensing rules, as stated by Balshy.




The Supreme State Security Prosecution referred Attalah to the court on Thursday, less than 24 hours after questioning her on charges of running a website without a license and of publishing false news, with the latter accusation dropped from the charge sheet in the trial referral.




Lawyer Hassan al-Azhari, Mada Masr’s legal counsel, 

described 

the “haste” in the referral and its scheduling as “unjustified urgency,” given the absence of circumstances in the case that require rapid resolution.




During trial proceedings, the defense counsel will seek from the court full access to evidence in the case, including the facts of the licensing procedures and related notifications, details of the charges Attalah is accused of and the time period over which it is alleged that the crime took place.




The defense team is also set to ask the court to grant them access to the full case file and to request that the court access all documentation regarding Mada Masr’s licensing application held by the SMRC.




It will request that the original SMRC notification rejecting Mada Masr’s license, which was not delivered to the organization, be brought before the court. The defense counsel will challenge the claim that Attalah received notice of rejection decision, requesting proof of its receipt.




Mada Masr has applied on multiple occasions since 2018 for a license to operate, when a new law organizing the media and the press was 

passed

, resubmitting its application 2020 upon the issuance of its bylaws.




It received no response from the regulatory council at the time. Instead, Attalah was informed by prosecutors, during a separate interrogation she was summoned to in 2022, that the SMRC had rejected the organization’s license application. Mada Masr responded by filing a lawsuit challenging the council’s failure to notify it of its decision.




Mada Masr will submit a memorandum to the court challenging the constitutionality of Articles 6 and 105 of Law 180/2018 Regulating the Press, the Media and the SMRC, arguing that they violate seven articles of the 

Constitution

: 65, 70, 71, 92, 95, 96 and 211.




In light of this, the defense is asking that the court either suspend the case and refer it to the Supreme Constitutional Court or that it permit the lawyers to file a case before the constitutional court themselves to seek a ruling on whether the two articles of the media law are consistent with the constitutional provisions specified.




Article 6 of the media law states that “websites may not be established or managed in the Arab Republic of Egypt, nor may offices or branches of websites operating from outside the country be managed, except after obtaining a license from the supreme council in accordance with the rules and conditions it sets in this regard.” For a breach of that article, the council may take the prescribed measures, including license cancellation, suspension of website activity or blocking where there is no valid license. The article provides for the council’s licensing decisions to be challenged before the administrative court.




Article 105 sets out penalties for violating certain provisions of the same law: a fine of LE1 to LE3 million, along with the closure and confiscation of equipment and devices. In a repeat offense, the article says, both the minimum and maximum penalty are doubled.

The post 

Mada Masr to challenge constitutionality of media law in Lina Attalah’s first court hearing

 first appeared on 

Mada Masr

.

author: Access Now Advocacy Team
title: #NoExamShutdown: One step forward, another step back
content:
Every year, when exam season rolls around for students across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), many governments use the risk of cheating as an excuse to shut down the internet or block social media platforms. And every year, this results in millions of people losing connectivity, businesses grinding to a halt, and disruption to daily life across entire countries. Of course, exam shutdowns are not the only threat to education in the region; 

students in Gaza

 have begun a third academic year in tents and makeshift spaces, while in Lebanon, nearly 

100,000

 students were unable to return to school at all.




But across the wider MENA region, this year’s exam season saw mixed results for exam shutdowns. For the first time since Access Now, 

SMEX,

 and the 

Internet Society

 began tracking this phenomenon as part of the 

#NoExamShutdown campaign

, the trend went in two different directions across the map. For example, Algeria, which has been a persistent offender for the past decade, 

limited shutdown measures

 to the inside of exam centres, without disconnecting the rest of the country. Meanwhile Syria, which imposed 

11 nationwide exam-related shutdowns just last year

, appears to have held its 2026 exams without any documented disruptions. On the other hand, Tunisia — a country previously ranked as having the 

highest internet freedom environment

 in MENA — joined the offender list for the first time, imposing covert connectivity restrictions during both of its Baccalaureate exam sessions. Read on for more details of this year’s exam season results.







iraQ




sudan




syria




algeria




tunisia




jordan




india










✎ In Iraq, the numbers tell a complicated story




Iraq’s 

exam-related internet shutdowns

 are now in their 11th consecutive year, with 2026 adding at least 34 documented disruptions, according to 

Cloudflare Radar

 and 

ISOC Pulse

 data.




The first set of disruptions occurred throughout June, aligned with the country’s middle and high school exam schedules. The Iraqi Ministry of Communications had 

previously announced

 the shutdowns, planned to last approximately 90 minutes every morning on exam days. The Minister of Communications Mustafa Sanad 

later confirmed the shutdown

, vowing to develop a digital system to eliminate centralized exam distribution and, thus, the “need” to cut off internet access. However, 

similar pledges have been made — and broken — before

. In August, a second wave of exam-related shutdowns hit on five consecutive mornings from August 26 to 31. The disruptions then continued daily until September 10, resuming from September 26 during postponed exams.




On average, this year’s disruptions were 

shorter

 in duration than in 2025, and there were fewer of them overall, but whether this represents a genuine policy shift in the right direction, only time will tell.




✎ Sudan’s shutdowns continue amid war




For a 

sixth consecutive year,

 Sudan’s government 

cut connectivity during exams

, ordering 

10 internet

 shutdowns between April 13-23. MTN Sudan 

notified

 subscribers in advance of the disruptions, but these shutdowns were imposed amid the country’s 

ongoing and devastating civil war

, making it even harder to justify the collective cost to people’s safety, access to information, income, and even healthcare.




✎ Syria: Breaking with the past?




Following the fall of Bashar al-Assad’s tyrannical regime in 2024, many 

wondered

 whether the new administration would break with the country’s longstanding pattern of implementing nationwide shutdowns during national exams. While authorities 

stuck to tradition in 2025

, something appears to have shifted in 2026, with neither 

Cloudflare

 nor 

ISOC

 reporting any exam-related shutdowns during this year’s exam period. This marks the first time in at least a decade that Syria has refrained from imposing shutdowns during national exams; proof that even the most entrenched patterns can be broken.




✎ Algeria turns a page




When Baccalaureate exams began in Algeria on June 7 of this year, people across the country were pleasantly 

surprised to find that their internet access had not been cut

, for the first time in 10 years. As the Minister of Education Mohamed Seghir Saâdaoui explained, connectivity would 

henceforth only be imposed inside exam centres

, with the wider country remaining connected. This marks a significant shift from authorities’ previous approach, which has previously included both total nationwide shutdowns and 

targeted app blocking only during exam hours

. Even if the government has not openly admitted as much, the shift towards fewer, more limited restrictions shows the power of public pressure from citizens, businesses, and civil society to affect real change.




✎ Tunisia: A new offender




Historically, Tunisia has been considered to have the highest 

internet freedom country in MENA

. Yet this year, the country appeared on the 

#NoExamShutdown

 campaign’s radar for the first time. 

OONI anomaly data

 suggests there were widespread 

mobile internet disruptions

, affecting messaging apps such as WhatsApp and Messenger across Tunisia, during both the main Baccalaureate session (June 3-10) and the reset period (June 29-July 2). These restrictions, which were imposed without prior notice, 

impacted businesses

 and 

people

 across the country. This is an alarming step in the wrong direction; one that will need to be closely followed in years to come. 




✎ Jordan: Announced, localized, and still unacceptable




Jordan has a 

long history of exam-related shutdowns

, with 

2023

 being a rare and one-off exception to its annual pattern of hitting the kill switch during exams, even as other 

platform

 restrictions remained in place. Unfortunately, 2026 continued in this vein; on July 23, Jordan’s Telecommunications Regulatory Commission (TRC) announced that IP-based 

messaging applications would be blocked

 near schools hosting the 

Tawjihi

 (General Secondary Certificate) exams, during examination hours only. But announcing a shutdown in advance does not make it any more of an acceptable measure. The TRC’s “localized” and “temporary” framing warrants scrutiny; targeted does not mean proportionate, and a public measure imposed annually and without legal challenge is one that risks being normalized.







➞ A spreading problem




The countries mentioned above are those we track most closely. But exam-related shutdowns are not confined to the MENA region.




✎ India




In June 2026, the Indian government used 

Section 69A of the

 

Information Technology Act

,

 to 

block Telegram

 for the week leading up to the country’s postponed NEET-UG (national medical school entrance) exams. The original NEET-UG exams, taken by 2.27 million candidates on May 3, were voided after it was revealed that materials matching the test’s questions had been leaked.







➞ 

A mixed report with room to improve

























➞ What you can do




If you have experienced internet disruptions during exam periods, we want to hear from you. Your testimonies can help us to document and measure what governments try to conceal.







Share your story

 → 

https://forms.gle/pUh6EPwwtkD65BDY6




Join the coalition

 → 

accessnow.org/campaign/keepiton




Spread the word

 → 

#NoExamShutdown #KeepItOn










Note on methodology:

 

The figures in this blog reflect the total number of individual disruptions observed during exam periods. However, as part of the #KeepItOn Shutdown Tracker Optimization Project

 

(

STOP

)

 

dataset, Access Now counts shutdown instances by each exam period rather than each individual disruption, roughly corresponding to the number of times that authorities deliberately choose to shut down the internet before each exam period begins. This means that the numbers in this blog may differ from our future annual reporting. For more details, read our

 

STOP methodology FAQ

 

(see: “What metrics do we use to track and report on shutdowns? Why do we count shutdowns differently depending on context?”).




The post 

#NoExamShutdown: One step forward, another step back

 appeared first on 

Access Now

.

author: Wir bleiben alle Friedrichshain
title: Was tun, wenn die Eigenbedarfskündigung ins Haus flattert?
content:
Einladung zum Nachbarschaftstreffen!


Am 27.10.2026 ab 19.00 Uhr in der Villa Felix


(Schreinerstr. 47)




Was tun, wenn die Eigenbedarfs- kündigung ins Haus flattert? Diese Frage müssen sich gerade sehr viele NachbarInnen stellen. Deswegen haben wir die Gruppe „Eigenbedarf kennt keine Kündigung“ (E3K) zu Gast.


E3K kämpft seit über sieben Jahren gemeinsam mit MieterInnen gegen Eigenbedarfs- kündigungen. Die Gruppe informiert, unterstützt Betroffene,


bereitet Gerichtsprozesse vor und organisiert solidarische Begleitungen zu Gerichts- terminen. Dabei konnten in den vergangenen Jahren zahlreiche Prozesse gemeinsam gewonnen werden.


Eigenbedarfskündigungen treffen selten eine einzelne Person. Sie können das ganze soziale Umfeld eines Hauses oder eines Kiezes verändern.


Kommt vorbei, bringt Eure Fragen und Erfahrungen mit – egal, ob ihr selbst betroffen seid oder einfach wissen wollt, was man tun kann. Wir freuen uns auf Euch!

author: Wir bleiben alle Friedrichshain
title: Lautstarker Protest gegen Wohnraumvernichtung und Räumung von Menschen
content:
Ca. 60 Menschen protestierten am Freitagabend (23.10.) gegenüber der Gürtelstraße


39-41 gegen Vernichtung von Wohnraum und Verdrängung von Menschen. Dort hatten sie die aktuelle Wohnraumvernichtung direkt vor Augen. In der Gürtelstraße 41, einem ehemaligen Hostel, haben bis Ende September Menschen gewohnt. Seitdem steht das Haus leer und die Fenster wie die sanitären Einrichtungen wurden zerstört. Auch das Haus Gürtelstraße 39


ist eingerüstet. Eine Gruppe der ehemaligen Bewohner*innen erklärte, dass sie durch eine kalte Räumung ihre Wohnungen verloren haben. Offiziell hätten die Bewohner*innen erst nach einer Klage geräumt werden können. Doch nach einer von dem Sicherheitsdienst provozierten Auseinandersetzung mit den Bewohner*innen mussten sie das Haus verlassen und konnten nicht mehr zurückkehren. Erst Tage später konnten sie einige persönliche Gegenstände aus dem Haus holen. Zwei Wochen lebten die geräumten Bewohner*innen des Hugo-Hauses, wie sie das Gebäude nannten, in einem Zeltlager gegenüber dem Haus. Das wurde von den Behörden ab Mitte Oktober nicht mehr verlängert und die Bewohner*innen so ein weiteres Mal vertrieben und zerstreut. So sollte die Vertreibung unsichtbar gemacht werden. Auf der Kundgebung konnten die Bewohner*innen ihre Forderung „Die Häuser denen, die sie brauchen“ skandierten.




Doch die Wohnraumvernichtung geht nicht nur in der Gürtelstraße weiter. Daniel, einer der Mieter in der Habersaathstraße 40-48, berichtete über den jahrelangen Kampf der Bewohner*innen gegen die drohende Verdrängung. Erst wurden die Gebäude des ehemaligen Wohnheims für Krankenschwestern der Charité unter der Ägide des Finanzsenators Sarrazin privatisiert. Seit Jahren versucht ein Wohnkonzern das Haus abzureißen, weil es sich


dann besser verwerten lässt. Er scheitert bisher am Widerstand von Mieter*innen, die nicht einsehen wollen, warum die bereits energetisch sanierten Häuser verschwinden sollen. Sie haben bisher sämtliche Klagen gewonnen und müssen doch weiter um ihre Wohnungen bangen, wie Daniel berichtete. Die Häuser in der Habersaathstraße wurden auch zu einem Symbol für den Kampf um Wohnraum, nachdem ehemals wohnungslose Menschen


dort eingezogen sind. Derweil schafft der Eigentümer Fakten, indem er ebenfalls Mitte Oktober Menschen aus den Häusern räumen und damit auf die Straße werfen ließ. Weitere Redebeiträge kamen von Bewohner*innen der Rigaer Straße 94, dem Bündnis Zwangsräumung verhindern, Nicole und Steffen vom Wohnungslosenparlament, die seit Jahren die Mahnwachengegen Obdachlosigkeit vor dem Roten Rathaus wesentlich organisieren.Auch Vertreter*innen der Union für Obdachlosenrechte (UFO) betonten, wie wichtig die Selbstorganisation der Betroffenen Menschen ist. Sie machen es vor, in dem sie für ihre Rechte kämpfen. „Wir sollten weniger auf sogenannte progressive Mehrheiten im Senat warten, sondern in der Tradition der Berliner Mietrebell*innen den Kampf für unsere Rechte selber in die Hand nehmen“, sagte ein Vertreter der Gruppe „Wir bleiben alle Friedrichshain“, die die Kundgebung organisierte. Sie war klein, aber ihre Stärke lag darin, dass dort Menschen sprachen, die selber von Wohnungslosigkeit und Vertreibung betroffen sind und für ihre Rechte kämpfen: Die Bewohner*innen vom Hugohaus in der Gürtelstraße, die Bewohner*innen der Rigaer Straße 94, die Mieter*innen der


Habersaathstraße 40 – 48, das Bündnis Zwangsräumung verhindern, die


Union für Obdachlosenrechte, Nicole und Steffen vom Wohnungslosenparlament, ihre Stimmen sind uns wichtig.




Eine Aufforderung an die Medien: Hört ihre Stimmen und wartet nicht


immer darauf, dass irgendwelche Parlamentarier*innen über Wohnungslose


sprechen.


Zum Schluss noch was zu einem leidigen Thema: Wie andere linke


Veranstaltung wurde auch unsere Kundgebung von gleich 3 rechten Streamern beobachtet und gestört. Einer der Streamer stelle gegen eine Mitorganisatorin der Kundgebung anzeigte, weil sie ihn fragte, ob er vielleicht aus dem rechtsextremem Streamermilieu kommt. Später konnte er sogar aus dem eigentlich geräumten Hugo-Haus filmen. Er habe die


Genehmigung des Sicherheitsdienstes gehabt. Hie zeigt sich einmal mehr,


wer auf der Seite des Eigentümerblocks steht und wer auf Seiten der von


Räumung Betroffenen.




 

passiert am 23.10.2026

author: Politisches Cafe in der K9
title: Filmvorführung: Der Lehrer, der uns das Meer versprach
content:
Mittwoch, 28. Oktober 2026, 19:30 Uhr




K9


Kinzigstr 9


Berlin


nähe U-Samariterstr




Vor 90 Jahren sorgte die spanische Revolution in aller Welt für Hoffnungen, nicht nur den Faschismus zu stoppen Die spanische Revolution war auch ein utopischer Ort für sehr unterschiedliche Linke. Wir wollen im Oktober in der K9 zwei denkbar unterschiedliche Filme zum Thema spanische Revolution zeigen.




Film 2:Der Lehrer, der uns das Meer versprach:


Der Film führt uns in eine konservative spanische Gegend im Spanien nach dem Wahlsieg der linken Volksfront. Ein junger Lehrer führt progressive Erziehungsmethoden und Lehrinhalten ein, verbannt die Insignien der Kirchen aus den Klassenzimmern und lässt die Schüler*innen im Unterricht mitbestimmen. Damit gewinnt er bald die Sympathie der Kinder, doch viele Eltern bleiben ablehnend. Als es ihm schließlich gelungen ist, deren Widerstände zu überwinden, beginnt der Putsch der Franco-Faschisten. Sie nehmen grausige Rache an den progressiven Pädogogen. Ein Film, der die Unterschiede zwischen der breit gefächerten linken Bewegung im Spanien der 30er Jahre und den Kräften der Reaktion sehr deutlich macht.

author: Westsahara Solidarität Berlin
title: 6.11.2026 | DEMO: Freiheit für die Westsahara. Schluss mit der kolonialen Besatzung!
content:
06.11.2026 (Fr), 16:00 Marokkanische Botschaft, Niederwallstr. 39, 10117 Berlin




Kundgebung vor der Botschaft, danach Protestlauf zum Auswärtigen Amt mit Abschlusskundgebung




Die Westsahara ist die letzte Kolonie Afrikas. Nachdem Spanien das Land 1975 verlassen hatte, wurde es von Marokko entgegen aller Beschlüsse der UNO unrechtmäßig besetzt.




Am 6.11.2026 jährt sich zum 51. Mal der sog. „Grüne Marsch“ – ein von Marokko staatlich inszenierter und von der Armee abgesicherter Siedlungsmarsch zur Besetzung der Westsahara. Tausende Saharauis waren damals waren gezwungen ihr Land zu verlassen und als Geflüchtete in Camps in Algerien zu leben.




Der Jahrestag der kolonialen Besatzung der Westsahara gilt in Marokko infamer Weise als Feiertag — doch wir lassen den seit 51 Jahren andauernden Widerstand der sahrauischen Befreiungsbewegung hochleben!




Die Besatzungsmacht in der Westsahara ist repressiv und brutal. Menschen verschwinden in Knästen ohne Kontakt zu ihren Familien. Journalisten werden auf offenere Straße zusammengeschlagen. Angehörige, die Mahnwachen für die Gefangenen abhalten werden verprügelt und festgenommen. Menschenrechtsbeobachter*innen bekommen Einreiseverbot.




Augenblicklich befinden sich Saharauis, die 2010 an einem friedlichen Protestcamp in Gdeim Izik teilnahmen in den marokkanischen Knästen im Hungerstreik gegen ihre unmenschlichen Haftbedingungen.




Wegen all dem wollen wir uns auch dieses Jahr wieder mit einem lautstarken Protest vor der Marokkanischen Botschaft versammeln.




Beim anschließenden Protestlauf zum Auswärtigen Amt werden wir auf die Komplizenschaft der deutschen Bundesregierung und der deutschen Konzerne aufmerksam machen, die sich in den besetzten Gebieten völkerrechtswidrig bereichern und zur Aufrechterhaltung der Besatzung beitragen. Beteiligte Konzerne, die Profit aus dem Status Quo der Besatzung schlagen, sind unter anderen ThyssenKrupp, Siemens, DHL International GmbH, HeidelbergCement, Continental AG und Köster Marine Proteins GmbH und auch die Allianz-Versicherung.




Anlässlich des andauernden Genozids Israels an der palästinensischen Bevölkerung prangern wir zugleich die militärische, ökonomische und politische Zusammenarbeit Deutschlands mit Israel und Marokko an – Komplizenschaft auf Kosten von Freiheit und Selbstbestimmung in Palästina wie in der Westsahara.




Wir fordern: Die sofortiger Freilassung der sahrauischen Gefangenen aus Marokkos Folterknästen! Ein Ende jeglicher Komplizenschaft mit dem marokkanischen Besatzungsregime!




Unsere Solidarität gilt allen, die gegen Kolonialismus, Besatzung und Unterdrückung kämpfen – in der Westsahara und weltweit.




Freiheit, Gerechtigkeit und Selbstbestimmung – jetzt!




Westsahara Solidarität Berlin

author: Kodao Productions
title: Activists ready massive protests against Trump
content:
Massive protests will greet US President Donald Trump when he visits Manila next month to attend the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit and Related Meetings.




While the Ferdinand Marcos Jr. government is rolling out the red carpet for the US President, groups led by the Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) are organizing protests as large as those that greeted him in November 2017 to attend the same summit.




Malacañang appealed to progressive groups to defer their protests, saying “Filipinos should practice hospitality, welcome foreign leaders,” and to “air their grievances on another day.”




But Bayan rejected the Palace’s request, stating the summit cannot be turned into a “protest-free zone” for the sake of “misplaced hospitality.”




Bayan president Renato Reyes Jr.  announced that tens of thousands of protesters would be on Manila’s streets to denounce  the one they blame for triggering unprecedented surges in oil prices because of his war against Iran.




“Trump deserves our utmost indignation, the most intense of protests and the burning anger of Filipinos who have been severely affected by the US war in Iran. He is a racist, a corrupt fascist and the real scourge of the world,” Reyes said.




What is Trump’s biggest agenda in the Philippines?




Trump’s attendance to the summit, however, appears not to be his biggest objective. He and Marcos Jr. are set to seal the so-called Pax Silica agreement between US, the Philippines and about two dozen other countries during his visit.




Bayan said the agreement plans to put up a microchip manufacturing hubs in the Philippines for the production of US military hardware using locally-sourced rare earth minerals and local cheap labor.




Trump and Marcos would also reaffirm military plans that would drag the Philippines into the US’ growing tensions with rival China, Bayan said.




The group said the protest actions would also condemn US’ role as the main support of Israel’s genocide of the Palestinians.




“No red carpet for this madman, only red banners of protest. Trump’s image will burn in Manila the moment he steps foot on the Philippines,” Reyes said.




Sacrifices for Trump




This early, the Philippine Civil Aeronautics Board has asked local and international airlines to review their scheduled flights in anticipation of potential traffic and enhanced security protocols ahead to Trump’s arrival.




More than a hundred flights may be cancelled, delayed or diverted in the less than 24-hours that the US leader would be spending in Manila, a situation that will inconvenience thousands of passengers.




The Marcos government also announced road closures leading to the summit venue and when Trump visits Malacañang Palace for the signing of military and mining agreements before flying to China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Schenzen. # 

(Raymund B. Villanueva)

Activists ready massive protests against Trump

Kodao Productions

author: Alice de Souza
title: As decisões favoráveis de Mendonça à Hapvida após encontro com executivo na Alemanha
content:
No início de março deste ano, quase um mês depois de assumir a relatoria das investigações do caso Master, o ministro do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) André Mendonça viajou a Frankfurt, na Alemanha, para participar de um autointitulado “debate de alto nível”. Ele havia acabado de cancelar sua participação em outro evento internacional, um congresso jurídico na Espanha, sob a alegação de preservar a imagem de imparcialidade do Supremo, já que lá estaria um integrante da defesa de Daniel Vorcaro.




Mas ele não deixou passar sua participação no seminário em terras germânicas porque o Instituto Iter, fundado pelo ministro em 2023 (e que contou com sua participação até setembro deste ano), foi um dos organizadores do evento. Lá, Mendonça esteve ao lado de pessoas relacionadas ao ex-banqueiro do Master, além de empresários ligados a grandes grupos empresariais cujos processos tramitam no STF – inclusive sob sua própria relatoria.




Um dos apoiadores do evento foi a Associação Brasileira de Planos de Saúde (Abramge). O seu presidente, Gustavo Ribeiro, marcou presença e chegou a mediar um painel sobre racionalização dos custos da saúde por meio da tecnologia. Ribeiro também é vice-presidente do Grupo Hapvida NotreDame Intermédica, a maior operadora de planos de saúde da América Latina, que comprou a rede Promed, da família de Vorcaro, por R$ 1,5 bilhão em 2021. A compra foi feita por meio da entidade jurídica Ultra Som Serviços Médicos S.A, da qual Ribeiro se tornou diretor. Ele esteve com Mendonça na Alemanha pelo menos uma outra vez neste ano, em julho, para assistir a um curso de verão dado pelo ministro.




Semanas depois do evento na Alemanha (e antes desse segundo encontro), chegaram à mesa de Mendonça no STF pelo menos dois casos de judicialização envolvendo a Hapvida. Em ambos, o ministro André Mendonça deu decisão que acabou favorecendo a empresa em detrimento do paciente segurado.
















Gustavo Ribeiro (segundo da esq. para dir.) se encontrou duas vezes com Mendonça na Alemanha




Em um deles, a operadora questionava uma decisão do Tribunal de Justiça do Amazonas (TJ-AM) que a obrigava a custear em até 48 horas, um tratamento para um caso de linfoma. Mendonça decidiu parcialmente favorável à empresa e, em 12 de maio, um juiz do TJ-AM suspendeu a liminar que determinava o pagamento.




No outro caso levado ao STF, a seguradora questionava uma decisão do Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de Alagoas (TJ-AL) referente a uma ação da Defensoria Pública sobre cobertura de tratamentos para pessoas com Transtorno do Espectro Autista. A defensoria alegava que operadoras estavam negando ou dificultando a cobertura integral dos tratamentos prescritos. Mendonça acolheu o pedido da Hapvida e determinou a revisão da decisão na primeira instância, de acordo com os critérios do STF para tratamentos fora do rol da Agência Nacional de Saúde (ANS).




Em setembro do ano passado, o STF fixou cinco critérios para que planos de saúde cubram tratamentos fora da lista da ANS: o tratamento deve ser prescrito por médico ou odontólogo assistente; não pode ter sido expressamente negado pela ANS nem estar pendente de análise para sua inclusão no rol; não deve haver alternativa terapêutica adequada no rol da ANS; deve ter comprovação científica de eficácia e segurança; e deve ser registrado na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa).




A partir de então, a Justiça só pode autorizar tratamento ou procedimento fora do rol da ANS se forem preenchidos esses critérios e se ficar provado que a operadora negou o tratamento ou que houve demora excessiva ou omissão no momento da autorização. Mendonça foi um dos ministros favoráveis à criação dessa norma.




A pauta da judicialização na saúde é uma na qual o executivo da Hapvida e da Abramge está implicado diretamente, como evidenciam suas postagens em redes sociais. Ribeiro defende que o futuro da saúde está atrelado à capacidade de prevenir conflitos antes que eles cheguem aos tribunais. Em abril deste ano, após o evento na Alemanha, a Abramge assinou um acordo de cooperação técnica com o STF para ampliar as taxas de conciliação e reduzir a judicialização.




A Abrange estima que os planos de saúde gastaram cerca de R$ 6,8 bilhões com judicialização apenas em 2024, aumento de mais de 22% com relação ao ano anterior, em litígios considerados “pretadórios” pela associação.  Dados do Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) mostram que, apenas em 2025, a Justiça recebeu 343 mil novas ações contra as operadoras de saúde e que, em março deste ano, pela primeira vez, o número de processos contra seguradoras superou os relacionados ao SUS.




‘Situações que enfraquecem a reputação da Corte’




Os encontros entre Mendonça e Ribeiro, bem como o apoio da Abramge a um evento organizado pelo instituto do ministro, ocorreram em meio a uma discussão no STF sobre a criação de um código de conduta para os integrantes da Corte. A participação de ministros em palestras e eventos internacionais, bem como a fundação de institutos ligados a eles, era um dos motivos por trás do debate, que segue em aberto. Na visão do presidente do STF, Edson Fachin, essas são situações que enfraquecem a reputação da Corte.




Mendonça é um dos que defendem a criação do código. O ministro anunciou a saída do Iter horas depois de a Revista Fórum revelar que o instituto possuía 55 contratos com órgãos públicos de 14 unidades federativas, dos quais 54 haviam sido firmados com dispensa de licitação. No começo de setembro, antes do anúncio, a newsletter Noites Húngaras havia revelado que Mendonça teve um encontro secreto com Vorcaro, dentro da sede do Iter, em março de 2025. 




O encontro na sede do Iter teria sido articulado pelo deputado Cezinha de Madureira (PL-SP), que também tinha interesses no próprio instituto. Ele  assinou um contrato de compra futura de 4% de participação no Iter. Madureira foi alvo de uma operação da Polícia Federal, em setembro, por suspeita de comercialização de influência junto a integrantes de tribunais superiores. Antes, em março, também havia mediado uma mesa no evento de Frankfurt.




Frankfurt sediou evento organizado por instituto fundado por André Mendonça




Procurado pela reportagem, André Mendonça afirmou que não mantém relação com dirigentes da Abramge ou do grupo Hapvida “além de eventuais encontros em ambientes públicos e acadêmicos”.




O ministro disse ainda que “as hipóteses de impedimento e de suspeição de magistrado são definidas em lei, de forma taxativa. Nenhuma delas se configura a partir da coincidência de presença em ambiente acadêmico internacional”. Sobre as decisões citadas, adicionou que estas “são públicas, fundamentadas e estão integralmente disponíveis para consulta, e falam por si”.




Procuradas, a Hapvida e a Abramge afirmaram, em nota, que “não houve, em nenhum momento, reuniões ou tratativas relacionadas a processos judiciais de interesse” das entidades durante os encontros entre Mendonça e Ribeiro.




Sobre os casos tramitados no STF entre os dois encontros, a seguradora e a associação esclareceram que, à época do evento, as ações mencionadas estavam em tramitação na Justiça na esfera estadual. “A reclamação constitucional referente a Alagoas foi autuada no STF em 18 de março, enquanto a referente ao Amazonas, teve decisão proferida em 29 de abril”.




Além disso, a Hapvida disse que “na Corte, a definição dos ministros relatores é feita por sorteio e segue critérios regimentais de distribuição. Diante dessa cronologia, não há fundamento para sugerir que o executivo pudesse antecipar a chegada dessas ações ao STF, muito menos a definição do ministro André Mendonça como relator”.




O Iter afirmou que sua atuação como apoiador acadêmico não se confunde com as atividades dos organizadores, dos apoiadores ou dos palestrantes, e que “o Instituto não possui qualquer ingerência sobre processos ou decisões judiciais, e as questões relativas à atuação jurisdicional do ministro André Mendonça escapam ao seu âmbito de competência”. Para o instituto, “a presença de representantes de diferentes setores em um evento acadêmico não constitui, por si só, conflito de interesses”.




Acesso facilitado de lobistas e empresários




O evento realizado em Frankfurt se vendeu como um “encontro internacional que conecta Brasil e Europa para debates qualificados sobre agendas estratégicas”, mas foi resumido por participantes ouvidos pela 

Pública

 como uma reunião de negócios para facilitar o acesso de lobistas a empresários e políticos do alto escalão brasileiro.




Mendonça esteve presente em quase todas as mesas. Quando possível, sentou nas primeiras fileiras de cadeira, de onde ouviu seu nome ser reverenciado em quase todas as sessões. A própria mesa da qual ele participou, sobre limites e funções das supremas cortes, foi mediada pelo advogado Marcus Vinicius Furtado Coêlho, que advoga para o Master e cujo escritório recebeu R$ 27,5 milhões do ex-banqueiro só em 2025.
















O ministro André Mendonça participou de quase todas as sessões




A questão acadêmica estava mais presente no fato de a sede ser a Universidade Goethe do que na dinâmica do evento, alegam as fontes ouvidas pela 

Pública

. “Pegaram a universidade para deixar com uma cara mais oficial, acadêmica, mas no fundo podia ter sido num resort”, comentou um dos participantes, cuja identidade será preservada.




Apesar de ter sido realizado na Alemanha e contar com tradução simultânea para o inglês, o idioma da maioria das mesas foi o português. Enquanto a participação brasileira costumava lotar a sala, as palestras de maioria alemã ficaram esvaziadas. “Eles queriam dar esse tom de fazer ponte, mas às vezes virava um certo palanque”, afirmou uma participante. “Inclusive tinha um ex-deputado europeu lá, que foi influente nos anos 2000, e dormiu enquanto tava na própria mesa dele”, acrescentou outro.




“Era um encontro de políticos brasileiros com alguns lobistas europeus. Tinham vários lobistas lá. E muita gente que só estava lá por causa de Mendonça”, contou outra fonte.




O evento teria começado a ser organizado em novembro do ano passado. É dessa época que data a primeira das quatro programações às quais a 

Pública

 teve acesso. Nela ainda não estavam confirmadas a presença de André Mendonça nem a do presidente da Câmara dos Deputados Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), mas havia outros nomes que depois deixaram a programação, como o do ex-ministro da Economia Paulo Guedes. 




O advogado do Master Marcus Vinicius Furtado Coêlho, por exemplo, já constava na programação desde o começo de fevereiro, antes de Mendonça assumir a relatoria das investigações sobre o banco e também antes de desistir do evento na Espanha. O nome de Mendonça passou a constar na agenda a partir de 3 de fevereiro, quando também estava na lista de participantes o ministro do STF Luiz Fux, substituído ainda naquele mês por Motta. A viagem do presidente da Câmara para o evento custou R$ 21 mil aos cofres públicos.




O encontro teve uma lista de 18 apoiadores. Além do próprio Iter e da Abramge, estava também o Not Journal, que teria integrado uma lista de veículos de comunicação e influencers contratados, a pedido de Daniel Vorcaro, para fazer ataques coordenados ao Banco Central, 

segundo a Folha de S. Paulo

. Vorcaro tentou, inclusive, comprar 50% do Not Journal por R$ 5 milhões. Na época, executivos do veículo confirmaram o contrato, mas negaram a combinação prévia de conteúdo. Eles também informaram ter recusado a proposta de compra.




Foi enquanto estava na Alemanha que Mendonça autorizou a prisão de Vorcaro, investigado por fraude bilionária aos cofres públicos.




Alguns participantes foram selecionados a dedo, como foi o caso de Tallis Gomes, o fundador e presidente do Grupo G4 recentemente associado à tentativa de trazer a rede trumpista Rockbridge ao Brasil.




Evento ostentação




O perfil dos convidados deu a tônica do investimento no evento. A 

Pública

 conversou com pelo menos três pessoas que estiveram lá e todas foram categóricas em classificar tudo como luxuoso. “Foi um evento caro. Tinha uma uma pompa, sabe? Uma certa ostentação”, conta um participante.




Restaurante 23 Nord, onde aconteceram os jantares do evento




As cerca de 150 pessoas que passaram por lá nos quatro dias tiveram acesso a almoço e café fornecidos pela autodenominada “principal empresa de catering premium da Alemanha”. Boa parte dos convidados ficou hospedada no hotel cinco estrelas Steigenberger Icon Frankfurter Hof, cujas diárias vão de 245 euros (R$ 1,3 mil, na cotação atual), para um quarto simples, a 13 mil euros (R$ 72 mil, na cotação atual), para uma suíte real. De lá, os convidados tinham todos os dias transporte gratuito para a Universidade Goethe.




Além da programação de palestras, havia uma agenda exclusiva de quatro jantares de gala destinada a um grupo menor de 30 a 40 vips e na qual estavam vetados os jornalistas que cobriram o evento. Segundo as fontes entrevistadas pela 

Pública

, nesses jantares foram feitas apresentações do governador de São Paulo Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos-SP), Hugo Motta e também do próprio Mendonça. Em uma das programações, o nome de Motta aparece vinculado a um jantar com apresentação sobre o cenário político-eleitoral brasileiro em 2026.




Os jantares foram realizados no próprio hotel Steigenberger; no restaurante 23 Nord, localizado no 23º andar da Torre Westhafen e cujo menu de quatro pratos custa 99 euros (R$ 545); no restaurante Opera, localizado no edifício da Alte Oper, a antiga casa de ópera de Frankfurt, cujo prato pode chegar a 56 euros (R$ 300); e no Schlosshotel Kronberg, um hotel de luxo instalado em um antigo palácio imperial alemão nos arredores de Frankfurt, cujo valor de um jantar oscila entre 99 e 175 euros por pessoa (R$ 545 a R$ 968).




A empresa que não existia, mas organizou o evento




Quem assina as peças publicitárias do evento é a Dinter, mas a empresa não existia em março – ela foi criada depois da realização do ciclo de debates em Frankfurt, como revela a 

Pública

. Uma empresa com esse nome foi registrada na Receita Federal em 23 de junho deste ano. Segundo documentos da Junta Comercial do Distrito Federal, a Dinter S.A. foi constituída em 10 de abril, ou seja, depois do seminário. Não há registros na Alemanha de empresa com este nome.




O presidente da Dinter é Ricardo Campos,  acadêmico que se descreve como professor na Universidade Goethe, apesar de aparecer no sistema da instituição como assistente de pesquisa. É ele o nome por trás das sequenciadas idas do ministro André Mendonça à Alemanha no último ano. No Brasil, Campos possui um 

think tank

, o Legal Fronts, que foi o organizador do evento em parceria com o Iter, segundo nota enviada pelas duas organizações à 

Pública

.




Campos também é ligado ao Iter. Ele é o coordenador acadêmico de um MBA do instituto que motivou um contrato sem licitação do Iter  com o Tribunal de Justiça do Amazonas no valor de R$ 1,6 milhão. Em nota, o Iter confirmou essa ligação e disse que Campos mantém colaboração acadêmica com o instituto na coordenação de alguns cursos.




Em nota, André Mendonça afirmou que sua relação com o professor Ricardo Campos é de natureza acadêmica, decorrente da docência compartilhada na Universidade Goethe. O ministro afirmou não possuir “qualquer participação societária, direta ou indireta, nem vínculo de qualquer natureza com a sociedade empresária Dinter S.A”.




Campos também tem proximidade com juristas que advogaram para Daniel Vorcaro. Ele foi sócio do advogado Walfrido Warde, que atuou na defesa de Vorcaro entre 2017 e janeiro deste ano e tentou articular um encontro do ex-banqueiro com o presidente Lula, segundo o Estadão.




A sociedade durou cerca de um ano, em num período em que Warde já advogava para o ex-banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro e recebia dele quantias milionárias.




A Dinter também tem entre seus membros o advogado Marcelo Doval Mendes, no cargo de diretor acadêmico. Ele é aparece como docente e coordenador acadêmico de pelo menos quatro cursos do Iter. Além disso, já foi superintendente do Sistema de Água, Esgoto e Saneamento Ambiental (Saesa) de São Caetano, em São Paulo, cargo que ocupou por apenas quatro meses. Tanto a saída quanto a chegada de Doval ao cargo teriam sido motivadas pela sua proximidade com o deputado Cezinha de Madureira (PL-SP). Ambos integraram a programação do evento de Frankfurt.




Procurado, o Legal Fronts afirmou que prestou apoio organizacional ao Regulation & Investment ’26 e que coube ao instituto, com apoio acadêmico do Iter, “a gestão do fluxo de trabalho contratualmente estabelecido, a revisão acadêmica dos conteúdos e o controle administrativo das entregas”. Segundo o Legal Fronts, a curadoria dos palestrantes foi conduzida por Campos.




O think tank confirmou a sociedade entre o Warde Advogados e Campos, mas esclareceu que “o professor jamais atuou, formal ou informalmente, na representação, no assessoramento ou na condução de quaisquer assuntos relacionados ao Banco Master, a Daniel Vorcaro ou aos negócios de sua família”. A informação foi confirmada pela Warde Advogados.




Já o Iter afirmou não possuir “nenhuma relação societária com o Legal Fronts ou com o Dinter SA.”, mas confirmou que o evento Regulation & Investment ’26, realizado em março de 2026, em Frankfurt, “foi promovido por meio de uma parceria entre os dois institutos, Legal Fronts e Iter. Nessa parceria, coube ao Instituto Iter prestar apoio acadêmico, enquanto a responsabilidade pela organização geral do evento, incluindo a definição dos temas e mesas, a seleção e o convite aos participantes e a contratação de fornecedores, ficou a cargo do Legal Fronts”.







A participação do Iter na organização do evento também fica evidente nos metadados de um edital de contratação de pesquisadores para sistematização e difusão dos conteúdos debatidos em Frankfurt. Apesar de levar apenas os logos do Dinter e da Universidade Goethe, o arquivo não foi criado por nenhuma dessas entidades ou seus representantes. A autoria do documento é de Mauro Rabelo, diretor acadêmico do Iter desde julho do ano passado. Rabelo foi secretário de Educação Básica do Ministério da Educação durante o governo de Jair Bolsonaro, na mesma época em que o atual CEO do Iter, Victor Godoy, era ministro da Educação.




A organização não respondeu o fato de a Dinter não existir juridicamente à época da realização do encontro.




Depois da realização do evento em março, o advogado Ricardo Campos fez questão de agradecer publicamente ao ministro “por ter dedicado seu precioso tempo e, acima de tudo, representar o Brasil no diálogo de alto nível sobre os padrões desejáveis do sistema de justiça”.

author: Unknown
title: Plana 11 xalî ya Lîsteya Xwendekaran a Sirbistanê dê bibe bernameya hikûmetê
content:
Lîsteya Xwendekaran (Studentska lista – Studenti pobeđuju) di hilbijartinên 25ê Cotmehê de piranîya kursiyên parlamentoyê bi dest xist.  Lîsteya Xwendekaran, “Plana Xwendekaran” (Studentski plan) a ji 11 xalan pêk tê dixwaze bike bingeha bernameya hikûmeta nû ku di 15ê Îlonê de ragihandibû.




Bernameya ku tevger diyar dike bi nîqaşên di meclisên zanîngehan de hat amadekirin, ji sê beşên sereke pêk tê: “Aa Sırbistan an mafya”, “Hêz di zanînê de ye” û “Sırbistan bi me re mezin dibe”.



















Di hilbijartinên Sirbistanê de Lîsteya Xwendekaran bi ser ket




26 Cotmeh 2026










Di bernameyê de vegerandina mal û milkên ku bi rêya gendeliyê hatine bi dest xistin ji bo cemaweriyê, derxistina dadwerî û ewlehiyê ji bin kontrola siyasetê, veguhastina çavkaniyên dewletê ji bo perwerde û hilberînê û sînordarkirina xebata bêewle derdikevin pêş.




Tevger teqez dike ku bernameya wan tenê ji bo guherandina kesên li ser desthilatdariyê nîne, armanca wan bisînorkirina desthilata siyasî ya li ser saziyan e.




I. An Sirbistan an mafya




Çar xalên destpêkê ji bo rakirina kontrola partiyan a li ser daraz, emniyet, çavkaniyên dewletê û medyayê ye.




1. Daraza serbixwe û polîsê dozgeriyê yê taybet




Tê armanc kirin ku dadgeh û dozger ji zextên siyasî rizgar bibin û hêzekî polîsên serbi dozgeriyê yê taybet ji bo lêpirsînên gendeliyê bi awayekî serbixwe bimeşîne bê avakirin.




Wezareta Karên Navxweyî û teşkilata polîsan dê di lêkolîneke berfireh re derbas bibin. Ji bilî peywirdarên ku têkiliya wan bi sûcên organîze re heye, ew polîsên ku di mudaxileyên li dijî xwendekar û xwepêşanderan de qanûn binpê kirine jî dê ji kar bên dûrxistin.




2. Destdanîna ser mal û milkên bêqanûnî û jikarxistina peywirdarên dewletê




Dê çavkaniyên serwet û mal û milkên peywirdarên dewletê bên lêkolînkirin. Îdareya bacê dê bi kadro û şiyanên ku dikarin van lêpirsînan bimeşînin bê xurtkirin.




Rêveberên ku tevlî gendeliyê bûne, peywira xwe xirab bikar anîne an jî mafên mirovan û nîzama Destûrî binpê kirine dê hesab bidin. 




3. Vekirina peymanên veşartî yên dewletê ji bo kontrolê




Îhaleyên giştî, projeyên mezin ên binesaziyê û peymanên dewletê dê ji bo kontrola giştî bên vekirin.




Bi taybetî peymanên veşartî, projeyên bi bihayên zêdekirî, veberhênanên ku bi qanûnên taybet ji kontrola asayî hatine derxistin û karên dewletê yên ku dema wan derbas bûye dê bên lêkolînkirin. Saziya Kontrolê ya Dewletê dê bê xurtkirin.




4. Rizgarkirina medyayê ji kontrola partiyan




Tê pêşbînîkirin ku Saziya Sazkirina Medyaya Elektronîk (REM) ji bandorên siyasî bê rizgarkirin û Radyo Televizyona Sırbistanê (RTS) vegere erka xwe ya weşangeriya cemaweriyê.




Berpirsiyariya rêveberên televizyonê û rojnamevanan a di belavkirina cudakarî û gotina nefretê de dê bê lêkolînkirin.Frekansên weşana neteweyî dê ji nû ve bên nirxandin; desthilata kontrolê ya Konseya Çapemeniyê dê bê xurtkirin.




II. Hêz di zanînê de ye




Beşa duyemîn armanc dike ku rêveberiya giştî li cihê kadroyên partiyê ji bo pisporan bê vekirin, di perwerdeyê de wekhevî çêbibe û hilberîn li ser bingeha zanînê be.




5. Liyaqat di rêveberiyên giştî de




Dê dawî li tayînkirina personel û rêveberan a bi rêya têkiliyên partiyan ji bo saziyên giştî bê anîn. Rêveberên kargehên giştî dê bi pêşbaziyên li ser bingeha nirxandinên pîşeyî yên eşkere û tund bên hilbijartin.




Xebatên darayî yên şirketên giştî dê zêdetir bên kontrolkirin.




6. Ji bo her xwendekarekî pirtûkên dersan yên belaş




Bêyî ku li kîjan herêmê dijîn, ji bo hemû xwendekarên perwerdeya seretayî û navîn pirtûkên dersê yên bêpere dê bên peydakirin.




Di perwerdeyê de dê ramana rexneyî, zanîna nûjen û hînkirina pratîkî esas bê girtin. Geştên perwerdeyê û çalakiyên derveyî dibistanê dê ji bo malbatan ji aliyê aborî ve bê piştgirîkirin.




7. Piştgiriya ji bo aboriya zanistê û hilberîna xwecîhî




Dê di navbera zanîngeh, enstîtuyên lêkolînê, rêxistinên pîşeyî û sektorên hilberînê de têkilî bê sazkirin.




Hewldanên ji bo teknolojiya nû, kargehên nûjen, karsazên herêmî û cotkar dê bi hîbe û sûbvansiyonan bên piştgirîkirin. Armanc ew e ku ji modela aborî ya li ser bingeha hêza kar a erzan derbasî hilberîna bi nirxê zêde bibin.




III. Sirbistan bi me re mezin dibe




Çar xalên dawî ji bo jiyana karkirinê, ewlehiya xurakan, mafê xanî û tenduristiyê ye.




8. Piştî 12 mehan peymana kar a domdar




Bi guherandina Qanûna Kar re, dema herî zêde ya peymanên kar ên bo demek diyarkirî dê ji 24 mehan bibe 12 meh.




Bi vî awayî tê armanc kirin ku xebitandina karkeran a bo demeke dirêj bi peymanên demkî bê bisînorkirin û derbasbûna wan a bo karê daîmî bê garantîkirin.




9. Sînordarkirina tekelên hawirdeyî




Dê li dijî bandora tekelên hawirdeyî û komên şirketên bijarte yên li ser ferqa navbera bihayên hilberîner û bihayên marketan têkoşîn bê kirin.




Erazîyên çandiniyê û çavkaniyên avê dê wekî sermayeyên neteweyî yên parastî ku ewlehiya xurekan peyda dikin bên nirxandin.




10. Ji bo ciwan û xebatkarên dewletê peydakirina xaniyan




Ji bo malbatên ciwan û bi taybetî ji bo karkerên di qada perwerde û tenduristiyê de dixebitin, dê xanîyên bi mercên guncaw ên kirêkirin û kirînê bên peydakirin.




11. Ji bo her gundî bijîşk û ji bo her kesî derman




Tê xwestin ku di dermanan de sîstema yek bihayî bê pêkanîn û li herêmên gundewar dermanxane bên zêdekirin.




Navendên tenduristiyê yên gundan dê ji nû ve bên vekirin. Li gorî nifûsê dê pîvanên herî kêm ên bijîşkiya malbatê û ekîba tenduristiyê ya asta yekem bên anîn. Li herêmên dûr, îstihdama bijîşkên ciwan û teknîsyenên tenduristiyê dê bê piştgirîkirin.




(AEK/AY)

title: İstanbul merkezli 30 ilde suç örgütü operasyonu: 85 şüpheli gözaltına alındı
content:
İstanbul — İstanbul merkezli 30 ilde suç örgütüne yönelik düzenlenen operasyonda 85 şüpheli gözaltına alındı.

İstanbul Emniyet Müdürlüğü Organize Suçlarla Mücadele Şube Müdürlüğü ekipleri, İstihbarat Şube Müdürlüğü desteği ve İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı koordinesinde, suç örgütlerinin faaliyetlerinin engellenmesi ve şüphelilerin yakalanmasına yönelik çalışma yürüttü.

Çalışmalarda, kent başta olmak üzere ülke genelinde ve uluslararası alanda faaliyet gösteren, elebaşılığını yurt dışında olduğu değerlendirilen ve hakkında kırmızı bülten kararı bulunan bir zanlının yaptığı suç örgütünün sosyal medya platformları üzerinden eleman temin ettiği belirlendi.

Bu yöntemle bulunan şüphelilerin WhatsApp gruplarına dahil edilerek suç eylemleri gerçekleştirmek üzere yönlendirildiklerini ortaya çıkaran ekipler, bu gruplarda eylem hazırlığında oldukları değerlendirilen zanlıların kimlik ve adreslerini tespit etti.

Ekipler, İstanbul, Şırnak, Kayseri, Ankara, Aydın, Bursa, Gaziantep, İzmir, Hatay, Kocaeli, Mersin, Eskişehir, Kilis, Manisa, Mardin, Şanlıurfa, Adana, Antalya, Balıkesir, Batman, Bingöl, Kahramanmaraş, Kırşehir, Muğla, Muş, Ordu, Samsun, Tekirdağ, Trabzon ve Van'da düzenledikleri eş zamanlı operasyonda 35'i adli süreçteki çocuk olmak üzere 85 şüpheliyi yakaladı.

Şüpheliler, işlemleri için emniyete götürüldü.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Chloe Beaton
title: Accessible tram stop campaigners try to board Sydney Road tram
content:
After being ignored by the Victorian government for three-and-a-half years, the Sydney Road Accessible Tram Stops (SATS) campaign held an action on October 23.

A group of about 30 people, with and without mobility aids, attempted to board a tram on Sydney Road to highlight the inaccessibility.

While Sydney Road has many different classes of trams that run along it, campaigners waited for a low floor tram because it is those that would be accessible if tram stops were upgraded.

These could be used by people with mobility aids such as wheelchairs, walkers and crutches, but also by people with prams and shopping trolleys.

The rally waited for more than 20 minutes for a low floor tram to approach. Once it arrived, campaigners tried to board.

Protesters sang and chanted as they unsuccessfully attempted to board the tram.

One person had come with a ramp, and pointed out that the only way someone with a mobility issue could use a tram is to carry around a heavy ramp with them.

To highlight how long the campaign has been going — as well as previous public transport and disability rights campaigns — a model skeleton, named Briony, sat in a wheelchair, was the mascot for the day.

Organisers said “Briony” had been waiting so long for accessible tram stops to be built on Sydney Road that she died in her wheelchair.

While it sounds dramatic, there have been several SATS campaigners who have died before one accessible tram stop has been built on Sydney Road, including Tim Reid and Frank Hall-Bentick.

Campaigners expressed frustration that they have not been acknowledged or heard despite years of campaigning, and federal government legislation stating that all public transport will be accessible in 2022.

They said everyone should be able to access the tram, particularly when the Upfield train line is temporarily closed for level crossing removal, leaving no accessible public transport in the area.

SATS is calling on the Victorian government to guarantee the construction of accessible tram stops on Sydney Road before the Upfield line level crossing removals continue.

[Chloe Beaton is an activist with Sydney Accessible Tram Stops and a Socialist Alliance candidate for Northern Metropolitan in the Victorian elections.]

Sydney Road Accessible Tram Stops Campaign

title: Rönesans Rezidans davası: Dönemin belediye başkanı ve fen işleri müdürü de yargılanacak
content:
Hatay'da depremin ardından Rönesans Rezidans enkazı | Fotoğraf: DHA

Hatay'da 6 Şubat depremlerinde Rönesans Rezidans'ın yıkılması sonucu 275 kişinin yaşamını yitirmesine ilişkin davaya, hakkında iddianame hazırlanarak dava açılan dönemin Ekinci Belediye Başkanı Seyfettin Yeral ile Fen İşleri Müdürü Mehmet Ezer de dahil edildi. Hatay 3’üncü Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi'nde dün görülen duruşmada, 3 tutuklu sanığın tutukluluk halinin devamına karar verilerek dava 30 Kasım'a erteledi.

ANTİS Yapı tarafından inşa edilen ve "Cennetten bir köşe" sloganıyla satılan, Hatay'ın Antakya ilçesinde bulunan Rönesans Rezidans'ın 6 Şubat depremlerinde yıkılması sonucu Hataysporlu futbolcu Christian Atsu, Hatayspor Sportif Direktörü Taner Savut ve milli hentbolcu Cemal Kütahya'nın da aralarında olduğu 275 kişi yaşamını yitirdi, 13 kişi yaralandı. Dışişleri Bakanlığı Hatay Temsilcisi Devrim Öztürk ile bazı yurttaşların cenazelerine enkazda ulaşılamadı.

Hatay Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, sanıklar Mehmet Yaşar Coşkun, Hüseyin Yalçın Coşkun, Ayhan Karan, Mehmet Haşim Eraslan, Bülent Seküçoğlu, Önder Artun, Bayram Mansuroğlu ve İbrahim Dahıroğlu hakkında "bilinçli taksirle birden fazla kişinin ölümüne neden olma" suçundan dava açtı. Geçen yıl 11 Temmuz'daki duruşmada, sanıklar Önder Artun ve Hüseyin Yalçın Coşkun'un vefat ettiği bilgisi paylaşılmış, sanık sayısı 6'ya düşmüştü.

3'ü tutuklu olmak üzere 6 sanığın yargılandığı davaya Hatay 3’üncü Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi'nde devam edildi. Bugünkü duruşmada, binanın yıkılmasıyla ilgili haklarında "taksirle ölüme ve yaralanmaya neden olma" suçundan dava açılan dönemin Ekinci Belediye Başkanı Seyfettin Yeral ile Fen İşleri Müdürü Mehmet Ezer'in dosyalarının da görülen davayla birleştirildiği açıklandı.

Duruşmaya, tutuklu sanıklar Mehmet Yaşar Coşkun, Mehmet Haşim Eraslan ve Bülent Seküçoğlu bulundukları cezaevlerinden, tutuksuz sanık Ayhan Karan ise bulunduğu ilden SEGBİS aracılığıyla katıldı. Tutuksuz sanık İbrahim Dahıroğlu ve iki kamu görevlisi, depremde yakınlarını kaybedenler ile taraf avukatları salonda hazır bulundu.

Duruşmada ilk olarak birleşen dosya kapsamında tutuksuz sanıklar Seyfettin Yeral ile Fen İşleri Müdürü Mehmet Ezer'in savunmaları alındı.

Sanık Yeral, 1999 ile 2014 yılları arasında belediye başkanlığı yaptığını belirterek, görev süresi boyunca statik projelerde incelemelerde bulunmadığını, ruhsat vermeden önce teknik personelden destek ve görüş aldıklarını söyledi. Problemli veya sıkıntılı inşaatlara ruhsat onayı vermediklerini ifade eden Yeral, proje ve yapım aşamasındaki denetimleri Fen İşleri Müdürü'nün yaptığını, belediye başkanı olarak projeler üzerinde herhangi bir görevinin bulunmadığını savundu. Yeral, binanın yıkılmasında herhangi bir hatasının olmadığını öne sürerek suçlamaları kabul etmedi.

Dönemin Ekinci Belediyesi Fen İşleri Müdürü Mehmet Ezer ise iddianamenin kendisine ulaşmadığını öne sürerek, savunma için mahkeme heyetinden süre istedi.

Depremde yakınlarını kaybedenler de sanıkların en ağır cezayı almalarını talep etti. Müşteki avukatları, sanıklarından "olası kast" suçlaması yönünden ek savunma alınmasını talep etti.

Tutuklu sanık Mehmet Yaşar Coşkun, 3 yılı aşkın süredir cezaevinde bulunduğunu ve mağdur olduğunu öne sürerek yapıda kusuru olmadığını iddia edip tahliyesini isterken, diğer sanıklar da haklarındaki suçlamaları reddetti.

Mahkeme heyeti, sanıkların mevcut hallerinin devamına ve diğer eksikliklerin giderilmesine karar vererek duruşmayı 30 Kasım'a erteledi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Bakırköy Belediyesine operasyon: 5 başkan yardımcısı dahil 37 kişi gözaltına alındı
content:
Görsel: Google Maps'ten alınan ekran alıntısı

İstanbul - Bakırköy Belediyesinin ihale süreçlerinde kamu zararına yol açıldığı ve ruhsat almak isteyen işletmelerden hukuka aykırı para talep edildiği iddiaları üzerine yürütülen soruşturmada, aralarında belediye yöneticileri ve firma temsilcilerinin de bulunduğu 68 kişi hakkında gözaltı kararı verildi. Sabah saatlerinde düzenlenen operasyonda 5 başkan yardımcısı ve 2 meclis üyesinin de aralarında bulunduğu 37 kişi gözaltına alındı.

Bakırköy Belediyesinin ihale ve ruhsat işlemlerine ilişkin usulsüzlük iddiaları üzerine soruşturma başlatıldı. Bakırköy Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığının yürüttüğü soruşturma kapsamında, 68 kişi hakkında gözaltına alma, arama ve el koyma işlemlerinin yapılması için talimat verildi. Başsavcılığın açıklamasına göre soruşturma, belediyenin mal ve hizmet alımlarına ilişkin ihale dosyalarında usulsüzlük yapılarak kamu zararına yol açıldığı ve iş yeri çalışma ruhsatı almak isteyen işletme sahiplerinden hukuka aykırı şekilde para talep edildiği yönündeki ihbarlar üzerine başlatıldı.

Operasyonda 5 başkan yardımcısı ve 2 meclis üyesinin de aralarında bulunduğu 37 kişi gözaltına alındı.

Başsavcılık tarafından yapılan açıklamada şu ifadelere yer verildi:

"Bakırköy Belediye Başkanlığı tarafından yapılan mal ve hizmet alımına ilişkin ihale dosyalarında suç teşkil eden usülsüzlükler neticesi kamu zararı oluştuğu; işyeri çalışma ruhsatı talep eden işletme sahiplerinden hukuka aykırı şekilde para talep edildiği, talep edilen miktarı ödemeyen işletmelerin ruhsat işlemlerinin ise sürüncemede bırakıldığı şeklinde Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığımıza gelen ihbarlar üzerine;

5237 sayılı Türk Ceza Kanunu, 5018 sayılı Kamu Mali Yönetimi ve Kontrol Kanunu, 4734 sayılı Kamu İhale Kanunu, 4735 sayılı Kamu İhale Sözleşmeleri Kanunu ile Mal Alımı İhaleleri Uygulama Yönetmeliği hükümleri gözetilerek,

İhaleye fesat karıştırma ve irtikap suçlarından Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığımızca yürütülen soruşturmada, 2024-2026 yıllarında Bakırköy Belediyesinin farklı müdürlükleri tarafından yapılan açık ve pazarlık usulüne tabi 42 ihale dosyası üzerinde bilirkişi incelemesi yaptırıldığı; şüphelilerin HTS kayıtları ve MASAK raporlarının analizlerinin yapıldığı; iletişimin tespiti ve teknik araçla izleme tedbirlerine başvurulması sonrası,

Atılı suçlara iştirak ettiği değerlendirilen Belediye Başkan Yardımcıları, Belediye Meclis Üyeleri ve Belediye personeli ile ihalelere katılım gösteren firma temsilcilerinin de aralarında bulunduğu 68 şüpheli hakkında İstanbul İl Jandarma Komutanlığı KOM Şube Müdürlüğüne yakalama, gözaltına alma, ifade alma, inceleme, arama ve el koyma talimatı verilmiştir."
