author: Ridah Hassan
title: Manosphere making classrooms toxic
content:
“I had male students threatening to rape the female students consistently. They would play ‘rape marry kill’ and used my own name frequently in their ‘game’.”

“Students saying ‘good girl’ to teachers.”

“Less respect for female staff vs male in behaviour—even with the same approaches they instantly listen to males more. More inappropriate jokes—racism, homophobic and sexist jokes with little consequences. Visible [and] audible dismissal/rejection of female staff to their faces when they appear to take classes.” 

These are quotes from a Monash University report which has cast light on the disturbing sexist conditions faced by teachers and students in primary and secondary schools across the country. 

Duty of Care: Teachers’ experiences of sexism, misogyny and sexual harassment in Australian schools

 is based on the testimony of 2,600 educators and reveals the breadth and depth of the crisis. 

A common theme in the report is the lack of respect male students show female teachers. This includes frequent interrupting, ignoring of instructions, mocking and mimicking, speaking disrespectfully and refusing to accept responsibility when challenged about inappropriate behaviour. Physical aggression and intimidation were also reported, along with threats of more serious physical and sexual assault. Male students frequently make “derogatory comments toward females focusing on appearance and worth”, “jokes about gender roles e.g. the kitchen”, “inappropriate sexualised remarks about female bodies, including specifically about peers and/or staff” and “[making] sexual noises in the classroom” while female staff are trying to teach.

This behaviour is contributing to the burn-out of teachers in a profession already facing shortages due to poor pay and unmanageable workloads. One respondent put it clearly: “Being the front line and bearing the brunt of misogyny is exhausting and erodes self-worth”. According to the report, 77 percent of teachers say that sexism and misogyny have a “negative” or “very negative” impact on their wellbeing, and more than 50 percent of female teachers report that they either “occasionally” or “frequently” consider leaving the profession because of it. And the situation is getting worse—both primary and secondary teachers reported that gendered violence on the part of students had increased significantly in the previous twelve months.

Given adult teachers are feeling undermined, threatened and belittled by male students’ behaviour, the impact on teenage girls should be cause for immediate action. According to the report, “Younger students are comfortable using misogynistic language without thought e.g. calling girls in class a ‘slut’ ‘whore’ because they won’t share a highlighter”, and “Women/girls in class are okay with being treated with misogyny as this is seen as ‘normal’ now. They do not retaliate and internalise, making emotional regulation hard”. Another teacher observed: “Female students are scared to speak out and express their opinions in class with males who chastise them. I am noticing students are very hesitant to participate in discussion these days whereas it used to be female students being quite eager to share ideas and answer questions. Female students appear angrier than in the past as well”.

Male students direct sexist and misogynistic language towards their female peers freely, entrenching a toxic gender divide among students. Again, the statistics bear this out, with 80 percent of respondents agreeing that the behaviour is having a negative impact on student wellbeing. In observing and being victim to male students’ sexism—including constantly disrupting learning and making spaces hostile—girls are being socialised to accept dehumanising language and treatment and to make themselves small targets by withdrawing and accommodating to the selfish and anti-social behaviour of boys. 

And though there are undoubtedly some who are willing to challenge their peers’ appalling behaviour, it is an unacceptable environment for female students to be expected to navigate every day, while at the same time trying to do the actual tasks of deciphering Shakespeare or learning calculus. It is well established that students learn best when they feel safe, supported and respected. This is currently not the case for female students at Australian schools. 

Misogyny and the rise of the ‘manosphere’

Further evidence of the problem of sexism among male students is the frequent cases of particularly egregious behaviour that make the news. Student from 

Scots College

 and 

St Gregory’s College

 in Sydney, for example, are currently facing court for a series of alleged crimes including sexual assault, rape and common assault for two separate incidents in July and August. 

An independent cultural review of St Kevin’s College

 in 2021 confirmed that sexist and misogynistic behaviour and views were “still clearly an issue” at the school. It was commissioned following an incident in 2019 when St Kevins students horrified the public with their 

misogynistic chants on a Melbourne tram.

 In 2020, a scavenger hunt organised by students at the Shore School, one of Sydney’s most elite institutions, was 

leaked

 

and found to contain activities such as “Get with an Asian chick”, “Play porn out loud on public transport” and “Get with a chick which is 3/10 or lower (photo of the chick + the dirty work)”. And in 2024, 

male students at Yarra Valley Grammar

 were suspended when their rating system of female students was discovered. 

As many respondents to the Monash University survey noted, an important driving force of this sexism is the rise of the online “manosphere”. This consists of the open use of misogynistic language, the revival and confident reiteration of conservative gender-stereotypes, the glorification of aggressive and violent masculinity and the dehumanisation and objectification of women. It is readily accessible through various online channels, with algorithms actively targeting boys and young men. More than 87 percent of teachers noted the influence of these ideas on the boys they teach, with one describing how they have to be careful “when discussing issues regarding female contribution to society or feminist ideas so as not to provoke students to make manosphere style commentary”. Many say they face “hostile attitudes toward discussions of women’s rights and social equity” from male students, who deny systemic issues of gender inequality, question the relevance of discussing these topics, and approach them with defensiveness and aggression rather than empathy, curiosity or an openness to learning.

These sexist and misogynistic ideas resonate with boys and young men not just because they offer a sense of power and superiority in a world where feelings of powerless and inadequate are endemic. But also because they are reinforced and validated by the wider organisation of society. 

Women’s oppression under capitalism 

Well before the manosphere existed, capitalism was systematically denigrating women and their contribution to society. Women’s work and intellectual and creative contributions to society is and has long been devalued and belittled. Women are concentrated in low-status jobs and are paid less on every measure in comparison with men. They are dehumanised and objectified in pop culture, advertising and pornography, with their bodies used as props to sell things, often on the basis of making women feel they are ugly, unwanted impositions on the world unless they fix themselves with diet, cosmetics, medication, surgeries. And that they only have value insofar as they are appealing to men. Women’s wants, needs, questions and ideas are a side show in much of public and private life—in the workplace, within their families and relationships, and in popular culture. 

Women exist to be judged, policed, made the butt of jokes, dismissed, controlled and purchased. In this context, it is no wonder young people are susceptible to the extreme sexism and misogyny that is now available to them online. 

The fact that sexism in schools and society is on the rise is connected to an interesting and challenging fact of the situation; views on gender and gendered behaviour are going backward by many measures at the same time that there is an increase in curriculum content to educate children about sexual and romantic relationships, consent, stereotypes, and the reality of the sexual and domestic violence epidemic. This gap between intention and reality highlights the limitation of education programs in the absence of addressing the structural, social and economic roots of women’s oppression. 

This is also why it is not just young people who hold sexist views. A Melbourne University report, 

Misogyny, Online Radicalisation, and Youth Extremism in Australia

 which asked 1,122 young people aged 13 to 17 and 2,307 adults about their views on gender, sex and sexual relationships found similar issues across age groups. For example, about 31 percent of males from each generation surveyed (Gen Z, Gen X, Millennials, Boomers) agreed with the statement: “Attempts to give equal opportunities to women in Australia have gone too far”. A quarter of both Gen Z and Gen X males agreed that: “The husband is the head of the household and the wife should be obedient to him”, and more than 23 percent of Gen Z males and 20 percent of Millennial males responded positively to the statement “Sometimes women bother me just by being around”. 

The right weaponises misogyny

The response to the Monash University report has not been across the board soul-searching about how to combat this epidemic of sexism and support female educators and students forced to contend with such hostility. Rather, the right has seen it as an opportunity to attack teachers and engage in a culture war in which they identify men as the victims. 

Liberal leader Angus Taylor claimed that the Respectful Relationships Education program, which aims to facilitate discussions about respect and gender equality, as well as consent in relationships, is simply teachers “pushing an agenda”. Nationals’ troglodyte Matt Canavan agreed that the program is “anti-boy”. Breaking stereotypes in her own way by proving it's not 

only 

men who are misogynists, Pauline Hanson claimed that teachers are “brain-washing” students with these discussions about sexism, gender-roles, consent and how to navigate relationships. 

Their agenda is to demonise social movements that aim to advance the interests at those at the bottom of capitalism’s pecking order—in this case, women. If women can break free from the box they are put in, there’s no reason that other workers, refugees, migrants and others can’t question and challenge the status quo which oppresses them too. And this is not good for profit-making and strengthening the nation that facilitates it, which is the key concern of the right.

Fighting back

The conclusions of the Duty of Care report’s authors are a far cry from those of the right. Their official recommendations include reference to the pay and conditions of teachers being crucial to redressing the crisis of sexism in schools. If teachers, who are mostly women, were better paid, had better working conditions and if the profession was less denigrated by the media and politicians among others, it would certainly make it more incongruent for students to denigrate teachers in the classroom. 

Other recommendations include facilitating whole-school implementations of Respectful Relationships Education, improving work health and safety requirements in schools, and establishing avenues for compensation if they are breached. It is definitely true that the sexist and misogynistic abuse educators experience at work would not be accepted in most comparable workplaces, and educators should have the right to a safe workplace free from actual or threatened physical or sexual violence. At the moment, schools simply can not guarantee this. More funding for teachers and education support staff, smaller class sizes so complex and challenging behaviours are more manageable, funding for allied health such as social workers and psychologists would all help. More educational and critical discussions about gender and relationships in schools would also be welcome. 

However, we need to go much further. 

The misogyny in schools is an echo of the misogyny that characterises the rest of society, and is being normalised by the far right that is gaining ground at an alarming rate. We need an organised fightback against this. We need a political movement that promotes a vision of society that is contrary to the divisive prejudices the right thrives on—that promotes the common interest between workers, the strength that comes from unity and solidarity with the oppressed, and the power that can back that up when workers stand together and take action. We need to use every instance of resistance to reassert women’s rights, fight for dignity and equality. Women will not achieve dignity and equality in schools or anywhere else as long as profit rules and people are a means to an end. We need a socialist vision and a socialist movement that can offer something completely different.

Ridah is a public school teacher in Victoria

author: Anneke Demanuele
title: Westsiders campaign against AI hub
content:
I met Anthony and Samantha on Holden Road in Plumpton, 40 kilometres west of Melbourne’s CBD. We’ve parked our cars at the Melbourne Renewable Energy hub gate, behind which a huge expanse of land could become home to a hyperscale data centre owned and operated by Syncline Energy. 

The surrounding area is a green wedge, meaning that it should be protected from industrial and urban sprawl. There’s a free-range egg farm, rolling fields, some houses and a few horses. Samantha, who is campaigning against the development, lives five minutes away in Diggers Rest and learned to ride a horse right here. In fact, one we are looking at is called Betsy and is the very same horse. 

A 

petition

 against the AI hub raises concerns about environmental destruction, including “endangered ecological vegetation communities, biodiversity corridors, areas of Aboriginal cultural heritage sensitivity and conservation efforts”.

The Plumpton plan is still awaiting approval from the state government. If it gets it, the site will host a

 

350-hectare AI hub

, which the 

Age

 reports is the size of 175 MCG playing fields. The facility will have a maximum power draw of 2.5 gigawatts, more than the entire output of the Loy Yang A coal power plant. Loy Yang A provides around 

30 percent of Victoria’s power

. It would use more power than every other data centre currently operating combined. 

“It’s such a blatant display of profit over people”, says Anthony, who has also been campaigning against Syncline’s plans for months. 

Their campaign group started after a community meeting of 150 people in Sydenham. “Anthony and Ella produced these awesome pamphlets, so we’ve been doing lots of letterboxing”, Samantha says. “We also hosted an information night [and] we’ve got a day of action coming up. We also attended the Senate inquiry as witnesses.” 

The Senate inquiry held hearings in Yarraville last month. The inquiry has heard from residents, local politicians and data centre CEOs. Local testimonies include stories of monolithic structures bearing down on residents, diesel emissions and pollution, drone surveillance, and concerns about fire risk.

“The Plumpton site will have huge amounts of lithium-ion batteries, and we feel like this hasn’t been assessed or regulated enough”, Samantha says. Lithium-ion batteries can trigger thermal runaway, releasing toxic fumes and a self-sustaining fire. Because data centres need 24/7 power, they often rely on diesel or gas generators. This increases the risk of uncontrollable fires. “The combination of lithium batteries and diesel is a pretty nasty sort of fire”, a member of Fire Rescue Victoria 

told the ABC 

in June

. 

The Plumpton group is one of many across Melbourne, mostly in working-class areas. The wealthy areas of Melbourne are unlikely to be high on the list of potential sites for the centres. In fact, Belinda Dennett, CEO of the data centre lobby group, said she wouldn’t want to live near one. Samantha describes her as “AI in human form”. Anthony is frustrated that communities have no say in whether centres get built. “It’s so clear that the system is not set up for a democratic decision”, he says.

Samantha says those living near the site don’t have much idea what is coming to their doorstep: 

“Last time I checked, there’s about 80 residents around here. And none of these guys knows about it. It will be in full view of their backyards, and they almost don’t want to believe me; they think I’m almost a conspiracy theorist. But it’s going to be built here, and they haven’t been notified”. 

That’s why Samantha and her co-organisers have been hosting outreach meetings, and doing the letterboxing and door knocking. They want to inform their neighbours what is coming to their communities and fight it together. 

According to Samantha and Anthony, Syncline’s CEO is a “schmoozer”. At the Senate hearings, he said his company has done a “bad job” at community outreach. He’s trying to turn that around and convince locals the AI hub will benefit them. 

“He is very good at convincing people that this will benefit them, without explaining how”, Samantha says. Anthony and Samantha feel the campaign has put pressure on Syncline, which is now trying to win support for its plan by claiming it will create new jobs. But those in the campaign aren’t fooled.

They also aren’t fooled by the Labor government’s Sustainable Data Centre Action Plan. The government promises that data centres won’t be built near residential areas and requires them to bring their own energy and water. But on closer inspection, these requirements are easy to get around. If recycled water isn’t yet available, data centre companies can simply submit a “plan with the water corporation to offset interim drinking water use”. For electricity, they only have to invest in new renewable generation and storage. Samantha is furious: 

“None of it’s due to come into effect or be legislated until early 2027. So even though we have been waiting almost twelve months for this plan, we still need to wait until early 2027 for legislation to catch up. And that’s just not good enough when we’ve got the department of planning process fast-tracking the data centre application in as little as 28 days.” 

Locals living close to existing data centres are unhappy too. The plan doesn’t affect centres that have already been built or approved. Anthony sums up the mood: “The west is sick of it. The working class is sick of being taken for granted. But we are stubborn people, and we won’t go down without a fight”.

author: Unknown
title: Précautions post-pillage
content:
Tout le monde est au courant, les magasins de la Presqu'ile et de la Guill' se sont tous fait ouvrir hier pendant de longue longue looooongue heures. Une belle démarche de prix libre dans un monde où tout augmente. Le truc évidemment, c'est que ce genre de chose ne va pas sans répression, alors voici quelques tips

 

!




Lors des derniers grands moments de pillages (notamment les révoltes suite à la mort de Nahel), les flics ont écumé les sites de revente pendant une longue période après le mouvement, en quête d'objets récupérés à prix très libre pour être revendus ensuite. Pour éviter ça, éviter de revendre les trucs dans les mois qui viennent, favorisez le don à des proches ou attendez les périodes intenses d'échange et d'achats de marchandises comme Noël, les fêtes de fin d'année ou l'Aïd...




Idéalement, ne traînez pas avec les objets que vous avez récupéré pendant un petit moment, c'est frustrant, on sait, mais vous chérirez d'autant ces objets que les souvenirs qui vont avec si vous ne vous faite pas péter avec

 

!

author: Unknown
title: ABD Başkanı Trump’tan İran açıklaması: “Orada biraz daha uzun kalabiliriz”
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, 3 Kasım’daki ara seçimler için yürüttüğü kampanya kapsamında Kentucky eyaletinin Highlands Heights kentinde konuştu.

ABD ve İsrail’in 28 Şubat’ta İran’a başlattığı saldırılara ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Trump, İran’ın nükleer silah sahibi olmasına izin vermeyeceklerini söyledi. Trump, saldırılarla İran’ın nükleer kapasitesini ortadan kaldırdıklarını savunarak şu ifadeleri kullandı:

“Biliyorsunuz, güzel İran İslam Cumhuriyeti’ne yaptığım o küçük gezide, onları perişan ettik. Ama o gezide, nükleer kapasitelerini de ortadan kaldırdık.”

“Orada biraz daha uzun kalabiliriz” diyen Trump, İran'ın silahlarını ortadan kaldırdıklarını ve yeniden silahlanmasını engellediklerini öne sürdü. Trump, “Bunu yapıyoruz. (Silahlar) geri gelmeyecek. (Bu) çok çabuk bitecek” dedi.

Trump, ABD’de artan akaryakıt fiyatlarının İran’a yönelik sürecin tamamlanmasının ardından düşeceğini savundu. Trump, “Bu arada, bu süreç sona erdiğinde, benzin fiyatlarınız da eskisinden daha düşük seviyelere inecek” diye konuştu.

Konuşmasında Rusya-Ukrayna savaşına da değinen Trump, ilk görev döneminde ABD ordusunu yeniden inşa ettiğini belirterek eski Başkan Joe Biden’ın bunun “büyük bir kısmını” Ukrayna’ya verdiğini iddia etti.

Ukrayna’ya sağlanan desteğin karşılığında Avrupa Birliği’nden para istenmesi gerektiğini söyleyen Trump, “Çok fazla verdi. Onlar ödeyeceklerdi. Tek yapması gereken Avrupa Birliği’nden para istemekti. Onlar ödeyeceklerdi, ben de gelip bunu yaptım” ifadelerini kullandı.

ABD’nin Venezuela’dan ekonomik kazanç sağladığını öne süren Trump, “Biliyor musunuz Venezuela’dan ne kadar para çıkarıyoruz? Venezuela’dan yüzlerce milyar dolar para çıkarıyoruz” dedi.

Trump, yönetiminin görevde bulunduğu döneme ilişkin ise şu değerlendirmeyi yaptı:

“Grönland’ı, Venezuela’yı, İran’ın nükleer silaha sahip olmayacağını, iş imkanlarını, her şeyi ekleyin, iki yıldan çok daha kısa bir sürede, ülkemizin tarihinde hiçbir yerde böyle bir iki yıl yaşanmadı.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: İstanbul Valisi Gül'den sel açıklaması: “Kısa vadeli işleri Pazartesi’ye kadar tamamlayacağız”
content:
İstanbul Valiliği Davut Gül, İstanbul’da yaşanan sel felaketinin ardından sosyal medya hesabından açıklama yaptı.

Gül, çalışmalara ilişkin şunları söyledi:

“Sayın Cumhurbaşkanımız konuyu takip etti. Bakanlarımız geldiler. Burada kısa, orta ve uzun vadede yapılacak işler var. Kısa vadede yapılacak işleri Pazartesi’ye kadar tamamlayacağız. Bu nedir? Suların temizlenmesi, caddelerin temizlenmesi, zarar ve ziyanların tespit edilip Pazartesi günü hesaplarınıza yatırılması, hayatın normalleşmesi. Orta vadede olabildiğince hızlı aksiyon alarak problemli alanları yıkarak dere ıslahının başlamasını istiyoruz. Hayat normalleşene kadar, herkes evine gidene kadar biz burada sizlerle birlikte olacağız.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Adana’da bir eve el yapımı patlayıcı atıldı
content:
Adana’nın merkez Yüreğir ilçesine bağlı Koza Mahallesinde, iddiaya göre kimliği belirsiz kişi ya da kişiler, Ali T.’nin evinin kapısına el yapımı patlayıcı attıktan sonra kaçtı. Patlamanın etkisiyle evin camları ve kapıları kırılırken, içeride bulunan 2’si çocuk 5 kişi panikle dışarı çıktı.

İhbar üzerine olay yerine polis ve sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi.

Sağlık ekipleri, tedbir amaçlı 5 kişinin sağlık kontrolünü yaptı. Polis çevrede güvenlik önlemi alırken, bölgeye özel harekat polisleri de sevk edildi.

Polis, şüpheli ya da şüphelilerin yakalanması için geniş çaplı arama çalışması başlattı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 18 octobre
content:
L'éphéméride des luttes du 18 octobre veut se souvenir de Laureano, d'Andreas, de Gudrun, de Jan-Carl et de toutes celles et ceux qui ont perdu la vie en l'offrant à la lutte. Qu'ils et elles vivent dans nos luttes présentes.




1920 :

 Au Mexique, grève de 20.000 mineurs des mines de charbon.




1956 :

 Au Japon, parution du journal anarchiste 'Le Drapeau Noir'.




 

 

 

 




1973 :

 En France, Danielle Cravenne détourne le vol Paris-Nice pour réclamer l'annulation du film 

Les Aventures de Rabbi Jacob

. Elle sera abattue à Marignane, où le GIGN donne l'assaut au moment d'un ravitaillement de l'avion, qui devait se diriger vers le Caire.




1976 :

 A Paris, assassinat de l'anarchiste illégaliste Laureano Cerrada Santos, qui avait participé aux combats de Barcelone en juillet 1936, à la résistance antinazie et financé un attentat aérien contre Franco le 

12 septembre

 1948.




 

 

 

 




1977 :

 - En Allemagne, le gouvernement annonce avoir retrouvé dans la prison de Stammheim les membres de la Fraction Armée Rouge (RAF) Andreas Baader, Gudrun Ensslin, Jan Carl Raspe morts dans leur cellule et Irmgard Moller gravement blessée. Celle-ci, une fois en état de parler, contredira la version officielle du suicide.




 Le journal 'Libération' officialise sa rupture avec le mouvement révolutionnaire en condamnant les actions de la Fraction Armée Rouge et en titrant 'RAF-RFA : La guerre des monstres'. Les locaux du journal seront par la suite occupés par des militants du mouvement autonome pour protester.

 A Dalmine près de Bergame, le groupe armé Prima Lina attaque une caserne de carabinieri.

 A Rome, des centaines de personnes se retrouvent pour marcher vers l'ambassade allemande et un siège de la Lufthansa pour protester contre la mort des militant-e-s de la RAF. La manifestation termine sous les lacrymogènes. Plus tard, le siège d'une société immobilière est incendiée, ainsi que des voitures près de l'hôpital Spallanzani. De plus, une tentative d'incendie de la maison d'un responsable fasciste échoue.

 A Turin, quatre personnes armées font irruption dans les locaux du patronat industriel du Piémont, puis tentent de les incendier. Revendiqué par Prima Linea.

 A Milan, cinq hommes armés font irruption dans un local de la police ferroviaire, désarment les agents présents et s'emparent de plusieurs mitraillettes et de pistolets. Revendiqué par le groupe Romano Tognini de Prima Linea (Romano Tognini était un militant de Prima Linea, mort le 

19 juillet

 de la même année lors d'un braquage d'armurerie).




2006 :

 A Thessalonique, le consulat suisse est victime d'un petit incendie en 'solidarité avec Marco Camenisch et tou-te-s les autres prisonnier-e-s révolutionnaires'.




2014 :

 A Berlin, dans le quartier Treptow, le commissariat de police est la cible de six molotov.




Voir 

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 18 octobre.

author: Unknown
title: Emon Azmi - To black anarchist men
content:
Author

: Emon Azmi

Title

: To black anarchist men

Subtitle

: A short reflection. Nothing here is a new insight.

Date

: 10/17/2026

Notes

: 

Source

: https://thatanarkatamuslim.substack.com/p/to-black-anarchist-men




NOTE:

 For an understanding of black anarchism’s development up to our moment, check out the book 

Black Anarchism and the Black Radical Tradition

 by 

Nsambu Za Suekama

 and Atticus Bagby-Williams. 




 i remember at a get together / open discussion with a bunch of us in VA, 

elder JoNina Abron-Ervin

 noted how few men were in the space and i thought to myself, “Yeah, that is crazy. We really do be sparse out here.” 




 i mention this moment a lot when chatting with brothers. What i pose to them when doing so is that (cis-het) men usually don’t show up in ‘social justice’ or radical spaces with knowledge that the space doesn’t put men at its center. And we don’t wanna be real about why we feel like we gotta be at the center (or central in whatever way) nor how that pull towards the center most often turns us into an implement for neocolonialism draped in “progressive” or “radical” garb. 




 A sister of mine has pointed out to me a couple times how this dynamic plays out in the sphere of black anarchist discourse (online especially), along with the problems the dynamic brings. There’ve been numerous other maGes i’ve seen name this, highlighting how patriarchy is shaping what black anarchists are most visible and what black anarchisms are legible as such in black radical discourses broadly. i’ve experienced a number of leftists’ and radicals’ preference for platforming the perspectives of black anarchist men. Or for equally distributing (between men and maGes) the perspectives being foregrounded from the tendency; as if that would be properly representative of black anarchism today, or even the majority of time since it was first articulated as such. 




 This slick drawing of men to the center, this further sidelining and overlooking of queer and women BARs, is a major reason why black anarchist men are able to gain more social capital (read 

A Discourse on the New Petty Bourgeois Soil

 and 

Social Capitalism

) through our platforms — even if those platforms are small relative to the broader ‘leftist’ sphere. And in all this, with some exceptions like 

elder Ashanti Alston

, the people most passively confronting the Man in the room (patriarchy) are the men. (surprise surprise!) 




 i take issue with the outsized attention myself and other men are getting in discussions of black anarchism (and black radicalism broadly). It is obscuring where the bulk of labor shaping the tendency is understood and projected out as being located. 




 Working-class and under-class maGes are, and have been, the cutting edge of the black radical tradition since the tradition first emerged out of our struggles against patriarchal-colonial oppression. The work and insights of queer and women BARs are, and have been, the primary driving force behind the development of black anarchism as it is today (in theory and in practice). 




 The external imposition of and internal reproduction of patriarchy among our people and within our spaces/movements is what displaces these facts — concealing the material and structural conditions playing into them. This makes these conditions appear as something to just “let them (women and queers) figure out over there”, fueling counterrevolution and reaction in moments of radical political possibility like ours at present. We saw this on under recognized Chattel Enslavement, as well as in the Reconstruction period, as well as in the Civil Rights / Black Power era. The 

Combahee River Collective Statement

, Butch Lee 

Jailbreak Out Of History

,

 andNsambu Za Suekama 

To The Ones Who Can Fly

 provide crucial insights on why this is. 




 No amount of popularity for anarchism in black radical spaces will stop this imposition or reproduction in itself. Black patriarchy will make black anarchism function as a front for neocolonialism, just like it has with so many other tendencies in the black radical tradition, if black anarchist men keep holding the center in our discussions and understandings of the politic and the praxes springing forth. 




 This is a major reason i point people toward anarkata politics (read 

Anarkata: A Statement

) so heavy. There’s no ducking and dodging confrontation with patriarchy in the framework. For men this forces us to reckon with how narrow a lens we are taught to have in our politics and in our conceptions of self and community, where anarchism on its own doesn’t directly confront this. Sanyika Shakur 

The Pathology of Patriarchy

, the speech 

Transphobia is a Respectability Politic

, Zoe Samudzi’s talk 

On Black Feminist Anarchism

, and 

A.I.D. Feedback Loop

 are all really good to engage on this and share. 




 At every turn for me in tryna make things shake in real life, maGes have been the primary ones providing interventions and getting me to ask questions that really pushed the work being done forward (intellectually and practically). Yes we need brothers organized if we’re gonna get free. But if the brothers don’t “reject the Man” then they’ll wind up being organized by, and organizing for, the Man. And that’s the exact formula that’s been whooping us and roping us into the maintenance of settler empire since its inception. That’s why in conversations offline, especially in spaces with lots of young men, i bring it back to patriarchy and how “that (i.e. patriarchy) is some white shit” so much. 




...

author: Unknown
title: Italiani veri
content:
Lasciatemi cantare




Perchè ne sono fiero




Sono un italiano




Un italiano vero




Toto Cotugno 










Contro il carovita, contro il caro carburante e quindi anche contro la guerra. Piazze di molte città d’Italia in questo 17 ottobre si sono riempite in aperta opposizione al governo Meloni, causa della crisi sociale dilagante. Piazze piene anche oggi quindi, dopo una giornata di mobilitazione studentesca significativa per tutto il Paese. 




A Milano, diverse migliaia di persone hanno preso parte al corteo che poi ha assunto una dimensione di ingovernabilità, in piazza Duomo si sono registrate cariche e lacrimogeni e barricate di transenne a tenere la piazza. A Bologna cariche, lacrimogeni e idranti intorno alla stazione. A Torino poco meno di diecimila persone hanno attraversato le vie del centro per poi dirigersi in stazione dove ci sono stati lanci di lacrimogeni e a conclusione del corteo barricate e lacrimogeni nei dintorni della prefettura. A Bergamo la celere ha caricato la piazza del presidio e diversi ragazzi minorenni sono stati portati in questura. A Brescia almeno tremila persone, anche qui cariche e lacrimogeni a protezione di un gruppo di fascisti che avevano intenzione di provocare. Camionette che fanno marcia indietro e cortei selvaggi nei centri cittadini. 




Una chiamata autoconvocata, apartitica, del popolo 

italiano

 che vuole dire basta agli aumenti dei prezzi e che si sente solidale con gli agricoltori che al Sud bloccano le autostrade. Una chiamata girata su canali telegram e whatsapp che ha raccolto però la partecipazione di tanti strati della popolazione e, soprattutto, giovani e giovanissimi. Gli stessi che in queste settimane hanno occupato le scuole, gli stessi che sono contro il razzismo del governo perché scendono in piazza con i loro compagni di banco di tutte le “generazioni”. C’erano i curiosi e i giornalisti che si chiedevano “ma chi sono”. Sono le persone che in questo momento si sentono accomunate da un rifiuto per la politica istituzionale, non c’è destra nè sinistra che tenga, sono le persone che non hanno mai dato un briciolo di fiducia a Meloni e magari anche quelle che hanno ben presente che sì, ha tradito. Sfiducia nei partiti e fiducia nel fatto che essendo uniti qualcosa può cambiare. 




Il dato di oggi è che c’è qualcosa che bolle in pentola. Due, tre sabati di seguito e la voglia di provare a scandire le proprie vite con altro che non sia il lavoro e lo sfruttamento può tornare. Piazze riempite da giovanissimi che hanno riempito una chiamata a tratti contraddittoria stando su un piano che non ne ha snaturato l’origine, semplicemente l’ha chiarificata: insieme alle bandiere italiane, le bandiere della Palestina, insieme ai cori contro il caro carburante i cori contro la polizia, insieme all’insofferenza di dover pagare i costi della crisi la naturalezza di indicare le responsabilità nel governo Meloni, nei Vannacci di turno, ma in generale in tutti coloro che vogliono riarmare l’Italia. E’ palese il senso di presa in giro e di inconsistenza di una narrazione governativa che vuole puntare tutto su questo, cadendo nella contraddizione di dover sottostare e ai diktat di Trump e a quelli dell’UE. 




C’è stato chi da destra ha provato a strumentalizzare o mettere il cappello sulla chiamata. Quel che è successo è che chi ha voluto esserci è semplicemente chi sta in basso: studenti, giovani, precari, pensionati, lavoratori. Ed è chi si è mobilitato per la Palestina, contro la guerra, contro il razzismo. E anche chi non per forza assume le forme classiche della mobilitazione come una modalità per dire “noi esistiamo” ma che c’è stato lo stesso, portando il proprio portato di incazzatura. In più magari c’è stato anche chi grazie a questa chiamata, spontanea e di pancia, ha preso parte alla giornata e ne ha respirato l’entusiasmo. 




Il governo dovrà fare i conti anche con questo e Meloni nelle sue prime dichiarazioni si trova in difficoltà: condannare le violenze basterà quando lei in primis si trova a dover ammettere di comprendere le ragioni della protesta? Inizia a delinearsi la strategia che in questi giorni il governo ha tentato di mettere in campo per disinnescare la mobilitazione: fermi e arresti preventivi, e anche in piazza, di giovanissimi per la gran parte razzializzati. Una strategia militaresca direttamente nei confronti di chi è molto semplice rendere il nemico interno dal quale guardarsi. Alle richieste di “isolare gli incappucciati” nei cortei di quest’oggi la risposta è stata “Meloni vaffanculo”. 




La Francia è ancora lontana e soprattutto è ben diversa. Nonostante questo anche in questo caso probabilmente l’eco del 17 ottobre francese, che in queste ore vede strade completamente divelte e palazzi comunali andati a fuoco, ha contribuito a creare un immaginario forte sul tema del carovita e della crisi sociale. Ma in ogni caso ciò che può aprirsi se guardiamo ai simboli e alle forme della protesta da un lato e, dall’altro, le rotture dall’alto spingono a una ripoliticizzazione della società che trova radici nel Blocchiamo Tutto e che, in fasi sotterranee ha sedimentato e poi, forse, a partire da queste settimane di inizio autunno sembrano segnare un’inversione di tendenza.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Denuncian represión contra trasladados al Complejo Penitenciario de Marcos Paz
content:
Tras los traslados intempestivos a Marcos Paz en los últimos días, los internos están sometidos a condiciones inhumanas, sin muda de ropa, con agua no apta para el consumo humano y alimentación deplorable, denuncian desde la Coordinadora por la Libertad de los Presos Políticos. Ahora, ante los reclamos, el Servicio Penitenciario Federal desató una represión dentro del complejo con gas pimienta y gases lacrimógenos.







Compartimos el comunicado de la Coordinadora por la Libertad de los Presos Políticos:




¡URGENTE DIFUSIÓN! 




17 de octubre de 2026




19hs.




Eneas Gallo y decenas de detenidos están siendo reprimidos en el nuevo Complejo Penitenciario de Marcos Paz




Denunciamos públicamente la brutal represión llevada adelante por el Servicio Penitenciario Federal contra el preso político Eneas Gallo y otras decenas de personas privadas de su libertad en el sector A3 del Instituto 4 del Complejo Penitenciario Federal VIII de Marcos Paz.




Frente a las condiciones de vida inhumanas a las que están siendo sometidos en el nuevo complejo de Marcos Paz, los internos se organizaron y resistieron para exigir respuestas a sus reclamos. Sin embargo, el Servicio Penitenciario no solo desoyó sus demandas, sino también los reclamos realizados ante organismos institucionales, como la Procuración Penitenciaria y el Comité Nacional de Prevención de la Tortura.




Como respuesta a sus legítimos reclamos, durante la tarde de hoy, los internos fueron reprimidos salvajemente mediante el lanzamiento de gas pimienta y gases lacrimógenos.




La situación es de extrema preocupación. Estamos a la espera de información sobre lo sucedido y tememos que la represión se extienda al sector contiguo, dentro del mismo instituto y penal. Un interno nos alertó que los detenidos del sector D también se estaban resistiendo a “engomarse” , cansados de soportar condiciones de vida degradantes.




Los internos llevan días con la misma ropa, consumen agua que no es apta para el consumo humano y reciben una alimentación deplorable. A esto se suman las restricciones del nuevo complejo.




Exigimos el cese inmediato de la represión, el resguardo de la integridad física de todas las personas detenidas, información urgente sobre su estado de salud y el cumplimiento efectivo de sus derechos.




¡Basta de represión! ¡Libertad a Milton y Eneas!

title: Seven Activists Liberate 16 Broiler Hens (Argentina)
content:
Received anonymously: (translated)

For politicians, the justice system and those who profit from animal life, there is a difference between an animal being killed in a slaughterhouse to sell its body and generate capital, or starving to death on farms — this represents a loss of invested capital.

For us, every individual life has value, so we only have one chance, and we won’t waste it waiting for the justice system to decide. Nor shall we waste her begging for mercy and for her murderers to give us a life.

And there we are, in broad daylight, in full view of some curious onlookers, cutting through the plastic to give them freedom, the freedom they have been denied since the moment they were born.

We only care about each other so they can be free, because they only have us by their side to break the cage.

Sete ativistas libertam 16 frangos de corte

Para os políticos, o sistema judiciário e aqueles que lucram com a vida animal, há uma diferença entre um animal ser morto em um matadouro para vender seu corpo e gerar capital, ou morrer de fome em fazendas — isso representa uma perda de capital investido.

Para nós, cada vida individual tem valor, então só temos uma chance, e não vamos desperdiçá-la esperando que o sistema judiciário decida.

Nem vamos desperdiçá-la implorando por misericórdia e para que seus assassinos nos deem uma vida. E lá estamos nós, em plena luz do dia, à vista de alguns curiosos, cortando o plástico para lhes dar liberdade, a liberdade que lhes foi negada desde o momento em que nasceram. Só nos preocupamos uns com os outros para que eles possam ser livres, porque eles só têm a nós do seu lado para quebrar a gaiola.

title: Δράσεις την Κυριακή 18/10
content:
>Συγκέντρωση ενάντια στο ισραηλινό κρουαζιερόπλοιο Crown Iris, 10:30 στην Κέρκυρα


>Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στο γαλλικό μαθητικό κίνημα, 17:00 Πανεπιστημίου







Συγκέντρωση ενάντια στο Crown Iris







Κερκυραϊκή Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης Στον Παλαιστινιακό Λαό




Την Κυριακή στις 10.30 πμ βρισκόμαστε στα εκδοτήρια του λιμανιού για να φωνάξουμε δυνατά ότι οι Σιωναζί είναι ανεπιθύμητοι σε αυτόν τον τόπο!!!










Κατάληψη Ελαία




Θα είμαστε κι εμείς εκεί










ΑΛΛΗΛΕΓΓΥΗ ΣΤΟ ΓΑΛΛΙΚΟ ΜΑΘΗΤΙΚΟ ΚΙΝΗΜΑ




OPEN CALL TO PROTEST ON SUNDAY 18TH OF OCTOBER IN SUPPORT OF FRENCH PROTESTERS AND TO UNITE OUR STRUGGLES ACROSS BORDERS


For over a month, French high school students have been campaigning for better teaching conditions and for equal access to education. The students are criticising inconsistent timetables, overcrowded classrooms, a lack of essential equipment and staff (teachers, social workers, nurses and supervisors), unsanitary premises (mould, asbestos, rats, no windows, broken ceilings, unsanitary toilets, etc.), and a university selection system that is obsolete, deeply unfair, arbitrary and opaque…


On the streets, whether during schoolblocks or demonstrations, students are being violently repressed. In two weeks, there have been more than 6,500 arrests of minors. Faced with heavily armed police using military-grade weapons, a 15-year-old school pupil lost his hand, a 14-year-old lost an eye, and another lost all his teeth and had his jaw broken. Hundreds of incidents of police violence have been filmed by young people: beatings, sexual assaults, racist and homophobic remarks… Thousands of adults (teachers, students, parents, firefighters…) joined the secondary school pupils to support their demands and protect their lives from the indiscriminate violence of the police. From demands focused on education, the slogans and number of participants multiplied, creating a social movement of historic proportions.


In France, as here, public services have been ravaged by budget cuts: schools, but also health and transport services… This is a logic that is neither particularly French nor Greek, but distinctly European. It is the logic of a Europe following in the footsteps of Trumpist, capitalist and imperialist America. A Europe that destroys public services, privatises and monopolises the media, sponsors fascist rhetoric and parties, and supports genocidal policies… A Europe that robs workers of their dignity and children of their future. A Europe that represses and maims.


“The fact that pupils are viewed as a threat, rather than as individuals asserting their rights, reveals how state power deals with any collective challenge to the dominant political order. When demands exceed the institutional limits set by higher authorities, state repression imposes silence and a return to ‘normality’.” – APOVOLI


In the face of the ultra-capitalist logic of today’s politicians, the dismantling of public services, the rise of fascism and the violence we face in our daily lives, we call for mobilisation. In support of French secondary school pupils, we call for a united front and a unification of struggles.


Let us gather on Sunday 18 October at 5.00 pm at Panepistimio for a demonstration in support of the French protests and to share these struggles beyond borders.


Assembly in support of French protesters


APOVOLI




ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑ ΓΙΑ ΔΙΑΔΗΛΩΣΗ ΤΗΝ ΚΥΡΙΑΚΗ 18 ΟΚΤΩΒΡΙΟΥ ΣΕ ΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΤΩΝ ΓΑΛΛΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΗΛΩΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΕΝΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΑΓΩΝΩΝ ΜΑΣ ΠΕΡΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΑ ΣΥΝΟΡΑ


Εδώ και περισσότερο από ένα μήνα, οι Γάλλοι μαθητές και μαθήτριες κινητοποιούνται για να απαιτήσουν καλύτερες συνθήκες διδασκαλίας στα δημόσια λύκεια και μεγαλύτερη ισότητα στην πρόσβαση στην εκπαίδευση. Οι μαθητές καταγγέλλουν ασυνάρτητα ωράρια, υπερπλήρεις τάξεις, έλλειψη βασικού εξοπλισμού, έλλειψη επαγγελματιών (καθηγητών, κοινωνικών λειτουργών και νοσοκόμων, επιτηρητών), χώρους που είναι ενίοτε ανθυγιεινοί (μούχλα, αμίαντος, αρουραίοι, απουσία παραθύρων, σπασμένες οροφές, ανθυγιεινές τουαλέτες κ.λπ.), ένα ξεπερασμένο και βαθιά άδικο, αυθαίρετο και αδιαφανές σύστημα επιλογής για την είσοδο στο πανεπιστήμιο… Στους δρόμους, είτε στο πλαίσιο των αποκλεισμών είτε στις διαδηλώσεις, οι μαθητές υφίστανται βίαιη καταστολή. Σε δύο εβδομάδες, καταγράφηκαν περισσότερες από 6.500 συλλήψεις ανηλίκων. Αντιμέτωποι με μια υπερ-οπλισμένη αστυνομία, που χρησιμοποιεί πολεμικά όπλα εναντίον ανηλίκων, ένας 15χρονος μαθητής λυκείου έχασε το χέρι του, ένας 14χρονος ένα μάτι, ενώ ένας άλλος έχασε όλα τα δόντια του και υπέστη κάταγμα στη γνάθο. Εκατοντάδες περιστατικά αστυνομικής βίας καταγράφονται σε βίντεο από τους νέους: ξυλοδαρμοί, σεξουαλικές επιθέσεις, ρατσιστικές και ομοφοβικές εκφράσεις… Χιλιάδες ενήλικες (καθηγητές, φοιτητές, γονείς μαθητών, πυροσβέστες…) ένωσαν τις δυνάμεις τους με τους μαθητές του λυκείου για να υποστηρίξουν τα αιτήματά τους και να προστατεύσουν τις ζωές τους από την αυθαίρετη βία των δυνάμεων της τάξης. Από τα αιτήματα που αφορούσαν συγκεκριμένα την εκπαίδευση, τα συνθήματα και οι συμμετέχοντες πολλαπλασιάστηκαν, δημιουργώντας ένα κοινωνικό κίνημα ιστορικής εμβέλειας στη Γαλλία.


Τόσο στη Γαλλία όσο και εδώ, οι δημόσιες υπηρεσίες έχουν πληγεί σοβαρά από τις περικοπές στον προϋπολογισμό: τα εκπαιδευτικά ιδρύματα, αλλά και οι υπηρεσίες υγείας, οι μεταφορές… Μια λογική που δεν είναι ούτε ιδιαίτερα γαλλική, ούτε ελληνική, αλλά καθαρά δυτική. Αυτή μιας Ευρώπης που ακολουθεί τα βήματα της «τραμπικής», καπιταλιστικής και ιμπεριαλιστικής Αμερικής. Αυτής που καταστρέφει τις δημόσιες υπηρεσίες, ιδιωτικοποιεί και μονοπωλεί τα μέσα ενημέρωσης, χρηματοδοτεί φασιστικές ομιλίες και κόμματα, υποστηρίζει γενοκτονικές πολιτικές… Αυτής που κλέβει την αξιοπρέπεια των εργαζομένων και το μέλλον των παιδιών. Αυτής που καταστέλλει και ακρωτηριάζει.


“Η αντιμετώπιση των μαθητών ως απειλή, αντί ως υποκειμένων που διεκδικούν τα δικαιώματά τους, αποκαλύπτει τον τρόπο με τον οποίο η κρατική εξουσία αντιμετωπίζει κάθε συλλογική αμφισβήτηση της κυρίαρχης πολιτικής. Όταν τα αιτήματα υπερβαίνουν τα θεσμικά όρια που έχουν τεθεί από τα πάνω, η κρατική καταστολή επιβάλλει τη σιωπή και την επιστροφή στην κανονικότητα.”


-ΑΠΟΒΟΛΗ


Αντιμέτωποι με την ακραία καπιταλιστική λογική των σημερινών πολιτικών, την καταστροφή των δημόσιων υπηρεσιών, την άνοδο του φασισμού και τη βία που έχει επιβληθεί στις ζωές μας, καλούμε σε κινητοποίηση. Σε ένδειξη αλληλεγγύης προς τους Γάλλους μαθητές λυκείου, καλούμε στην ένωση των δυνάμεων και στην ένωση των αγώνων.


Καλούμε την Κυριακή 18 Οκτωβρίου στις 17:00, στο Πανεπιστήμιο, σε μια διαδήλωση αλληλεγγύης προς τις κινητοποιήσεις στη Γαλλία, για να ακουστούν τα αιτήματά τους πέρα από τα σύνορα, γιατί είναι και δικά μας αιτήματα.


Assembly in support of French protesters


ΑΠΟΒΟΛΉ

Δράσεις την Κυριακή 18/10

infolibre

.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Turbulencias en un régimen en transición
content:
En un mundo que atraviesa una rápida transformación y cuya definición final aún no vemos, nuestro país está también bajo transformaciones estructurales. En este marco, las malas noticias de la llamada economía real no dejan de acumularse.




Foto: 

Nico Solo ((i))




El país atraviesa un cambio de régimen. Todas las turbulencias económico políticas de este tiempo tienen que ver con esa transición, tensionada además por la perspectiva electoral. Dilemas del oficialismo y la oposición.




En un mundo que atraviesa una rápida transformación y cuya definición final aún no alcanzamos a visualizar nuestro país está también bajo transformaciones estructurales, muchas de ellas tienen que ver con las tendencias globales, pero que incluye características propias de una formación social en transformación y en reconfiguración de su matriz productiva y del bloque de poder.




Cambio de régimen




De una economía parcialmente cerrada, sostenida en regulaciones estatales y controles a los movimientos de capital, paritarias libres y estímulos al consumo interno, todo financiado con gasto público, pasamos a una economía más abierta, desregulada y sin mayores controles, con libre movimiento de capitales, paritarias con techo y eje en el equilibrio fiscal, todo financiado con endeudamiento. El periodista Jorge Liotti lo describe como “el pasaje de un estatismo decadente a un librecambismo irrestricto”.




Si en el primer caso terminó con restricción externa, fuerte déficit fiscal y alta inflación. En lo que va del nuevo régimen el fuerte ajuste del gasto público para alcanzar el equilibrio fiscal, junto con el aumento de los costos, la apertura indiscriminada de la economía y un tipo de cambio bajo, ha provocado una fuerte caída del consumo, cierre de empresas, pérdida de empleos, aumento de la pobreza y numerosas familias que no llegan a fin de mes y recurren al endeudamiento.




Caen fuertemente los sectores ligados al mercado interno (industria, construcción, comercio) y se favorecen los más dinámicos (hidrocarburos, minería, agropecuario, industria del conocimientos) ligados a las cadenas globales y beneficiados por el RIGI. Si los primeros son demandantes de dólares los segundos son fuertes proveedores.




El poder económico se está redistribuyendo geográficamente, favoreciendo el llamado arco hidrocarburífero-minero más el agro (regiones andina, patagónica y pampeana) y debilitando las provincias tradicionalmente industriales (Bs.As, Córdoba y Santa Fe), lo que tendrá también impacto poblacional. Nada de esto es momentáneo ni circunstancial, es consecuencia directa del cambio de régimen que incluye transformaciones importantes en la matriz productiva, que llegaron para quedarse.




Foto: Indymedia Trabajadoras/es




Una tras otra




En esta transición las malas noticias de la llamada economía real no dejan de acumularse. El consumo no repunta, la actividad cayó 2.9 y se está al borde de la recisión técnica (dos trimestres consecutivos de caída). El FMI recalculó a la baja el crecimiento del PBI del 4% inicial al 2.1 (estimaciones locales lo reducen a 1.5 -1.7) La caída del mercado interno, la suba de costos y la apertura de importaciones, más la flexibilización de controles aduaneros que favorecen el contrabando, especialmente de bienes que reemplazan ya a buena parte de la producción local, afecta fuertemente a la industria, mientras que la inversión esta en los niveles más bajos de las últimas décadas (en el primer semestre del año es de solo 14,7%).




Esta debilidad de la economía afecta fuertemente la recaudación, por lo que para mantener el superávit fiscal primario comprometido con el FMI el gobierno aplicará en este 2026 el mayor ajuste de su gestión, 5.4% llevando el gasto público total a solo el 12.4% del PBI.




Santiago Bausili, Javier Milei, Luis Caputo




Según los últimos informes del INDEC crecen la desocupación ( 7.9%), la informalidad (alcanza al 45% y supera el 80% entre cuentapropistas), la pobreza (32.3% y 7.5 la indigencia) y las desigualdades sociales (según el índice de Gini la diferencia entre los ingresos del 10% más rico y el 10% más pobre es de 14 veces).




Si algo faltara la FED (el banco central estadounidense) luego de tres años estables elevó las tasas de interés de referencia conmoviendo el mercado financiero mundial. En nuestro país afectó el programa de pagos hasta diciembre 2027 presentado por el ministro Caputo. Descartada la toma de deuda en el mercado internacional para no convalidar tasas superiores al 10%, entre las diversas fuentes de financiamiento contaba la colocación de bonos en dólares en el mercado local pero aquí también subieron las tasas, por lo que el ministro tuvo que desistir de colocar estos bonos. Distintos análisis concluyen que como mínimo el programa tiene ahora un bache de 10.000 millones de dólares. La ayuda del amigo americano, como el año pasado, está en la carpeta del gobierno, pero todo puede depender del resultado de las elecciones de medio término del próximo 4 de noviembre.




También la política




Las turbulencias que emanan de la transición no afectan solamente a la economía, la política sufre también sus cimbronazos. En el oficialismo por un lado está el ala política, encabezada por Karina Milei, temerosa del impacto que la fragilidad económica pueda causar en un año electoral, pide flexibilizar el modelo estimulando el consumo, al mismo tiempo el ministro Caputo comparte esas preocupaciones pero quiere resolverlas a su modo, flexibilizando la política crediticia liberando encajes bancarios. Por el otro está el ala dura, Milei y Sturzenegger, que prefiere “morir con la botas puestas” antes que poner en riesgo el equilibrio fiscal. Así las dos alas están ante un dilema de difícil resolución: mantener el rumbo a como dé, puede profundizar aún más la recesión y desembocar en una derrota electoral, pero devaluar y aflojar la política monetaria puede estimular la inflación y llevar también a una derrota porque se vulneró el único capital político del gobierno que es la baja de la inflación. En este tumulto, de dichos y contradichos, el presidente Milei tuvo que salir a desmentir la renuncia del ministro Caputo…




Foto: 

Nico Solo ((i))




En la oposición la crisis sigue sin resolverse, no hay un liderazgo claro, tampoco acuerdo sobre candidaturas. No es solo una disputa de poder o un problema de egos, las fracciones en pugna están también ante el dilema de con qué programa enfrentar esta transición en el régimen económico y qué inserción internacional para el país.




Solo la izquierda anticapitalista, expresada en el FIT-U, pareciera tener claro su rumbo. Mientras vuelca todos sus esfuerzos en unificar y centralizar la multiplicidad y diversidad de conflictos que recorren el país, para darle una perspectiva política, espera pacientemente para lanzar la candidatura de Myriam Bregman, con un programa que debiera anular toda la arquitectura jurídica del mileísmo, atender la emergencia social e iniciar transformaciones estructurales en una perspectiva anticapitalista socialista.




Mientras tanto el humor social, que combina bronca y tristeza por partes iguales, está también a la espera de su propia resolución. ¿Soltará amarras ante una crisis que le ha expropiado el futuro o esperará para manifestarse en las próximas elecciones presidenciales?




La incertidumbre campea tanto en el plano de la política como de la economía.







Eduardo Lucita es integrante del colectivo EDI –Economistas de Izquierda-




La entrada 

Turbulencias en un régimen en transición

 se publicó primero en 

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

.

author: Trojka
title: Wspomnienie Patyczaka o Oskarze Kasperku
content:
Trudno mi w kilku zdaniach podsumować – ciężko w to uwierzyć! – niemal 40 lat znajomości.










“Uwolnić Oskara Kasperka” to były pierwsze plakaty, które rozwieszałem w 1987 roku jako uczeń liceum w Sosnowcu. Oskar siedział wtedy za odmowę służby wojskowej, a ja za te plakaty zaliczyłem moje pierwsze przesłuchania przez Służbę Bezpieczeństwa. Poznałem go dopiero, gdy wyszedł z więzienia, a ja przyjechałem na studia do Poznania, gdzie potem wspólnie działaliśmy w Ruchu Wolność i Pokój.



















Oskar zawsze był trochę outsiderem: nie miał może wielkiego drygu do działań organizacyjnych, za to zapewniał nam fajną oprawę graficzną: czy to plakat, czy okładkę gazetki. Później odbijałem zaprojektowane przez niego szablony na koszulkach mojej Oficyny Agrafka. Oskar nauczył mnie też wycinać stemple, przygotowywać ramy do sitodruku, a gdy odwiedzałem go w jego pracowni, to i o tzw. życiu trochę rozmawialiśmy przy herbacie i szachownicy – bo był również całkiem niezłym szachistą.










Oskar bardzo chętnie dzielił się swoją wiedzą i umiejętnościami. Chyba wręcz zależało mu, by i jego sztuka i umiejętności szły po prostu dalej między ludzi.










Od kiedy wyjechał do Trójmiasta, było tylko kilka rozmów przez telefon. W jego pracowni Weksla w ośrodku Halo Kultura byłem dopiero teraz, kiedy go żegnaliśmy i pomagałem porządkować jego rzeczy. Wielka szkoda, że trójmiejska przygoda Oskara została tak nagle przerwana. Ale wiedza, umiejętności i energia Oskara zostają wśród nas.







Artykuł 

Wspomnienie Patyczaka o Oskarze Kasperku

 pochodzi z serwisu 

FEDERACJA ANARCHISTYCZNA - wolność, równość, pomoc wzajemna

.

author: Unknown
title: Fransa: Öğrenci isyanı toplumsallaşıyor, 800 bin insan Cumartesi sokaktaydı
content:
Fransa'da eylül ortasında başlayan lise protestoları, 17 Ekim Cumartesi günü Paris'ten Akdeniz kıyısında Marsilya'ya, Orta Batı'da Limoges'da kitlesel yürüyüşlere dönüştü. İçişleri Bakanlığı ülke çapında 110 gösteri düzenlendiğini açıkladı. Gösterilerin çoğu barışçıl geçerken bazı kentlerde yağma, kundaklama ve polislerle çatışmalar yaşandı.




İsyanın sınıfsal coğrafyası




Hareketin ilk merkezlerinden biri Seine-Saint-Denis. Burası, Paris'in kuzeydoğusunda işçi sınıfı nüfusunun yoğunlaştığı yoksul bir ilçe. İsyan, Saint-Denis, Aubervilliers ve Sevran'daki liselerde öğrenciler öğretmen eksikliği, bakımsız binalar, kalabalık sınıflar ve eğitimde bölgesel eşitsizlikler nedeniyle dersleri boykotuyla  başladı. Paul-Éluard ve Le Corbusier liseleri öne çıktı. Öğretmenler ve veliler de eylemlere katıldı.




Öğrencilerin itirazı yalnızca okul binalarıyla sınırlı değildi: Yoksul mahallelerde eğitime ayrılan kaynaklar ve yükseköğretime erişim koşulları da hareketin gündemine girdi.




Piketty: “Macronizmin alacakaranlığı”




"21. Yüzyılda Kapital"in yazarı iktisatçı Thomas Piketty, 17 Ekim'de 

Le Monde

'da yayımlanan yazısında öğrenci hareketini şöyle değerlendirdi:







“Bugünkü lise ve üniversite öğrencileri hareketi, Macronizmin alacakaranlığına işaret ediyor.”







Piketty'nin aktardığı hesaplamaya göre 2017-2026 döneminde yükseköğretim bütçesi nominal olarak artsa da enflasyon ve öğrenci sayısındaki yükseliş nedeniyle öğrenci başına reel kaynak yaklaşık yüzde 20 azaldı.




Piketty, araştırmacı Asma Benhenda'nın verilerine dayanarak eğitimdeki bölgesel eşitsizliğe dikkat çekti:







"Paris ve varlıklı Hauts-de-Seine'deki öğretmenlerin yaklaşık yüzde 10'u sözleşmeli ya da mesleğe yeni başlamış öğretmenlerden oluşurken, yoksul Seine-Saint-Denis ve Val-de-Marne'da bu oran yüzde 50'ye ulaşıyor.”







Kaynak yetersizliği savunmasına “Fransa hiç bu kadar zengin olmamıştı” diyr karşılık veren Piketty sonucu bir cümleyle özetledi: 







“Sorun yalnızca bir bölüşüm sorunu.”







Sendikalar öğrencilerle buluştu




Öğrencilerle ilk örgütlü dayanışmayı eğitim emekçileri sendikaları kurdu. Eğitim, Öğretim ve Araştırma Sendikaları Federasyonu (FSU), Genel Emek Konfederasyonu (CGT), İşçi Gücü (FO), Fransız Demokratik Emek Konfederasyonu (CFDT), Ulusal Özerk Sendikalar Birliği (UNSA) ve SUD-Solidaires'in eğitim örgütleri ekim başında öğretmen açığına, eğitim bütçesine ve okul koşullarına ilişkin ortak eylem çağrılarında yer aldı.




17 Ekim'de katılım eğitim sektörünü aştı. CGT ve sendikal birlik Solidaires, üyelerini öğrenci ve emekçi gösterilerine çağırdı. CGT ücret ve emekli aylıklarının artırılmasını, hayat pahalılığıyla mücadeleyi ve kamu hizmetlerinin korunmasını öne çıkardı. Genel Sekreter Sophie Binet, kaynakların büyük servetlerden ve şirket kârlarından sağlanmasını savundu. Solidaires işyerlerinde grevlerin örgütlenmesini istedi.




Köylü Konfederasyonu (Confédération paysanne), gelir güvencesi, gıdaya erişim ve iklim adaleti talepleriyle katıldı. Akaryakıt fiyatları ve geçim sıkıntısına karşı harekete geçen Sarı Yelekliler de yürüyüşlere katıldı. Öğrenci örgütleri USL, UNEF ve Öğrenci Birliği çağrıları destekledi.




Ancak 17 Ekim'e bütün konfederasyonlar ortak genel grevle katılmadı. Eylem tatil günü yapıldı ve  CFDT ve FO ülke çapındaki ağırlıklarını 5 Kasım eylemine koyacaklarını açıkladılar. 




Gösterilerin yoğunlaştığı merkezler ve şiddet olayları




Paris'te Cumhuriyet Meydanı çevresi başlıca buluşma noktasıydı. Lyon, Nantes, Rennes, Marsilya, Lille, Toulouse, Bordeaux, Strasbourg ve Montpellier'de yürüyüşler düzenlendi. Boyun Eğmeyen Fransa (LFI) lideri Jean-Luc Mélenchon Paris'te gösteriye katıldı; komünistler ve Yeşiller de çeşitli kentlerde gösterilerde yer aldı.




Paris'te bazı mağazalar yağmalandı, araçlar ateşe verildi. Limoges'da belediye binasında yangın çıktı; Marsilya ve Lille'de belediye binaları zarar gördü. Lyon'da bir turizm bürosu kundaklandı; Bordeaux ve başka merkezlerde mağazalara saldırılar bildirildi.




Bununla birlikte, şiddet olayları yüz binlerce göstericinin katıldığı eylemlerin belkemiğini oluşturmuyor. İçişleri Bakanlığı yaklaşık 400 gözaltı açıkladı; bu sayı, yağma ve kundaklamaya karışanları ifade etmiyor. Önceki günlerde polisin gözaltına aldığı protestocu sayısı bundan birkaç kat yüksekti.




İçişleri Bakanı Laurent Nuñez saldırılardan radikal aşırı solu sorumlu tuttu; suçlamasını doğrulayan bağımsız bir genel bilanço açıklamadı. LFI lideri Mélenchon yağma ve tahribe katılmama çağrısı yaptı. Önceki gösterilerde bir gencin polisin kullandığı patlayıcı yüzünden elini kaybettiği  müdahale hakkında da soruşturma açıldı.




LFI lideri Mélenchon sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada gösterilerde yer yer şiddetin ortaya çıkmasını Başbakan Lecornu'nun güvenlikçi, polisiye yaklaşımının esasen şiddete dayanmasıyla ilişkilendirdi.







Paris'te İçişleri Bakanlığı'nın talimatıyla göstericilere saldıran polis kıtaları/Fotoğraf: X, @LucAuffret







Lecornu'nun kendisine yönelik suçlamalarını Mélenchon şöyle 

yanıtladı

: 







Sayın Lecornu,




Ateşle oynadınız. Çürüme sürecine bel bağlayarak, sadece tüm gençliği ve çalışan sendikalarını dayanışmaya sürüklediniz. Ardından Le Canard enchaîné tarafından ifşa edilen vahşi baskı talimatlarınız, ülkede eşi benzeri görülmemiş bir seferberliği tetikledi.




Benimle bu politikacı kavgasına gömülerek, bir devlet adamı olmadığınızı gösteriyorsunuz. Sadece bir memur olduğunuzu, bir rejim krizini tetiklemekte olduğunuzu. Yaratığınız tahribatın farkında mısınız?




Bu saatte bundan daha iyi bir işiniz yok mu, bu politikacı kavgası ve ahlak dersi vermekten başka? Polislere gelince, siz sorgulamanız gerekir: Bu iktidar, tuhaf ve yetersiz kararlarıyla düzensizliği organize etti. İlk fırsatta sizi terk edecek.







Sıradaki buluşma 5 Kasım




Sendikalar 5 Kasım'da düşük ücretler, satın alma gücünün gerilemesi ve kamu hizmetlerindeki niteliksizleşmeye karşı yeni eylemler planlıyor. Öğrenciler öğretmen açığının kapatılması, eğitimde eşitlik ve polis müdahalelerinin sona erdirilmesi taleplerini sürdürüyor.




(AEK)

author: Rizomatica
title: Grupo Bandelé presenta espectáculo de identidad y memoria afrotarapaqueña y afroperuana en Iquique
content:
El grupo de música y danzas Bandelé presentó la gala 

“Cumanana, el latido de nuestra historia”

, el pasado sábado 10 de octubre, en el salón Tarapacá de la ciudad de Iquique.


































En palabras de su directora musical, la percusionista Andrea Nuñez Cares y de su directora de danza Catalina Palacios:







“

Cumanana

 es una palabra de origen Kikongo, de la familia Bantú que representa la transmisión oral de saberes de generación en generación y da nombre a esta gala artística a través de la música y la danza afroperuana. Un encuentro de raíces, tambores y movimientos que honra el pasado, vibra en el presente e inspira el futuro. A través de la danza, la música y la expresión escénica, bascamos compartir con nuestra comunidad un espacio de encuentro, memoria e identidad.”







Un espectáculo de 3 horas de duración dividido en tres bloques temáticos, que presenta un recorrido por distintas expresiones de la cultura afrodescendiente del territorio, así como relatos sobre la esclavitud, la historia de instrumentos musicales ancestrales y expresiones culturales de resistencia.




Durante la muestra, el grupo celebra y agradece a distintos cultores de la música y la danza afroperuana y afrotarapaqueña, y releva expresiones ancestrales y antiguas como el ritmo afro, landó y distintos festejos como alcatraz y son de los diablos.




























Bandelé incluye en su repertorio zamacueca y una patita de cuecas choras y campesinas, dos de creación propia: “A la mar” y “Bandelé” y una cueca de tradición: “Las diez formas del canto”, que fueron bailadas por Matías Romero Soto y Karla Gómez Figueroa, campeones nacionales de cueca chora.




























Un momento que impresionó y emocionó al público asistente fue la representación del hatajo de negritos, expresión religiosa afrodescendiente que mezcla el mundo andino y el mundo afro, perteneciente al territorio de El Carmen, sur del Perú.



















El grupo también puso en escena el Cachimbo de Mamiña, mantenido vivo y transmitido por la familia Caqueo, a la cual pertenece una de las músicas del grupo.



















En el tercer bloque del espectáculo, Bandelé presentó un contrapunto de cajones peruanos, una armonía que reúne a 16 percusionistas en escena, todas las integrantes del grupo.






















Bandelé, cuyo nombre africano Bantú tiene como significado “nacidas fuera de casa” fue creado en el año 2014 y está integrado completamente por mujeres. Se enfoca en el rescate y visualización de la cultura afroperuana presente en la región de Tarapacá y de reivindicación de la presencia de las mujeres en la música y danzas afrodescendientes.




Al finalizar la muestra, su directora general Eva Loyo Moyano, se remontó a los inicios del grupo, cuando las chicas con las que inició el proyecto se habían quedado sin su profesora de festejo y le pidieron que ella diera las clases, a lo cual se reusó, pero ante la insistencia terminó aceptando. En ese momento, ella pensó que las estaba rescatando pero se dio cuenta de que al dirigirlas fueron ellas quienes la terminaron rescatando y reconectándola con lo que tanto amaba, el baile y sus raíces afro. Agradeció que las integrantes del grupo respeten y amen la cultura afrodescendiente al igual que ella.
